items.t: A Hybrid Message-Passing and Electric-Field Representation for Electrostatic QM/MM Embedding with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials
items.a: Within a hybrid quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics approach a small region of a large atomistic system is described quantum mechanically, while the rest of the system is represented by a classical force field. Despite this, the computational cost of the quantum calculation severely limits the accessible simulation and sampling time. Replacing the quantum calculation with a machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) trained on quantum reference data can greatly increase the accessible simulation time. However, the accuracy and efficiency strongly depend on the specific way in which the MLIP incorporates information about the classical (electrostatic) environment. Here, we demonstrate that existing strategies based purely on features derived from an external electric field fail to distinguish certain environments, ultimately limiting their accuracy. As a solution, we propose an extension to the equivariant TensorNet architecture that mitigates this shortcoming by incorporating classical atoms close to the quantum region into the message-passing scheme, combined with features derived from the electric field for describing the environment farther away. We show that this combination achieves higher accuracy than either approach alone.
items.tz: 一种结合消息传递与电场表示的静电QM/MM嵌入方法，采用机器学习互作用势
items.az:
在混合量子力学/分子力学方法中，大原子体系中的一个小区域采用量子力学描述，而体系的其余部分则由经典力场表示。
尽管如此，量子计算的计算成本严重限制了可访问的模拟和采样时间。
用机器学习原子势（MLIP）替代量子计算，该势函数在量子参考数据上训练，可以显著提升模拟的可访问时间。
然而，准确性和效率强烈依赖于MLIP如何具体融入经典（静电）环境信息。
在这里，我们证明了仅基于外部电场导出的特征的现有策略无法区分某些环境，从而限制了其准确性。
作为一种解决方案，我们提出了一种扩展的等变张量网络架构，通过将靠近量子区域的经典原子纳入消息传递方案，并结合从电场导出的特征来描述更远区域的环境，以缓解这一缺陷。
我们表明，这种结合方法的准确性高于单独使用任一方法。

items.t: Spin controlled transport switching with negative differential resistance in a chiral molecular device
items.a: Manipulating electron transport through spin control is fundamental to molecular spintronics. We show that adjusting the crystal field and oxidation state of a magnetic center embedded in a chiral framework allows accurate regulation of transport across spin states ranging from S = 0 to 2. Our results reveal pronounced current drops (up to 70%) during spin transitions and the appearance of negative differential resistance (NDR), arising from bias-driven realignment of the highest occupied molecular orbitals and accompanying shifts in the transmission spectrum. We further show that asymmetric coupling to the environment, in particular through a CO axial ligand, leads to current rectification and robust NDR under reverse bias. In addition, Fe(III) junctions exhibit remarkable spin-filtering capabilities, with the S = 3/2 state achieving a spin polarization exceeding 0.95 at low bias, highlighting a versatile strategy for molecular spin-state engineering.
items.tz: 在一种手性分子器件中实现由负微分电阻控制的输运开关
items.az:
通过自旋控制调控电子传输是分子自旋电子学的基础。
我们证明，通过调节嵌入手性框架中的磁性中心的晶体场和氧化态，可以准确调控从S = 0到S = 2的自旋态之间的输运。
我们的结果表明，在自旋跃迁过程中出现了显著的电流下降（高达70%）以及负微分电阻（NDR），这是由于偏压驱动的最高占据分子轨道重新排列以及传输谱的伴随变化所致。
我们进一步表明，不对称地耦合到环境中，特别是通过CO轴向配体，会导致反向偏压下的电流整流和稳定的负阻效应。
此外，Fe(III) 接口表现出显著的自旋过滤能力，S = 3/2 态在低偏压下实现了超过 0.95 的自旋极化，凸显了分子自旋态工程的一种多功能策略。

items.t: Diffusion-Model-Guided Identification of a Candidate α-Synuclein Aggregation Inhibitor under Secondary-Nucleation-Dominated Conditions
items.a: The process of α-synuclein aggregation results in the formation of amyloid deposits that accumulate in the brain of patients affected by Parkinson’s disease and related synucleinopathies. Among possible therapeutic strategies for these conditions, one approach is based on the development of compounds capable of inhibiting α-synuclein aggregation. An effective inhibition could be achieved by blocking the nucleation sites on the surface of the amyloid fibrils that are responsible for their autocatalytic proliferation. Here, we use an E(3)-equivariant conditional diffusion model to identify candidate inhibitors of this type. With this approach, we generated pocket-conditioned molecules, identified purchasable analogues, and experimentally tested selected compounds. We thus identified a compound that delays α-synuclein aggregation under conditions in which secondary nucleation is the dominant process. These results illustrate the use of conditional diffusion models to identify candidate aggregation inhibitors.
items.v: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
items.tz: 基于扩散模型指导的在二级成核主导条件下筛选一种候选α-突触肌氨酸脱羧酶聚集抑制剂
items.az:
α-突触核蛋白聚集过程导致形成淀粉样沉积物，这些沉积物在帕金森病及相关合成色素病患者脑组织中积累。
在这些疾病的可能治疗策略中，一种方法是基于开发能够抑制α-突触素聚集的化合物。
通过阻断导致其自催化增殖的淀粉样纤维表面成核位点，可实现有效的抑制。
这里，我们使用一个E(3)-equivariant conditional diffusion model来识别这类化合物的候选抑制剂。
采用这种方法，我们生成了口袋条件下的分子，筛选出可采购的类似物，并对选定的化合物进行了实验测试。
我们因此鉴定出一种化合物，在二级成核为主要过程的条件下可延缓α-突触核蛋白的聚集。
这些结果展示了条件扩散模型在识别候选聚集抑制剂方面的应用。

items.t: Molecular Trends in the Oxidative H Abstraction of Organic Molecules on Oxide Surfaces: Implications for Electrolyte Reactivity at the Positive Electrode in Li-Ion Batteries
items.a: Oxidative degradation of carbonate solvents via C–H activation is observed on late transition metal oxide positive electrodes in Li-ion batteries. However, analogous reactivity of other classes of organic molecules on oxides is not well understood. Here, we used density functional theory calculations to show how C–H activation changes from deprotonation to oxidative hydrogen abstraction as the lattice oxygen activity increases by moving the Fermi level closer to the oxygen 2p-band center. By using a set of 23 small molecules with 50 nonequivalent C–H bonds, spanning a broad range of functional groups and substitutions, we show how relevant energies of the isolated molecules impact the driving force for degradation reactions at the surface of LiNiO2, an oxide with high lattice oxygen activity. We demonstrated that C–H bond oxidation free energy, measured as the free energy to substitute a C–H bond with a C–OH bond for the isolated molecule, is the descriptor with the most predictive power for the C–H activation driving force on an oxide with highly reactive lattice oxygen. Using this descriptor, we identified promising S- and F-containing compounds with enhanced stability toward C–H activation. These results pave the way for a rational design of novel electrolytes that minimize degradation and impedance growth of Ni-rich LiNixMnyCo1–x–yO2 (NMC) electrodes.
items.v: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
items.tz: 有机分子在氧化物表面的氢抽象反应趋势：对锂离子电池正极电解质反应性的影响
items.az:
在锂离子电池中，晚过渡金属氧化物正极上观察到碳酸酯溶剂通过C–H活化发生的氧化降解。
然而，其他类有机分子在氧化物上的类似反应性尚不明确。
在此，我们通过密度泛函理论计算表明，随着晶格氧活性的增加（即费米能级靠近氧2p带中心），C–H活化过程从脱质子转变为氧化氢抽象。
通过使用一组包含50个非等价C–H键的23种小分子，这些分子涵盖了广泛的官能团和取代基，我们展示了孤立分子的相关能量如何影响LiNiO₂（一种具有高晶格氧活性的氧化物）表面降解反应的驱动力。
我们证明了C–H键氧化自由能——即孤立分子中将C–H键替换为C–OH键所需的自由能——是预测在具有高度活泼晶格氧的氧化物上C–H活化驱动力的最佳描述符。
利用这一描述符，我们识别出了一些含硫和氟的化合物，其对C–H活化具有增强的稳定性。
这些结果为新型电解质的理性设计铺平了道路，该设计可最小化富镍锂层氧化物（NMC）电极的降解和阻抗增长。
items.tw: 作者：Erin R. Johnson；期刊在关注名单

items.t: Coarse-Graining Optimal Transport for Rollout-Free Post-Training of Flow Matching
items.a: Flow matching depends critically on the coupling used to pair source and target samples. Optimal transport (OT) couplings can reduce velocity conflict and straighten trajectories; but, in practice, challenges remain: the source comes from a continuous distribution, only a finite number of target samples data are accessible, and the neural network has finite capacity. For these reasons, making the coupling more OT-like may not consistently improve sampling quality, in particular in the low number-of-function-evaluation (NFE) regime. Motivated by this, we introduce ReCouple, a controllable framework that constructs coarse-grained OT couplings, to better understand rollout-free OT-based post-training. We also consider extensions of this basic framework: ReCouple+ extends this toward the continuous-source setting by increasing source resolution, converging to semi-discrete OT in the appropriate limit; and ReCouple++ further adds spatial regularization, motivated by the observation that straight trajectories need not correspond to spatially simple velocity fields. Empirical validation demonstrates the effectiveness of these methods, and it reveals an NFE-dependent interplay between coupling optimality, neural realizability, and generation quality.
items.tz: 基于最优传输的粗粒化流匹配无回滚后训练方法
items.az:
流匹配严重依赖于用于配对源样本和目标样本的耦合方式。
最优传输（OT）耦合可以减少速度冲突并使轨迹变直；但实践中仍存在挑战：源来自连续分布，仅能获取有限数量的目标样本数据，且神经网络具有有限容量。
因此，使耦合更加接近最优传输可能并不总是能提高采样质量，尤其是在函数评估次数（NFE）较少的 regime 中。
受此启发，我们提出了ReCouple，一个可控制的框架，用于构建粗粒度的最优传输耦合，以更好地理解无回滚的基于最优传输的训练后优化。
我们还考虑了这一基本框架的扩展：ReCouple+ 通过提高源分辨率将该方法拓展至连续源场景，在适当极限下收敛到半离散最优传输；而 ReCouple++ 进一步引入了空间正则化，这是基于观察到直线轨迹并不一定对应于在空间上简单的速度场。
经验验证表明，这些方法是有效的，并揭示了NFE依赖的耦合最优性、神经可实现性与生成质量之间的相互作用。

items.t: When Donors Cannot Choose, the Metal Decides: Acceptor-Site Hierarchy and Polyfurcated, Metal-Involving Halogen Bonds in Platinum(II) Cocrystals
items.a: The square-planar complex [Pt(ppy){S2CN(CH2)6}] (1; ppyH = 2-phenylpyridine) presents, within a single molecule, a set of chemically distinct halogen-bond (HaB) acceptor sitesthe nucleophilic dz2-PtII center, the dithiocarbamate sulfur atoms, and the metalated C6H4 ring of the phenylpyridyl ligand. To probe how an incoming σ-hole selects among these competing sites, 1 was cocrystallized with a series of polyfluorinated iodoarenes of increasing topicitymonotopic 4-FIBP, ditopic 1,4-FIB and 4,4′-FIBP, and tritopic 1,3,5-FIBwhose σ- and π-holes are deliberately non-codirectional. Four cocrystals were obtained and characterized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction. Across all structures the iodine σ-hole preferentially engages the metal center, and every I···Pt contact is accompanied by an ancillary I···S and/or I···C linkage, giving rise to asymmetric three-center I···(Pt,S)/(Pt,C), four-center I···(Pt,S,C), and, in one case, a five-center I···(Pt,S,C,C) bond, in which the I···Pt component dominates. A complementary set of theoretical bonding descriptors (AIM, ELF, IGMH, IBSIW, NBO, ETS-NOCV, EDD, and CDF) corroborates this site hierarchy and shows that several attractive contacts are not flagged by bond critical points, underscoring the need for a multi-descriptor analysis of heavy-atom interactions. The supramolecular dimensionality scales with donor topicitydiscrete assemblies, one-dimensional chains, and two-dimensional layers for mono-, di-, and tritopic donors, respectivelyyet the observed non-ideal stoichiometries reveal that the donors do not always realize their maximal topicity toward the preferred acceptor sites, an outcome traced to σ-hole anticooperativity and crystal-packing effects. In short, when the donor cannot reconcile its holes to satisfy any single site, the metal decides: the dz2-PtII center wins the σ-hole and organizes the assembly around itself.
items.tz: 当给体无法选择时，金属决定：铂(II)共晶中的受体位点层级及多枝状、涉及金属的卤键
items.az:
方形平面配合物 [Pt(ppy){S2CN(CH2)6}] (1; ppyH = 2-苯基吡啶) 在单个分子内包含一组化学上不同的卤键（HaB）受体位点——亲核性的 dz²-PtII 中心、二硫代氨基甲酸根的硫原子，以及苯基吡啶配体中被金属化后的 C6H4 环。
为了探究入射的σ孔如何在这些竞争性位点中进行选择，1与一系列氟代碘芳烃共晶化，这些氟代碘芳烃的取代基位点依次增加——单取代4-FIBP、双取代1,4-FIB和4,4′-FIBP以及三取代1,3,5-FIB——其σ孔和π孔被刻意设计为非共方向。
获得了四种共晶，并通过单晶X射线衍射进行了表征。
在所有结构中，碘的σ孔优先与金属中心相互作用，且每一个I···Pt接触都伴随着一个辅助的I···S和/或I···C连接，形成不对称的三中心I···(Pt,S)/(Pt,C)、四中心I···(Pt,S,C)键，以及在一种情况下形成的五中心I···(Pt,S,C,C)键，其中I···Pt成分占主导。
一组互补的理论成键描述符（AIM、ELF、IGMH、IBSIW、NBO、ETS-NOCV、EDD 和 CDF）证实了这一位点层级，并表明若干吸引相互作用未被键临界点标记，凸显了对重原子相互作用进行多描述符分析的必要性。
超分子维度随给体的配位性变化——单配位给体形成离散组装，双配位给体形成一维链，三配位给体形成二维层——然而观察到的非理想化学计量比表明，给体并不总是将其最大配位性实现于优选的受体位点，这一现象归因于σ孔抗协同作用和晶体堆积效应。
简而言之，当给体无法将其空穴分配到任一单一位点以满足其需求时，金属决定：dz²-PtII 中心赢得σ孔，并围绕自身组织组装。

items.t: Transferring Peptide-Target Interaction Patterns to Small Molecules by Joint Guidance for Diffusion and Flow Matching
items.a: Generating small molecules to target protein-protein interactions (PPIs) remains one of the most challenging yet high-reward frontiers in drug discovery. Unlike traditional small-molecule drugs that bind to deep, well-defined pockets, PPI interfaces often comprise broad, shallow binding surfaces. A natural strategy is to leverage known peptide-target interactions, as peptide ligands provide rich interface-level constraints. However, a major algorithmic challenge is that rigid atom-level conditioning on peptide structures can over-constrain the generative space and exclude valid small-molecule solutions. To address this challenge, we present PIFT (Peptide InterFace Transfer), a novel framework that transfers peptide-target interaction patterns to small molecules through joint sampling-time guidance of masked discrete diffusion and continuous flow matching. PIFT first maps peptide-target and small-molecule-target interfaces into a shared, target-conditioned interaction space, capturing transferable interface information across molecular modalities. The resulting peptide-derived reference then jointly steers building-block logits and 3D coordinates toward peptide-compatible molecules while preserving a strong adapted molecular prior. Extensive experiments across diverse PPI targets show that the learned representation captures cross-modal interaction compatibility, while peptide guidance improves interface recovery and achieves strong docking performance and favorable molecular properties.
items.tz: 通过扩散和流匹配的联合指导将肽-靶标相互作用模式转移到小分子
items.az:
生成小分子靶向蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）仍然是药物发现中最具挑战性却回报最高的前沿领域之一。
不同于传统小分子药物所结合的深且明确的口袋，蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用界面通常包含宽而浅的结合表面。
一种自然的策略是利用已知的肽-靶标相互作用，因为肽配体提供了丰富的界面约束。
然而，一个主要的算法挑战是，对肽结构进行刚性原子级别的条件约束可能会过度限制生成空间，并排除有效的小分子解决方案。
为解决这一挑战，我们提出了PIFT（肽-靶点界面转移），一种新颖的框架，通过掩码离散扩散和连续流匹配的联合采样时间引导，将肽-靶点相互作用模式转移到小分子上。
PIFT 首先将肽-靶标和小分子-靶标界面映射到一个共享的、靶标条件下的相互作用空间中，捕捉跨分子模态的可转移界面信息。
得到的肽衍生参考则同时引导构建块对数概率和三维坐标趋向于与肽相容的分子，同时保持一个强适应的分子先验。
在多种PPI靶标上的广泛实验表明，所学习的表示捕捉了跨模态交互兼容性，而肽引导提高了界面恢复效果，并实现了优异的对接性能和良好的分子性质。

items.t: ORCHID: Connecting Finite-Temperature Thermodynamic Evidence to Computational Materials Discovery
items.a: Finite-temperature phase stability is essential to materials discovery, but the evidence needed to describe it remains scattered across decades of literature. ORCHID organizes this evidence around the thermodynamic states that the observations describe, using tiered agentic extraction guided by thermodynamic rules, expert supervision and explicit validation. The collection contains 73,542 values from 1,321 papers, represented with their thermodynamic states, phase identities, provenance, evidence classes and uncertainty, together with assessed phase assemblages and calculated references. A qualified subset is released in ESPEI-compatible form for CALPHAD assessment, and machine-readable access supports both human and AI-assisted reuse. Blind expert evaluation of 48 diagram fields gives 93.8% agreement, increasing to 97.9% after accounting for notation conventions. On a common formation-enthalpy benchmark, eight MLIPs show residual spreads close to their DFT reference, motivating evaluation of finite-temperature phase stability through PhaseForge. One-shot MLIP-PhaseForge descriptions of Cu-Zr recover 0.35-0.56 of observed phase occurrences at assessed field points. ORCHID-assisted refinement through PhaseForge+ recovers 9 of 13 invariant temperatures within 2 sigma and reduces held-out activity error from 5.1 to 1.7 kJ/mol. By supplying interpreted literature evidence directly to gradient-based refinement through PhaseForge+, ORCHID connects evidence recovery to programmatic CALPHAD assessment. With the initial description and fitting datasets prepared, the final Cu-Zr refinement completes in approximately 27 minutes, providing a foundation for continuously updated thermodynamic models and their use in materials discovery.
items.tz: ORCHID：将有限温度热力学证据与计算材料发现相连接
items.az:
有限温度下的相稳定性对材料发现至关重要，但描述它的证据仍分散在数十年的文献中。
ORCHID 将这些证据围绕观测所描述的热力学状态进行组织，采用由热力学规则、专家监督和显式验证指导的分层代理提取。
该集合包含来自1321篇论文的73,542个值，其表示形式包括热力学状态、相态身份、来源、证据类别和不确定性，以及评估的相组合和计算得到的参考数据。
一个合格的子集以与ESPEI兼容的形式释放，用于CALPHAD评估，机器可读访问支持人类和AI辅助的重复使用。
对48个图示字段的盲专家评估显示，一致性为93.8%，在考虑符号规范后提升至97.9%。
在一项常见的形成焓基准测试中，八个MLIPs的残余偏差接近其DFT参考值，这促使通过PhaseForge评估有限温度下的相稳定性。
单次MLIP-PhaseForge描述对Cu-Zr的相出现情况在评估场点上恢复了0.35-0.56的观测相发生率。
通过PhaseForge+结合ORCHID辅助优化，成功恢复了13个不变温度中的9个，误差控制在2个标准差以内，并将留出集的活性误差从5.1降低至1.7 kJ/mol。
通过将解释过的文献证据直接供给PhaseForge+中的基于梯度的精修，ORCHID将证据恢复与程序化CALPHAD评估相连接。
初始描述和拟合数据集准备完成后，最终的Cu-Zr精修在约27分钟内完成，为持续更新的热力学模型及其在材料发现中的应用奠定了基础。

items.t: Generative Design and Graph Neural Network Screening of Novel Bimetallic Alloy Catalysts for the Hydrogen Evolution Reaction
items.a: Identifying earth-abundant catalysts for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) is a central challenge in scalable green hydrogen production. We present a computational pipeline that couples diffusion-based generative modelling, machine-learning force-field relaxation, and graph neural network (GNN) property prediction to discover bimetallic HER catalysts beyond the structures and stoichiometries covered by existing adsorption databases. A generative model (MatterGen) is fine-tuned on bulk alloy structures labelled with their minimum hydrogen adsorption energy and steered towards adsorption energies near zero. From the generated pool we retain the stable structures that are novel bimetallic alloys: binary compositions built from the training-set metals but at stoichiometries or structures absent from that database. Each candidate's low-index facets are ranked by a machine-learning-force-field (MatterSim) surface-energy screen, and only the most stable terminations are converted into explicit slab models with hydrogen adsorbed at all high-symmetry surface sites and relaxed with the same force field. Two GNN surrogates (MEGNet and ALIGNN), trained on a high-throughput density functional theory (DFT) dataset, then screen the resulting slab candidates. Because the two models encode the local environment through different inductive biases, we retain only the alloys on which both agree, reducing the influence of any single model. This consensus screening, combined with a MatterSim energy-difference triangulation, resulted in a shortlist of near-thermoneutral bimetallic candidates. Eight are validated with plane-wave DFT, and four of them, Pd5Au, Pt5Rh, Cu5Pt3, and Pd13Ru3, bind hydrogen within the thermoneutral window. All eight alloys are dynamically stable by phonon calculations. These four alloys are highlighted as DFT-validated bimetallic HER candidates for experimental follow-up.
items.tz: 新型双金属合金催化剂的生成设计及图神经网络筛选（用于析氢反应）
items.az:
识别适用于氢析出反应（HER）的地球丰度催化剂是实现可扩展绿色氢能生产的核心挑战。
我们提出了一条计算流程，该流程结合基于扩散的生成建模、机器学习力场松弛以及图神经网络（GNN）性质预测，以发现超出现有吸附数据库所涵盖的结构和化学计量比的双金属析氢反应（HER）催化剂。
一种生成模型（MatterGen）在具有最小氢吸附能的 bulk 合金结构上进行微调，并被引导至接近零的吸附能。
从生成的集合中，我们保留那些稳定的、具有新颖双金属合金特性的结构：由训练集金属构成的二元组分，但其化学计量比或结构在该数据库中不存在。
每个候选物的低指数晶面通过机器学习力场（MatterSim）表面能筛选进行排序，仅将最稳定的终止面转化为具有所有高对称性表面位点吸附氢原子的显式 slab 模型，并使用相同的力场进行松弛。
两种图神经网络代理模型（MEGNet 和 ALIGNN），在高通量密度泛函理论（DFT）数据集上训练后，对所得的层状候选结构进行筛选。
因为两个模型通过不同的诱导偏置编码局部环境，我们仅保留两者一致的合金，从而减少单一模型的影响。
这一共识筛选结合了MatterSim的能量差三角法，得到了一组接近热中性的双金属候选物。
八个结构通过平面波密度泛函理论验证，其中四个结构——Pd5Au、Pt5Rh、Cu5Pt3 和 Pd13Ru3——的氢结合位于热中性窗口内。
所有八种合金通过声子计算都是动力学稳定的。
这四种合金被突出显示为DFT验证的双金属HER候选材料，用于后续实验研究。

items.t: WASABI: Wasserstein Sampling via Bridge Interpolants
items.a: Sampling from Boltzmann distributions is a fundamental problem in physics, chemistry, and biology. We introduce WAsserstein SAmpling via Bridge Interpolants (WASABI), a method that trains a diffusion model to generate samples from a target Boltzmann distribution given access only to the energy function. WASABI minimizes the KL divergence between the distribution generated by its diffusion model and the Boltzmann target using Wasserstein gradient flows. This approach builds on a principle underlying classical sampling methods such as Langevin dynamics. However, applying Wasserstein gradient flows to diffusion models is challenging because the updates require the gradient of the model's own log density, which is generally intractable. We derive a practical training algorithm that avoids computing this gradient. Once trained, WASABI can generate new samples without further evaluations of the energy or its gradient. On alanine dipeptide, WASABI outperforms the best reported baselines using an estimated 3.3 times fewer energy evaluations. It also achieves competitive performance on interacting particle system benchmarks.
items.tz: WASABI：通过桥插值的Wasserstein采样
items.az:
从玻尔兹曼分布中采样是物理学、化学和生物学中的一个基本问题。
我们提出了基于桥插值的Wasserstein采样（WASABI），一种方法，该方法通过训练扩散模型，在仅获得能量函数的情况下，从目标Boltzmann分布中生成样本。
WASABI 通过 Wasserstein 梯度流最小化其扩散模型生成的分布与 Boltzmann 目标分布之间的 KL 散度。
该方法基于经典采样方法（如朗之万动力学）所依赖的原理。
然而，将Wasserstein梯度流应用于扩散模型存在挑战，因为更新需要模型自身对数密度的梯度，这通常难以求解。
我们推导出一种实用的训练算法，该算法避免计算这个梯度。
一旦训练完成，WASABI 可以生成新样本而无需进一步评估能量或其梯度。
在丙氨酸二肽上，WASABI 比最佳已报道的基线方法在能量评估次数上减少了约3.3倍。
它还在相互作用粒子系统基准测试中取得了有竞争力的性能。

items.t: Shock Loading Accesses Reaction Pathways beyond Accelerated Thermolysis
items.a: Thermolysis and shock loading can produce similar major stable products in energetic materials, despite different chemical evolution and reaction pathways. Here, we develop EMFF-MACE, a reactive machine-learning potential for C/H/N/O energetic materials, enabling thermolysis simulations of 20 materials and shock simulations of 10 on a common potential energy surface. Comparisons at matched normalized reaction progress reveal divergent chemical states and local structural environments. Mean reaction-state similarity decreases from 94.0% at 20% progress to 25.9% at trajectory endpoints, while 47.1-92.6% of shock local environments lie outside corresponding material-specific thermolysis reference domains. Structural and reaction-network analyses reveal enhanced intermolecular reorganization and additional association and rearrangement branches under shock loading, despite partially shared early decomposition chemistry. These findings show that loading history influences the structural states and subsequent reaction pathways accessed during decomposition, rather than merely the rate of thermolysis.
items.tz: 冲击加载揭示了超越加速热解的反应路径
items.az:
热解和冲击加载在含能材料中可以产生相似的主要稳定产物，尽管其化学演化和反应路径不同。
在此，我们开发了EMFF-MACE，一种用于C/H/N/O类能量材料的反应性机器学习势能函数，能够在同一个势能面上实现20种材料的热解模拟和10种材料的冲击模拟。
在匹配的归一化反应进度下比较显示，化学状态和局部结构环境存在差异。
反应状态相似性从20%进度时的94.0%下降到轨迹终点时的25.9%，而47.1-92.6%的冲击局部环境位于对应材料特异热解参考域之外。
结构与反应网络分析表明，在冲击加载下，分子间重排得到增强，并出现了额外的结合和重组分支，尽管早期分解化学部分重叠。
这些发现表明，加载历史影响着材料在分解过程中所经历的结构状态及后续的反应路径，而不仅仅是热解速率。

items.t: Reactive Molecular Dynamics of Hydrogen Evolution at Charged Interfaces Using Effective Machine Learning Potentials
items.a: Understanding electrochemical reaction mechanisms requires atomistic simulations that simultaneously capture charged interfaces, explicit solvent, and long-time dynamics, which remain beyond the reach of conventional ab initio molecular dynamics. Here, we develop an equivariant machine-learning interatomic potential trained on density functional theory data for electrochemically activated MoS2/water interfaces under charged conditions. The resulting model reproduces first-principles energetics with an error of 7 meV/atom, while enabling nanosecond molecular dynamics simulations of systems containing hundreds of atoms. The simulations reveal that hydrogen evolution is strongly governed by surface hydrogen coverage, with higher coverages promoting faster H2 formation while preserving the interfacial water structure. Mechanistic analysis identifies the Heyrovsky-like pathway as the dominant hydrogen evolution mechanism, whereas Tafel recombination contributes only at high coverages. The emergence of sustained hydrogen evolution, stable interfacial populations, and coverage-dependent reaction pathways demonstrates that electrochemically informed MLIPs can reproduce chemically meaningful reactive dynamics at charged interfaces over nanosecond time scales.
items.tz: 利用有效机器学习势函数研究带电界面处氢析出的反应分子动力学
items.az:
理解电化学反应机制需要能够同时捕捉带电界面、显式溶剂以及长时间动力学的原子级模拟，而这仍超出传统从头算分子动力学方法的范畴。
在这里，我们开发了一种基于密度泛函理论数据的、在带电条件下电化学激活的MoS₂/水界面的equivariant机器学习紧束缚势。
所得模型的误差为7 meV/原子，能够实现包含数百个原子体系的纳秒级分子动力学模拟。
模拟结果表明，氢析出强烈受表面氢覆盖率的调控，较高的覆盖率促进更快的H2生成，同时保持界面水结构。
机制分析表明，Heyrovsky 类路径是主导的氢析出机制，而塔菲尔复合仅在高覆盖率时起作用。
持续的氢析出、稳定的界面群体以及依赖覆盖率的反应路径的出现，表明基于电化学信息的机器学习界面模型（MLIPs）能够在纳秒时间尺度上重现带电界面处具有化学意义的反应动力学。

items.t: Structure, dynamics, and chemical ordering in multi-element metallic nanoparticles: an atomistic modeling and machine learning approach
items.a: Over the past decades, the study of metallic nanoalloys has considerably broadened from initially monometallic, via bimetallic to increaslingly complex multimetallic systems. Initially focused on the structural, dynamical, and thermal properties of bimetallic alloys, the field has progressively expanded towards systems containing an increasing number of chemical components, including High-Entropy nanoalloys (HENA). HENAs are generally defined as multimetallic nanoparticles composed of at least five different metallic species at similar concentration, whose complex chemical interactions give rise to a rich configurational space and a variety of structural and chemical arrangements. However, not all multicomponent metallic nanoparticles can be classified as high-entropy nanoalloys : the presence of several chemical species alone is not sufficient to ensure that configurational entropy is the dominant factor governing their stability. Understanding the factors governing the stability of these systems therefore requires consideration of both energetic and entropic contributions, as well as their interplay with temperature. This thesis presents a machine-learning-assisted strategy for the parametrization of interatomic potentials and its application to the atomistic study of multimetallic nanoparticles. The aim is to develop reliable potential parametrization capable of describing the structural, thermal, and chemical properties of a quinary metallic system: CuNiPdPtRh. The atomistic description is based on the second-moment approximation of the Tight-Binding model, studied by Monte Carlo simulations, basin-hopping global optimization, and molecular dynamics. In the first part of the thesis, the methodology is applied to monometallic systems, including face-centred cubic (fcc) metals such as Au, Cu, Ni, Pd, Pt, and Rh, as well as body-centred cubic (bcc) Fe. The corresponding potential parameters are investigated and optimised to provide an accurate description of the energetic and thermodynamic properties of the metals considered. The approach is subsequently extended to bimetallic systems, where the main challenge lies in determining the heteronuclear interaction parameters from experimental thermodynamic properties of binary alloys. Artificial Neural Network (ANN) are employed as surrogate models to reproduce the physical properties of binary alloys and accelerate the fitting procedure of the heteronuclear potential parameters. The resulting parametrization provides sufficiently accurate models for the atomistic investigation of bimetallic nanoparticles characterised by both positive and negative mixing enthalpies. The parametrized potentials are subsequently employed to investigate the CuNiPdPtRh nanoalloy. The temperature-dependent evolution as well as the equilibration at constant temperature, is studied through atomistic simulations. The analysis focuses on structural transformations, thermal stability, and chemical ordering, with the aim of identifying the most favourable atomic arrangements. The optimal chemical ordering is further investigated, together with the growth of CuNiPdPtRh nanoparticles. Overall, this work establishes a machine-learning-assisted strategy for the parametrization of interatomic potentials and demonstrates its application to the atomistic modelling of complex multicomponent metallic systems. The results highlight the important role of energetic contributions and chemical interactions in determining the structural stability and chemical ordering of multielement nanoalloys. The chemical ordering obtained is markedly different from that of a solid solution, exhibiting a highly robust multishell chemical ordering that is largely insensitive to the different simulation protocols considered. In this configuration, the core is occupied by Ni and Rh, with an intermediate shell composed of Pt, while the surface is enriched in Cu and Pd.

items.tz: 多元素金属纳米颗粒的结构、动力学和化学有序性：一种原子级建模与机器学习方法
items.az:
在过去几十年中，金属纳米合金的研究已从最初的一元合金，经二元合金逐步扩展到越来越复杂的多金属体系。
最初聚焦于双金属合金的结构、动力学和热学性质，该领域已逐步扩展至包含越来越多化学组分的体系，包括高熵纳米合金（HENA）。
HENAs 通常被定义为由至少五种不同金属物种以相似浓度组成的多金属纳米颗粒，其复杂的化学相互作用导致了丰富的构型空间以及多种结构和化学排列。
然而，并非所有的多组分金属纳米颗粒都可以归类为高熵纳米合金：仅存在多种化学物种并不能保证构型熵是决定其稳定性的主导因素。
因此，理解这些体系稳定性的决定因素需要考虑能量和熵的贡献，以及它们与温度之间的相互作用。
本论文提出了一种基于机器学习的原子间势参数化策略及其在多金属纳米颗粒原子级研究中的应用。
目标是开发一种可靠的势函数参数化方法，能够描述五元金属体系CuNiPdPtRh的结构、热学和化学性质。
原子级描述基于紧束缚模型的二阶矩近似，通过蒙特卡洛模拟、盆地跳跃全局优化和分子动力学研究。
在论文的第一部分，该方法被应用于单金属体系，包括面心立方（fcc）金属如Au、Cu、Ni、Pd、Pt和Rh，以及体心立方（bcc）的Fe。
相应的势能参数被研究并优化，以准确描述所考虑金属的能态和热力学性质。
该方法随后被扩展至双金属体系，其中主要挑战在于从二元合金的实验热力学性质中确定异核相互作用参数。
人工神经网络（ANN）被用作代理模型，以重现二元合金的物理性质，并加速异核势参数的拟合过程。
所得的参数化为双金属纳米颗粒的原子级研究提供了足够准确的模型，这些纳米颗粒具有正负混合焓。
参数化势能随后被用于研究CuNiPdPtRh纳米合金。
通过原子模拟研究了温度依赖的演化过程以及恒温下的平衡过程。
该分析聚焦于结构转变、热稳定性及化学有序性，旨在识别最有利的原子排列。
进一步研究了最优的化学有序性，以及CuNiPdPtRh纳米颗粒的生长。
总体而言，本工作建立了一种机器学习辅助的相互作用势参数化策略，并将其应用于复杂多组分金属体系的原子级建模。
结果强调了能量贡献和化学相互作用在决定多元素纳米合金结构稳定性和化学有序性中的重要作用。
得到的化学有序性与固溶体明显不同，表现出一种高度稳健的多壳层化学有序，对所考虑的不同模拟协议几乎不敏感。
在此构型中，核心由Ni和Rh占据，中间壳层由Pt组成，表面富集于Cu和Pd。

items.t: Recent advances in chiral organic room‐temperature phosphorescence with circularly polarized luminescence
items.a: Circularly polarized room‐temperature phosphorescence (CPRTP) materials combine the dual advantages of long‐lived triplet emission and chiral optical response, demonstrating broad application prospects in information security, bioimaging, and flexible optoelectronics. This review outlines recent progress in organic CPRTP materials from molecular chiral design, aggregation modulation, performance tuning and application scenarios. Chiroptical activity is realized via covalent modification, supramolecular assembly and liquid crystal induction. Aggregation strategies including crystal engineering and matrix doping enhance the luminescence dissymmetry factor, while simultaneously improve the emission efficiency. Emerging CPRTP systems, including near‐infrared (NIR) emitters, dynamically regulated chiral systems, and weavable fibers have been exploited for bioimaging and electro‐controlled encryption, shifting research from basic property study to practical use. Although the field still faces core challenges, including the inherent trade‐off between efficiency and dissymmetry factor, the unclear microscopic mechanism of chiral amplification, the weakness in NIR/deep‐blue regions, and the difficulty in transitioning from photoluminescence to electroluminescence, advances in intrinsic chiral efficiency, synergistic enhancement of long lifetime and high quantum yield, theoretical prediction, and high‐throughput screening methods are expected to drive CPRTP materials toward next‐generation optoelectronic devices and information security technologies.
items.tz: 近期在手性有机室温磷光及其圆偏振发光方面的进展
items.az:
具有室温圆偏振磷光特性的材料（CPRTP）结合了长寿命三重态发射和手性光学响应的双重优势，在信息加密、生物成像以及柔性光电领域展现出广阔的应用前景。
本文综述了从分子手性设计、聚集调控、性能调优及应用场景方面，有机CPRTP材料的最新进展。
手性光学活性通过共价修饰、超分子组装和液晶诱导实现。
聚集策略包括晶体工程和基质掺杂，能够增强发光非对称因子，同时提高发射效率。
新兴的CPRTP体系，包括近红外（NIR）发射体、动态调控的手性体系以及可编织纤维，已被用于生物成像和电控加密，研究正从基本性质研究转向实际应用。
尽管该领域仍面临核心挑战，包括效率与手性因子之间的固有权衡、手性放大作用的微观机制尚不明确、在近红外/深蓝色区域性能较弱，以及从光致发光向电致发光的转换困难，内在手性效率的提升、长寿命与高量子产率的协同增强、理论预测以及高通量筛选方法的进步有望推动CPRTP材料向下一代光电设备和信息安全技术发展。

items.t: GCMDiff: a condition-guided diffusion framework for pharmacophore-fragment drug discovery and target-specific molecular design
items.a: Drug discovery remains a costly and time-consuming process, motivating the development of artificial intelligence approaches to accelerate molecular design. Many generative models, including generative pre-trained transformers (GPT), rely on one-dimensional SMILES representations that lack explicit structural topology and are constrained by rigid syntax rules. Moreover, most existing models perform unconditional molecule generation, while the few conditional diffusion approaches often rely on abstract parameters rather than pharmacologically interpretable constraints. Consequently, current methods have limited ability to enforce explicit drug-like and pharmacophore requirements during molecular generation. Here, we propose GCMDiff, a multi-condition guided diffusion framework for molecular graph generation that supports controllable and interpretable molecular design. Unlike SMILES-based models, GCMDiff employs an atom-pair and bond-centric molecular graph representation that directly captures explicit chemical topologies. Crucially, we introduce an interpretable pharmacological condition embedding that integrates multi-modal constraints, including atom number, Lipinski’s Rule of Five constraints, and structural moieties derived from Checkmol, PubChem, and Rings in Drugs descriptors. These explicit features guide the diffusion process toward promising chemical spaces satisfying user-defined prerequisites. Benchmark experiments demonstrate that GCMDiff generates chemically valid and structurally diverse molecules, achieving 99.6% novelty and 100% uniqueness while maintaining atom and bond distributions consistent with drug-like chemical space. As a practical application, GCMDiff was applied to epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) inhibitor design, where generated candidates reproduced key binding interactions, including the conserved hydrogen bond between a quinazoline scaffold and residue Met793. These results demonstrate that GCMDiff provides a flexible and interpretable framework for pharmacophore-fragment-conditioned molecular generation, enabling controllable exploration of drug-like chemical space and facilitating early-stage rational drug discovery. Scientific contribution GCMDiff advances molecular design by employing a graph-based diffusion framework that bypasses SMILES-related syntax limitations. Its core innovation is a multi-modal condition encoder integrating drug-like properties and pharmacophores, enabling interpretable, pharmacophore-fragment-conditioned molecular generation. The model achieves 99.6% novelty and 100% uniqueness while demonstrating practical utility through the design of novel EGFR inhibitors that replicate essential Met793 binding interactions. This framework effectively bridges generative AI with rational, constraint-driven lead optimization.
items.tz: GCMDiff：一种基于条件引导的扩散框架，用于药效团-片段药物发现和靶向特异性的分子设计
items.az:
药物发现仍是一个成本高昂且耗时的过程，推动了人工智能方法的发展以加速分子设计。
许多生成模型，包括生成式预训练变换器（GPT），依赖于一维的SMILES表示形式，这些表示形式缺乏明确的结构拓扑，并受到严格的语法规则限制。
此外，大多数现有模型执行无条件的分子生成，而少数条件扩散方法往往依赖于抽象参数，而非药理学可解释的约束。
因此，当前方法在分子生成过程中强制实施药物样和药效团要求的能力有限。
在这里，我们提出了GCMDiff，一种支持可控和可解释分子图生成的多条件引导扩散框架。
不同于基于SMILES的模型，GCMDiff采用一种以原子对和键为中心的分子图表示方法，能够直接捕捉明确的化学拓扑结构。
至关重要的是，我们引入了一种可解释的药理学条件嵌入，整合了多种模态约束，包括原子数量、Lipinski五规则约束以及来自Checkmol、PubChem和Rings in Drugs描述符的结构基团。
这些显式特征引导扩散过程朝着满足用户定义前提的有前景的化学空间发展。
基准实验表明，GCMDiff生成的分子在化学上有效且结构多样，实现了99.6%的新颖性与100%的独特性，同时保持了原子和键分布与药物类化学空间的一致性。
作为一项实际应用，GCMDiff被应用于表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）抑制剂的设计中，其中生成的候选分子重现了关键的结合相互作用，包括喹唑啉骨架与残基Met793之间的保守氢键。
这些结果表明，GCMDiff为基于药效团-片段条件的分子生成提供了一个灵活且可解释的框架，能够实现对类药物化学空间的可控探索，并促进早期阶段的理性药物发现。
科学贡献 GCMDiff 通过采用基于图的扩散框架，绕过了 SMILES 相关的语法限制，推动了分子设计的发展。
其核心创新是一个多模态条件编码器，整合了药物样性质和药效团，实现了可解释的、基于药效团-片段的分子生成。
该模型实现了99.6%的新颖性与100%的唯一性，通过设计能够复制关键Met793结合相互作用的新型EGFR抑制剂，展示了实际应用价值。
该框架有效将生成式人工智能与基于约束的理性先导化合物优化相结合。

items.t: Decoding Hierarchical Crystal Packing in Phenprocoumon and Related 4-Hydroxycoumarins
items.a: Polymorphism in flexible molecular systems arises from the interplay between molecular conformation, strong intermolecular interactions, and crystal packing. Here, a combined experimental and computational study of RS-phenprocoumon, encompassing multiple newly characterized solid forms, reveals a hierarchical organization of its crystal structures in which a conserved heterochiral dimer acts as a persistent supramolecular construct, while structural diversity emerges at successive higher levels. At the one-dimensional level, the orientation of the enolic OH group governs hydrogen-bond propagation symmetry and consequently the chirality of the resulting β-chains. At the two-dimensional level, alternative relative arrangements of equivalent β-chains generate the distinct packing organizations observed experimentally. Crystal structure prediction (CSP) identifies all experimentally observed polymorphs as low-energy structures on the landscape, which is populated by a remarkably limited set of recurrent conformational and packing symmetry combinations. Comparison with related 4-hydroxycoumarin derivatives in the Cambridge Structural Database shows that the same hierarchical structural relationships extend beyond RS-phenprocoumon and consistently describe crystal packing across the scaffold. Together, these results suggest that the crystal energy landscape of RS-phenprocoumon can provide useful insights into the solid-state behavior of structurally related compounds, providing a framework for understanding packing preferences across the 3-substituted 4-hydroxycoumarin scaffold.
items.tz: 解码吩丙酮及相关4-羟基香豆素的分层晶体堆积
items.az:
柔性分子体系中的多晶型现象源于分子构象、强分子间相互作用和晶体堆积之间的相互作用。
在此，对RS-吩丙酮的联合实验与计算研究，涵盖了多种新表征的固态形式，揭示了其晶体结构呈现出分层组织特征，其中一种保守的异手性二聚体作为持久的超分子结构单元存在，而结构多样性则在更高层次上逐步显现。
在一维水平上，烯醇OH基团的取向决定了氢键传播的对称性，从而决定了所形成的β链的手性。
在二维层面，等效的β链的交替相对排列产生了实验中观察到的 distinct 包装结构。
晶体结构预测（CSP）识别出所有实验观测到的晶型作为能景中低能量结构，这些结构由一组 remarkably 有限的重复构象和堆积对称性组合所填充。
与剑桥结构数据库中相关4-羟基香豆素衍生物的比较表明，相同的层次结构关系不仅适用于RS-苯丙香豆素，而且一致地描述了该骨架的晶体堆积。
这些结果共同表明，RS-吩丙嗪的晶体能景可以为结构相关化合物的固态行为提供有用的见解，为理解3-取代4-羟基香豆素骨架的堆积偏好提供框架。

items.t: Accuracy, Reliability, and Efficiency of a MACE Machine-Learning Interatomic Potential for Aspirin: A Reproducible Benchmark for Molecular Simulation
items.a: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) can reproduce density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces at a small fraction of the computational cost, yet an average benchmark error is an incomplete measure of their reliability in molecular simulation. This study presents a reproducible workflow that assesses prediction accuracy, error heterogeneity, and dynamical stability together, using aspirin (C9H8O4), a widely used pharmaceutical compound, as an initial molecular benchmark en route to metal-containing systems. A MACE equivariant graph neural network potential is trained on the MD17 dataset and deployed for molecular dynamics through the Atomic Simulation Environment (ASE). Across 210 762 held-out configurations the potential attains a force root-mean-square error of 15.30 meV Å−1, within the published MACE benchmark range, with a validation-to-test generalization gap of 7.6%. Force error correlates positively with configuration energy (Pearson r = 0.51), the carboxyl carbon emerges as the least reliable atomic site, and 90% of force predictions lie within 23.5 meV Å−1 of the DFT reference. Microcanonical simulations conserve total energy and canonical trajectories remain stable, while single-configuration evaluation is approximately four orders of magnitude (a roughly ten-thousand-fold) faster than the corresponding DFT calculation. By combining aggregate accuracy with configuration-and atom-resolved error analysis and explicit dynamical tests, the workflow exposes behavior that a single error metric conceals. The resulting aspirin benchmark establishes a documented baseline for subsequent validation on metal-containing systems and illustrates the value of assessing error distributions and dynamical behavior alongside mean prediction accuracy.
items.tz: 阿司匹林的MACE机器学习原子势的准确性、可靠性与效率：分子模拟的可重复基准
items.az:
机器学习原子势（MLIPs）可以在极小的计算成本下重现密度泛函理论（DFT）的能量和力，然而平均基准误差并不能完全反映其在分子模拟中的可靠性。
本研究提出了一种可重复的工作流程，通过使用广泛使用的药物化合物阿司匹林（C9H8O4）作为初始分子基准，同时评估预测准确性、误差异质性以及动力学稳定性，以推进至含金属体系的研究。
一种MACE等变图神经网络势函数在MD17数据集上进行训练，并通过原子模拟环境（ASE）用于分子动力学模拟。
在210762个保留的构型上，势函数的力均方根误差为15.30 meV Å⁻¹，处于已发表的MACE基准范围之内，验证集到测试集的泛化差距为7.6%。
力误差与构型能呈正相关（Pearson r = 0.51），羧基碳原子是可靠性最差的原子位点，90%的力预测值位于DFT参考值的23.5 meV Å⁻¹范围内。
微正则模拟保持总能量不变且正则轨迹保持稳定，而单构型评估的速度大约比相应的密度泛函理论计算快四个数量级（约十万倍）。
通过结合整体准确性与构型及原子级误差分析以及明确的动力学测试，该工作流程揭示了单一误差指标所掩盖的行为。
所得的阿司匹林基准为后续在含金属体系中的验证建立了可记录的基线，并展示了在平均预测准确性之外评估误差分布和动力学行为的价值。

items.t: AtomSteer: Test-Time Constraint Steering for Atomistic Generative Models
items.a: Diffusion and flow matching models offer scalable approaches to generating crystalline materials, molecular conformers, and protein-ligand complexes. However, satisfying crystallographic symmetry, structural geometry, and accurate stereochemistry remains challenging. Satisfying these requirements calls for corrections that preserve the geometry already captured by the pretrained model. In this work, we propose AtomSteer, a test-time inference framework for steering pretrained atomistic generative models with structural constraints. During sampling, AtomSteer corrects intermediate structure predictions with bounded local projections, graph-rigid stereochemical transformations, and projections over periodic symmetries, accepting updates that improve constraint satisfaction while limiting changes to the rest of the structure. We demonstrate AtomSteer across three pretrained backbones, FlowMM, ET-Flow, and Boltz-2, spanning de novo crystal generation and crystal structure prediction, molecular conformer generation, and protein-ligand complex structure prediction. AtomSteer improves space-group distribution coverage in de novo crystal generation and improves target space-group recovery in crystal structure prediction. AtomSteer improves molecular validity and E/Z stereochemical accuracy while retaining conformer ensemble fidelity. For protein-ligand complexes, AtomSteer reduces ligand E/Z errors relative to experimental reference structures while achieving competitive docking success and PoseBusters validity. Our method provides a unified framework for adding chemical and crystallographic control to existing atomistic generative models without retraining or architectural changes.
items.tz: AtomSteer：用于原子级生成模型的测试时约束引导
items.az:
扩散和流匹配模型为生成晶体材料、分子构象以及蛋白质-配体复合物提供了可扩展的方法。
然而，满足晶体学对称性、结构几何形状以及准确的立体化学仍具有挑战性。
满足这些要求需要进行修正，以保留预训练模型已捕获的几何结构。
在本工作中，我们提出了AtomSteer，一种在测试时推理框架，用于通过结构约束引导预训练的原子级生成模型。
在采样过程中，AtomSteer 通过有界的局部投影、图刚性立体化学变换以及周期对称性的投影来修正中间结构预测，接受那些能够改善约束满足且限制结构其余部分变化的更新。
我们展示了AtomSteer在三个预训练主干网络（FlowMM、ET-Flow和Boltz-2）上的应用，涵盖从头晶体生成和晶体结构预测、分子构象生成以及蛋白质-配体复合物结构预测。
AtomSteer 提高了从头晶体生成中空间群分布的覆盖范围，并提升了晶体结构预测中的目标空间群恢复能力。
AtomSteer 在保持构象集合保真度的同时，提升了分子有效性和 E/Z 构型的准确性。
对于蛋白质-配体复合物，AtomSteer 在相对于实验参考结构的情况下降低了配体的E/Z错误，同时实现了有竞争力的对接成功率和PoseBusters的有效性。
我们的方法为在不重新训练或改变架构的前提下，向现有的原子级生成模型中添加化学和晶体学控制提供了一个统一框架。

items.t: Logical Guidance of Stochastic Interpolants
items.a: Guidance and composition of generative models have applications in visual design, chemistry, and biology. Logical guidance composes conditional scores exactly for diffusion models. However, Flow Matching (FM) and Stochastic Interpolants (SI) learn velocity fields. We show that negation and exclusive disjunction admit exact conditional velocity composition on any interpolant, whereas conjunction, and therefore any formula containing one, is exact on Gaussian paths but in general incurs a drift-interaction error, so composed velocities need not sample the logical target. LOGSI solves this by using score-based re-equilibration as our principled mechanism and falling back to the Gaussian-path velocity rule as an approximate transport predictor. In non-Gaussian bridge problems, generation alternates transport steps with score re-equilibration steps. On image trans fer (EMNIST to CMNIST, CelebA) and QM9 source-to-target molecular editing with logical attribute constraints, LOGSI improves rule conformity at the same network-evaluation budget over composed-velocity baselines, while also improving fidelity on the image tasks. More broadly, LOGSI applies wherever stochastic interpolants need guidance and logical combinations of constraints are natural.
items.tz: 随机插值的逻辑引导
items.az:
生成模型的引导和组成在视觉设计、化学和生物学中具有应用。
逻辑引导为扩散模型精确构造条件分数。
然而，流匹配（Flow Matching, FM）和随机插值（Stochastic Interpolants, SI）学习速度场。
我们证明，否定和排中析取在任意插值路径上都具有精确的条件速度合成，而合取则在高斯路径上是精确的，但一般情况下会引入漂移相互作用误差，因此合成后的速度无需采样逻辑目标。
LOGSI 通过使用基于分数的重新平衡作为我们的原则性机制，并在需要时回退到高斯路径速度规则作为近似的传输预测器。
在非高斯桥问题中，生成过程交替进行传输步骤与分数重平衡步骤。
在图像迁移（EMNIST到CMNIST、CelebA）以及QM9源到目标分子编辑中，引入逻辑属性约束的LOGSI在相同网络评估预算下，相较于组合速度基线方法提升了规则符合度，同时在图像任务上也提高了保真度。
更广泛地说，LOGSI适用于任何需要随机插值引导且逻辑组合约束自然存在的场景。

items.t: Field‐Driven Proton Transport in Water Revealed by Machine Learning Molecular Dynamics
items.a: Excess-proton transport in water arises from the coupling of proton transfer (PT), hydrogen-bond rearrangement, and solvent polarization. While equilibrium Grotthuss diffusion has been widely studied, its response under strong electric fields remains difficult to resolve because simulations must capture both chemical reactivity and induced polarization over long time scales. Here, we have developed a reactive and polarizable machine-learning interatomic potential for molecular dynamics simulations of the hydrated excess proton in water. A fine-tuned PiNet2 model provides an accurate zero-field reference for structure and diffusion, while an AD(OS)-based finite-field coupling enables non-equilibrium simulations under an applied electric field. In the linear-response regime, below 0.04 V/Å, the proton mobility obtained from drift velocity agrees closely with the equilibrium diffusion coefficient. The proton drift velocity remains nearly linear with field strength up to 0.15 V/Å, a field strength at which the ionic mobility of a constrained hydronium ion decreases. Our simulations revealed a distinct field-response of protonated water, whose hydrogen-bond network largely preserves its structural fluctuations and mobility without a comparable dielectric-saturation signature. Furthermore, free-energy analysis shows that strong fields stabilize the hydronium species with four-fold H-bond coordination.
items.tz: 机器学习分子动力学揭示了水中的场驱动质子传输
items.az:
水中过量质子传输源于质子转移（PT）、氢键重排和溶剂极化的耦合。
尽管平衡Grotthuss扩散已被广泛研究，但在强电场下的响应仍难以解析，因为模拟必须在长时间尺度上同时捕捉化学反应性和诱导极化。
在这里，我们为水分子动力学模拟水合过量质子开发了一种具有反应性和极化能力的机器学习原子间势函数。
一个经过微调的PiNet2模型为结构和扩散提供了准确的零场参考，而基于AD(OS)的有限场耦合则能够在施加电场下实现非平衡模拟。
在线性响应区域，低于0.04 V/Å时，从漂移速度获得的质子迁移率与平衡扩散系数高度一致。
质子漂移速度在场强达到0.15 V/Å之前几乎与场强呈线性关系，此时受限的质子离子的离子迁移率下降。
我们的模拟揭示了质子化水具有明显的场响应，其氢键网络在很大程度上保留了结构波动和迁移性，而没有出现可比的介电饱和特征。
此外，自由能分析表明强场稳定了具有四重氢键配位的质子物种。

items.t: The role of solid-melt interfaces in self-catalyzed growth kinetics of III-nitride semiconductors
items.a: Solid-melt interfaces govern metal-mediated epitaxy of gallium nitride (GaN) and related III-nitride semiconductors, yet a quantitative connection between interfacial structure and growth kinetics has remained elusive. Using atomistic simulations based on machine-learning interatomic potentials, we show that crystal orientation determines the local atomic arrangement and electrostatic character at the interface, inducing facet-dependent ordering in the adjacent melt. This ordering reshapes the N-transport free-energy landscape, substantially lowering migration barriers relative to pristine surfaces. Kinetic Monte Carlo simulations reveal that under realistic Ga-mediated molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) conditions, GaN grows in a diffusion-controlled, layer-by-layer regime, where the interface-normal adsorption free-energy landscape sets the dominant kinetic resistance. Combining facet-specific free-energy profiles with N diffusivity and solubility in liquid Ga, we develop a fitting-free model predicting growth rates of 0.01–0.04 nm/s, consistent with MBE-grown GaN nanoparticles. Similar ordering in other III-nitride systems indicates a generalizable route from atomistic energetics to anisotropic crystal growth kinetics.
items.tz: III-氮化物半导体自催化生长动力学中固-液界面的作用
items.az:
固-液界面调控氮化镓（GaN）及相关III-氮化物半导体的金属介导层状生长，然而界面结构与生长动力学之间的定量关联仍不清楚。
基于机器学习原子势的原子级模拟表明，晶体取向决定了界面处的局部原子排列和静电特性，从而在相邻熔体中诱导出facet依赖的有序结构。
这种有序排列重塑了N传输的自由能景观，显著降低了与原始表面相比的迁移势垒。
动力学蒙特卡洛模拟表明，在现实的Ga介导分子束外延（MBE）条件下，GaN以扩散控制的逐层生长模式进行生长，其中界面法向吸附自由能景观决定了主要的动能阻力。
结合面向晶面的自由能曲线、N在液态Ga中的扩散性和溶解度，我们构建了一个无需拟合的模型，可预测生长速率在0.01–0.04 nm/s之间，与MBE生长的GaN纳米颗粒的实验结果一致。
其他III-氮化物体系中的相似有序性表明，从原子级能学到各向异性晶体生长动力学存在一种可推广的途径。

items.t: Fine-Tuning Universal Machine Learning Potentials Enables Efficient Computation of Li Electrode Potentials in Battery Electrolytes
items.a: The electrode potential of Li metal is fundamental to the performance and stability of Li-metal batteries, yet its accurate prediction across diverse electrolyte chemistries remains a challenge. Standard quantum chemistry using cluster models fails to account for explicit bulk solvation, while ab initio molecular dynamics is restricted by the high computational cost of thermodynamic sampling. In this work, we present an integrated framework that combines a universal machine learning potential for electrolytes with a data-efficient fine-tuning strategy to compute Li electrode potentials. This workflow achieves ab initio level accuracy using ∼200 extra density functional theory calculations per electrolyte system. Furthermore, the identified relationship between local Li+ solvation environments and electrode potential shifts provides mechanistic insights into electrolyte-dependent redox behavior and offers guidance for rational electrolyte design.
items.v: Journal of the American Chemical Society
items.tz: 通过微调通用机器学习势能实现了电池电解质中锂电极电位的高效计算
items.az:
锂金属的电极电位对锂金属电池的性能和稳定性至关重要，然而在其多种电解质化学体系中的准确预测仍是一项挑战。
使用簇模型的标准量子化学未能考虑显式的体相溶剂化，而基于第一性原理的分子动力学因热力学采样计算成本过高而受到限制。
在本工作中，我们提出了一种集成框架，该框架结合了适用于电解质的通用机器学习势能和一种数据高效的微调策略，用于计算锂电极电位。
该工作流程通过每个电解质体系约200次密度泛函理论计算，实现了从头算级别的精度。
此外，所识别的局部Li+溶剂化环境与电极电位变化之间的关系为电解质依赖的氧化还原行为提供了机制性见解，并为合理设计电解质提供了指导。

items.t: Computational data for: "Thermal Activation under Electrochemical Conditions: CO and N2 Bond Dissociation on Co (B5)"
items.a: This dataset contains two Jupyter notebooks and the associated computational data, in the compressed file, used to analyse and visualise results from DFT and OPES_meta simulations of CO and N2 dissociation on cobalt surface. In this work, we quantify these dissociation path at a Co(B5) step site using density functional theory, implicit-solvent calculations, and explicit-solvent enhanced sampling with a machine-learned interatomic potential (MLIP). The notebooks generate plots related to CO and N2 dissociation energetics, solvent and cation effects, free-energy surfaces, minimum-energy paths, and validation of machine-learning interatomic potential predictions against DFT reference data. `DFT.ipynb` analyzes DFT-derived energy data, including solvent-dependent barrier trends and implicit-solvent parameter maps. `MTD.ipynb` analyzes OPES_meta/metadynamics free-energy data, minimum-energy paths, solvent/cation effects, and MACE-vs-DFT validation plots. `DFT.ipynb` and `MTD.ipynb` - © Copyright 2026 Technical University of Denmark, licensed under BSD-3-Clause. Associated compressed file 'Data.tar' and `README.txt` - licensed under CC BY 4.0.
items.tz: “电化学条件下的热激活：Co (B5) 上CO和N2键解离的计算数据”
items.az:
该数据集包含两个Jupyter笔记本和相关的计算数据，存储在压缩文件中，用于分析和可视化钴表面CO和N2解离的DFT和OPES_meta模拟结果。
在本工作中，我们利用密度泛函理论、隐溶剂计算以及结合机器学习原子势（MLIP）的显溶剂增强采样方法，对Co(B5)步位处的解离路径进行了定量分析。
笔记本生成了与CO和N2解离能、溶剂及阳离子效应、自由能面、最低能量路径以及机器学习原子间势预测与DFT参考数据对比验证相关的图表。
DFT.ipynb 分析了源自密度泛函理论的能数据，包括溶剂依赖的势垒趋势和隐式溶剂参数映射。
MTD.ipynb 分析 OPES_meta/元动力学自由能数据、最低能量路径、溶剂/阳离子效应以及 MACE-vs-DFT 验证图。

items.t: A coordination-ligand reorientation mechanism for ferroelectricity in Mn(II) hybrid complex and its utility for memory application
items.a: Moving beyond classical models of collective ion reorientation, we present a ligand-tilting design for molecular ferroelectrics. Using the asymmetric isothiocyanate (NCS⁻) ligand as a dynamic “molecular hinge,” we achieve facile polarization switching through geometric distortion and coordination-ligand flipping in the hybrid complex [Ph3PEt]3[Mn(NCS)5]. In this framework, the asymmetric cation stabilizes a polar phase in the triclinic P1 space group and a rare distorted trigonal-bipyramidal Mn(II) center, directed by the tilt of the coordinated NCS⁻ ligand, enabling room-temperature ferroelectricity with saturation polarization (Pₛ) of 1.57 µC·cm−2. Density functional theory (DFT) confirms that ligand-flipping modes are a key switching mechanism with a low barrier to polarization reversal. Piezoresponse force microscopy (PFM) provides visual validation of domain reversals via box-in-box lithography and single-point switching spectroscopy. Incorporation of [Ph3PEt]3[Mn(NCS)5] into ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) yields a memory window (60 V) and an ON/OFF ratio (>104), with electrically controlled transitions between volatile and non-volatile states. The devices emulate synaptic functions, including long-term potentiation/depression (LTP/LTD) and multilevel conductance states (with 64 levels), demonstrating neuromorphic capabilities. Control experiments distinguish polarization-driven switching from charge trapping as the origin of the memtransistor response. Coordinate-ligand dynamics thus emerge as a design principle for molecular ferroelectrics, enabling memory and brain-inspired computing. Addressing the limitations of classical models in molecular ferroelectrics, the authors introduce a ligand-tilting design using asymmetric isothiocyanate ligands. This approach enables room-temperature ferroelectricity and neuromorphic capabilities in devices, with implications for memory and brain-inspired computing, as demonstrated by their integration into ferroelectric field-effect transistors.
items.tz: Mn(II)杂化复合物中铁电性的配体-配位重定向机制及其在存储应用中的实用性
items.az:
超越经典集体离子重取向模型，我们提出了一种配体倾斜设计用于分子铁电体。
使用不对称的异硫氰酸盐（NCS⁻）配体作为动态“分子铰链”，我们通过杂化配合物[Ph3PEt]3[Mn(NCS)5]中的几何畸变和配位-配体翻转实现了便捷的极性切换。
在此框架中，不对称阳离子稳定了三斜P1空间群中的极性相以及一个罕见的畸变的三角双锥形Mn(II)中心，该中心由配位NCS⁻配体的倾斜方向决定，实现了室温铁电性，饱和极化强度（Pₛ）为1.57 µC·cm−2。
密度泛函理论（DFT）证实，配体翻转模式是关键的开关机制，其极化反转具有低能垒。
压电响应力显微镜（PFM）通过盒内盒光刻和单点开关光谱学提供了域反转的视觉验证。
将[Ph3PEt]3[Mn(NCS)5]引入铁电场效应晶体管（FeFETs）中，可获得一个记忆窗口（60 V）和一个开/关比（>104），并实现挥发态与非挥发态之间的电控转变。
这些器件模拟了突触功能，包括长期增强/抑制（LTP/LTD）和多级导电状态（64级），展示了神经形态能力。
对照实验将极化驱动的开关效应与电荷捕获作为忆阻器响应的起源区分开来。
坐标-配体动力学因此成为分子铁电体的设计原则，能够实现存储和类脑计算。
针对分子铁电体中经典模型的局限性，作者引入了一种使用不对称异硫氰酸酯配体的配体倾斜设计。
该方法使器件在室温下表现出铁电性和类神经计算能力，其在存储和类脑计算中的应用已通过将其集成到铁电场效应晶体管中得到验证。

items.t: TACFormer: Transformer-Based Generative Model for Target-Conditioned De Novo PROTAC Design
items.a: Targeted protein degradation (TPD) represents a fundamental shift in drug discovery, moving beyond traditional target inhibition toward the event-driven removal of disease-causing proteins. A prominent strategy for TPD is the use of proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs), heterobifunctional molecules that selectively route a protein of interest (POI) to the ubiquitin-proteasome system for degradation. While PROTAC design still relies heavily on trial-and-error synthesis and experimental testing, deep generative models offer a promising means to explore PROTAC chemical space in silico and generate novel molecules. However, many existing generative methods formulate PROTAC design primarily as a linker-generation problem, with POI-binding (warhead) and E3-ligase-binding components fixed in advance. This restricts exploration of the full PROTAC chemical space and often leaves the POI implicit through the predefined warhead, rather than using protein-level information as an explicit conditioning signal during generation. To address these limitations, we propose TACFormer: a transformer-based generative model for target-aware de novo PROTAC design. The model conditions a GPT-style molecular decoder on pretrained ESM-2 representations of POI sequences, allowing POI-level information to steer full-molecule generation. Our results show that TACFormer generates highly novel and chemically diverse PROTACs while showing consistent POI-dependent shifts in generated chemical space. In particular, molecules generated under specific target conditions preferentially populate chemical neighborhoods associated with POIs in the held-out dataset, while extrapolating to novel chemotypes. By natively integrating biological context into the generative process, TACFormer moves PROTAC design toward a more biology-informed exploration of degrader chemical space.
items.tz: TACFormer：基于Transformer的生成模型用于目标条件下的从头PROTAC设计
items.az:
靶向蛋白降解（TPD）代表了药物发现领域的一次根本性转变，从传统的靶点抑制转向事件驱动的致病蛋白去除。
TPD的一个重要策略是使用蛋白水解靶向嵌合体（PROTACs），即一种双功能分子，能够选择性地将目标蛋白（POI）导向泛素-蛋白酶体系统以实现降解。
尽管PROTAC的设计仍然严重依赖于试错合成和实验测试，深度生成模型为在计算机上探索PROTAC的化学空间并生成新型分子提供了有前景的途径。
然而，许多现有的生成方法将PROTAC设计主要视为一个连接子生成问题，其中POI结合（战头）和E3泛素连接酶结合组分预先固定。
这限制了对PROTAC化学空间的全面探索，且通常通过预定义的战头隐含地确定POI，而非在生成过程中利用蛋白质层面的信息作为显式的条件信号。
为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了TACFormer：一种基于变换器的生成模型，用于目标感知的从头PROTAC设计。
该模型将一种类似GPT的分子解码器条件化于POI序列的预训练ESM-2表示上，使得POI级别的信息能够引导整个分子的生成。
我们的结果表明，TACFormer生成了高度新颖且化学多样性的PROTACs，同时在生成的化学空间中表现出一致的POI依赖性偏移。
特别是，在特定目标条件下生成的分子更倾向于聚集在保留数据集中的POI相关化学邻域中，同时外推至新型化学结构。
通过原生地将生物背景融入生成过程，TACFormer推动了PROTAC设计朝着更加基于生物学的降解剂化学空间探索方向发展。
items.tw: 预印本或来源不明；作者不在关注名单

items.t: Atomic-scale simulation of a bismuth liquid-metal ion source using a universal machine-learning interatomic potential
items.a: Liquid-metal ion sources (LMISs) are central to focused-ion-beam technology, yet a predictive atomic-scale model has been prevented by the absence of transferable interatomic potentials for the emitter metals. Here, we show that the universal machine-learning interatomic potential MACE-MP-0, applied without any bismuth-specific fine-tuning, delivers a parameter-free atomic-scale description of a bismuth LMIS. Molecular-dynamics simulations reproduce, within experimental uncertainty, the liquid-Bi pair distribution function (first peak at 3.275 Å, 0.2% from neutron/x-ray experiment, with the full first- and second-shell profile recovered) and the self-diffusion coefficient (1.88 × 10−9 m2 s−1, +8% against first-principles molecular dynamics, bracketed by a Stokes–Einstein estimate), and give a sharp field-evaporation threshold at 6.0 V Å−1. The threshold exceeds the tabulated evaporation field of bismuth by a factor of about three, the same ratio reported for bond-breaking molecular dynamics of Cu, Ni, and W, so the model reproduces a known open discrepancy of this class of simulation rather than escaping it. A 3363-atom nanotip exhibits a sharp stable-to-unstable emission transition whose 18-fold rate jump follows the field-induced collapse of the evaporation barrier; the corresponding emission currents (0.9–112 μA) match the operating range of real Bi-LMIS. Above the threshold, the evaporation rate is linear in field (R2 = 0.9998 over 8–20 V Å−1) rather than exponential, and the seed-to-seed scatter falls from 21% at the threshold to below 1% above it, marking the transition from thermally activated to barrierless, supply-limited emission. The simulated time-of-flight mass spectrum is Bi+-dominated, consistent with a post-field-ionization charge-state analysis, while the underestimated Bi3+ yield is attributed to gas-phase aromatic stabilization outside the neutral model. The results establish foundation potentials as a transferable, physically faithful, and low-cost route to modeling high-field metal emission.
items.tz: 使用通用机器学习原子势对铋液态金属离子源进行原子尺度模拟
items.az:
液态金属离子源（LMISs）是聚焦离子束技术的核心，然而由于发射金属缺乏可转移的原子间势能，尚未建立具有预测性的原子尺度模型。
在这里，我们表明，将通用机器学习原子间势能 MACE-MP-0 应用于铋基 LMIS 时，无需任何铋特异性的微调，即可实现无参数的原子尺度描述。
分子动力学模拟在实验不确定度范围内重现了液态Bi的配位函数（第一峰位于3.275 Å，与中子/X射线实验结果相差0.2%，且完整恢复了第一和第二壳层轮廓）以及自扩散系数（1.88 × 10⁻⁹ m² s⁻¹，比第一性原理分子动力学结果高+8%，介于斯托克斯-爱因斯坦估算值之间），并给出了一个清晰的场蒸发阈值6.0 V Å⁻¹。
阈值比铋的表列蒸发场高约三个数量级，这一比例与Cu、Ni和W的键断裂分子动力学中报道的比例相同，因此该模型重现了此类模拟中的一个已知开放性矛盾，而非回避这一矛盾。
一个含3363个原子的纳米尖端表现出从稳定到不稳定发射状态的锐利转变，其18倍速率跃迁遵循场诱导蒸发势垒的坍塌；相应的发射电流（0.9–112 μA）与实际Bi-LMIS的工作范围相匹配。
阈值以上，蒸发速率与场强呈线性关系（在8–20 V Å⁻¹范围内R² = 0.9998），而非指数关系，且种子到种子的散射从阈值处的21%降至其上的1%以下，标志着从热激活态过渡到无能垒、由供应限制决定的发射。
模拟的飞行时间质谱以 Bi+ 为主导，与场离子化电荷态分析结果一致，而 Bi3+ 产量的低估归因于中性模型外气相芳香稳定作用。
结果证实，基础势是一种可转移、物理上忠实且成本低廉的高场金属发射建模途径。

items.t: Transfer learning on universal interatomic potential embeddings improves generalization in structure-property defect models
items.a: Oxygen vacancy formation energies govern the performance of metal oxides across energy conversion, catalysis, and electronics, yet predicting them accurately without density functional theory calculations for novel chemical systems remains challenging. Here, we show that frozen 256-dimensional embeddings extracted from a pretrained MACE universal machine-learning interatomic potential encode information sufficient to predict vacancy formation energies obtained from density functional theory without requiring supercell construction, vacancy creation, or geometry optimization. A lightweight multilayer perceptron trained on these embeddings (MACE-dGNN) achieves an element-wise cross-validation mean absolute error of 0.38 eV, halving the error of a baseline graph neural network trained from scratch (0.72 eV) and offering a modest advantage over direct MACE relaxation calculations (0.51 eV). Because the embedding approach decouples representation from the prediction task and generalizes well with limited data, it will (1) extend naturally to fine-tuning and prediction of properties (e.g., charged defects) that are inaccessible to generic energy-and force-output interatomic potentials and (2) be trainable on necessarily small datasets, potentially enabling the use of more expensive but accurate tools for generating training data (e.g., hybrid functional calculations) for which training or fine-tuning of interatomic potentials will be difficult. We demonstrate practical impact by revisiting a prior screening of thermochemical water-splitting materials, where improved generalization alters ∼45 % of candidate classifications.
items.tz: 基于通用原子间势嵌入的迁移学习提升了结构-性质缺陷模型的泛化能力
items.az:
氧空位形成能调控金属氧化物在能量转换、催化和电子学中的性能，然而对于新型化学体系，准确预测氧空位形成能仍缺乏密度泛函理论计算。
在这里，我们表明从预训练的MACE通用机器学习原子势中提取的256维冻结嵌入编码了足以在无需构建超胞、创建空位或进行几何优化的情况下，预测密度泛函理论所得空位形成能的信息。
一种基于这些嵌入的轻量级多层感知机（MACE-dGNN）在元素级交叉验证中的平均绝对误差为0.38 eV，将从头训练的基线图神经网络的误差（0.72 eV）减半，并在与直接MACE松弛计算（0.51 eV）相比时具有微小优势。
因为嵌入方法将表示与预测任务解耦，并且在数据有限的情况下具有良好的泛化能力，因此它（1）可以自然地扩展到细调和预测那些无法被通用的能量-力输出原子间势函数访问的性质（例如带电缺陷）；（2）可以在数据集必然较小的情况下进行训练， potentially enabling the use of more expensive but accurate tools for generating training data (e.g., hybrid functional calculations) for which training or fine-tuning of interatomic potentials will be difficult.
我们通过重新审视先前的热化学水分解材料筛选工作，展示了实际影响，其中泛化能力的提升改变了约45%的候选材料分类。

items.t: Free-Energy Landscapes of Clathrate Hydrate Polymorphism
items.a: Clathrate hydrates exhibit polymorphism among distinct hydrogen-bonded water-framework topologies, yet the structure observed during formation or transformation need not be the thermodynamically stable polymorph. A structure-resolved free-energy framework is developed to distinguish stable single-polymorph states, equilibrium coexistence of compositionally distinct polymorphs, and kinetically retained metastable structures. Guest-induced cage stabilization is combined with the reference free energy of each water framework, while closed multicomponent systems are evaluated through a global convex-envelope construction. Cyclopropane provides a positive benchmark for temperature-driven sI−sII polymorphism, with the calculated lower coexistence pressure differing from the experimental four-phase value by 0.68%. Methane−ethane exhibits composition-driven re-entrant sI−sII−sI polymorphism; canonical reconstruction reveals strong structural−compositional partitioning, with the lower transition showing a polymorph-separation driving force approximately nine times larger than the upper transition. In methane−propane, experimentally retained sI states remain strongly on the sII-favored side of the calculated free-energy landscape, supporting kinetic polymorph selection rather than equilibrium coexistence. The resulting framework provides a thermodynamic reference for interpreting polymorph selection, coexistence, guest partitioning, and structural memory during clathrate crystallization.
items.tz: 笼形水合物多型的自由能景观
items.az:
笼目水合物在不同的氢键水骨架拓扑结构之间表现出多态性，然而在形成或转变过程中观察到的结构未必是热力学稳定的多晶型体。
建立了一种基于结构的自由能框架，用于区分稳定的单晶型态、组分不同的晶型的平衡共存状态以及动力学保留的亚稳态结构。
客体诱导笼状稳定化与每个水框架的参考自由能相结合，而闭合多组分系统则通过全局凸包构造进行评估。
环丙烷为温度驱动的sI−sII多态性提供了正向基准，计算得到的共存压低于实验四相值0.68%。
甲烷−乙烷表现出由组分驱动的重新进入型 sI−sII−sI 多态性；典型重构揭示了强烈的结构−组分分离，其中较低转变所展现的多态分离驱动力约为上一转变的九倍。
在甲烷−丙烷体系中，实验保留的sI态仍明显位于计算自由能图谱中 favor sII 的一侧，支持动力学多晶型选择而非平衡共存。
所得框架为解释包合物结晶过程中多晶型选择、共存、客体分配以及结构记忆的热力学参考。

items.t: Limits of geometric packing descriptors in molecular crystal energy ranking
items.a: Simple packing descriptors do not consistently reproduce molecular crystal energy rankings across chemically distinct compounds. A retrospective benchmark of 98 deposited crystal structure prediction candidates from seven molecules was assembled from published relative r²SCAN-D3 electronic energies. Forty entries from four earlier systems were combined with 58 entries for indomethacin, nicotinamide and aspirin. Density, heavy-atom proximity, N–H···O/N geometry and planar-ring proximity were evaluated individually and through an equal-weight rank composite, without fitting feature weights. An implementation audit identified incomplete periodic-image enumeration affecting at least one descriptor in 23 structures. Recalculation with geometry-dependent complete image bounds changed 3.5 Å contact counts in 13 structures. On the three additional molecular systems, the corrected four-feature composite gave a macro-averaged Spearman correlation of 0.187, compared with 0.501 for density and −0.004 for 3.5 Å contacts. The composite improved on density for indomethacin but underperformed for nicotinamide and aspirin. Fifty-four of 813 within-molecule pairs had reference energy differences below 0.2 kJ mol⁻¹. This retrospective threshold does not provide calibrated predictive uncertainty or a prospective abstention rule. Metadata-verified energy joins, exact input hashes, representative invariance tests and reproducible numerical outputs accompany the analysis. The results document representation and implementation sensitivities and heterogeneous transfer between molecules. Neither superiority over established energy-ranking approaches nor prediction of experimental thermodynamic stability is demonstrated.
items.tz: 几何堆积描述符在分子晶体能级排序中的局限性
items.az:
简单的堆积描述符在化学结构不同的化合物中无法一致地重现分子晶体的能量排序。
一个包含七个分子的98个已发表晶体结构预测候选结构的回顾性基准，基于已发表的r²SCAN-D3电子能相对值构建。
来自四个早期体系的40个条目与针对吲哚美辛、烟酰胺和阿司匹林的58个条目相结合。
密度、重原子临近性、N–H···O/N 几何构型以及平面环临近性分别进行了评估，并通过等权重排名复合方法进行综合评估，未对特征权重进行拟合。
一项实现审计发现，不完整的周期性图像枚举影响了至少一个描述符的23种结构。
基于几何依赖的完整图像边界重新计算，使13种结构的3.5 Å接触数发生了变化。
在另外三个分子体系中，经过修正的四特征复合模型的宏观平均Spearman相关性为0.187，而密度的相关性为0.501，3.5 Å接触的相关性为−0.004。
该复合物在吲哚美辛的密度方面有所提升，但在烟酰胺和阿司匹林方面的表现则不佳。
813个分子内配对中，有54个的参考能差小于0.2 kJ mol⁻¹。
这个回顾性阈值并未提供校准的预测不确定性或前瞻性的回避规则。
元数据验证的能量连接、精确的输入哈希值、代表性不变性测试以及可重复的数值输出伴随分析。
结果记录了表示和实现的敏感性以及分子间的异质传递。
并未展示出优于现有能量排序方法的优越性，也未预测出实验热力学稳定性的结果。

items.t: A New High Pressure Polymorph of Na2[C2O5] Synthesized at 41 GPa
items.a: The inorganic pyrocarbonate Na2[C2O5] was synthesized at 41(3) GPa and 1000(300) K using a laser-heated diamond anvil cell. The compound was obtained by heating a mixture of Na2[CO3] and CO2 under high-pressure conditions. Its crystal structure was determined by single crystal synchrotron X-ray diffraction. This high pressure polymorph of Na2[C2O5] crystallizes in the space group Fdd2 with Z = 48 and an extremely anisotropic unit cell shape. The lattice parameters at 41(3) GPa are a = 50.466(7) Å, b = 23.681(6) Å, and c = 2.7212(4) Å, corresponding to a unit cell volume of 3252.1(10) Å3. The two [CO3]2−-groups which form the [C2O5]2−-groups are slightly tilted with respect to each other. Density functional theory based calculations confirmed the structure and supported the interpretation of the Raman spectra. Na2[C2O5]−Fdd2 is a high pressure polymorph of the previously reported Na2[C2O5]−P21.
items.tz: 在41 GPa下合成的Na₂[C₂O₅]的一种新高压多晶型
items.az:
无机吡罗碳酸盐 Na₂[C₂O₅] 采用激光加热金刚石压砧在 41(3) GPa 和 1000(300) K 条件下合成。
该化合物通过在高压条件下加热Na₂[CO₃]和CO₂的混合物获得。
其晶体结构通过单晶同步辐射X射线衍射确定。
该Na₂[C₂O₅]的高压多晶型在空间群Fdd2中结晶，Z = 48，且晶胞形状具有极强的各向异性。
在41(3) GPa下的晶格参数为 a = 50.466(7) Å，b = 23.681(6) Å，c = 2.7212(4) Å，对应的单位晶胞体积为 3252.1(10) Å³。
两个[CO3]2−基团形成的[C2O5]2−基团彼此略有倾斜。
基于密度泛函理论的计算证实了结构，并支持了拉曼光谱的解释。
Na₂[C₂O₅]−Fdd2 是 previously reported Na₂[C₂O₅]−P21 的高压多型体。

items.t: Direct simulation of LiNi₀.₈Mn₀.₁Co₀.₁O₂ transport properties using an efficient and accurate machine learning potential
items.a: The rate capability of layered lithium nickel manganese cobalt oxide (NMC) cathode materials is decisive for high-power applications such as fast charging, yet the mechanisms governing lithium-ion transport in NMC remain insufficiently understood, both experimentally and computationally. In this work, an efficient and accurate machine learning potential (MLP) was developed for LiNi₀.₈Mn₀.₁Co₀.₁O₂ (NMC811) to enable direct large-scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of lithium self-diffusion. The workflow uses a fine-tuned MACE (Message Passing Atomic Cluster Expansion) foundation model as a structure generator together with an active learning strategy applied to a near-ground-state dataset, which allows a reliable MLP to be constructed in a data-efficient manner from a limited number of density functional theory (DFT) reference calculations. MD simulations based on this potential preserve the accuracy of DFT while overcoming its time and length scale limitations, and were used to predict lithium diffusion coefficients in NMC811. This record contains the DFT reference data used for direct force training and testing of the artificial neural network (ANN) interatomic potential with the atomic energy network (ænet) and ænet-PyTorch packages (https://github.com/atomisticnet/aenet-PyTorch). Each data file contains an atomic structure together with its energy and atomic forces in XCrySDen Structure Format (XSF). The structure and content of the archive are described in README.md.
items.tz: 使用一种高效且准确的机器学习势函数直接模拟LiNi₀.₈Mn₀.₁Co₀.₁O₂的输运性质
items.az:
层状锂镍锰钴氧化物（NMC）阴极材料的倍率性能对于快充等高功率应用至关重要，然而NMC中锂离子传输的机理在实验和计算层面仍理解不足。
在本工作中，为实现锂自扩散的直接大规模分子动力学（MD）模拟，开发了一种高效且准确的机器学习势能（MLP），适用于LiNi₀.₈Mn₀.₁Co₀.₁O₂（NMC811）。
该工作流程使用一个微调过的MACE（消息传递原子簇扩展）基础模型作为结构生成器，并结合应用于近基态数据集的主动学习策略，从而以高效的数据方式从有限数量的密度泛函理论（DFT）参考计算中构建出一个可靠的MLP模型。
基于该势函数的分子动力学模拟在保持密度泛函理论准确性的同时克服了其时间尺度和长度尺度限制，并用于预测NMC811中的锂扩散系数。
该记录包含用于人工神经网络（ANN）原子间势能的直接力训练和测试的DFT参考数据，使用原子能量网络（ænet）和ænet-PyTorch包（https://github.com/atomisticnet/aenet-PyTorch）。
每个数据文件包含一个原子结构及其能量和原子力，格式为XCrySDen结构格式（XSF）。
档案的结构和内容在 README.md 中有描述。

items.t: Framework-Conditional Open Materials Generation
items.a: Theoretical predictions of novel materials rely on a variety of techniques, from data-mining-based ion substitution methods to fully de novo generative models. Each approach imposes specific constraints and encounters unique challenges when extrapolating beyond the distribution of known materials to discover new ones. The foremost goal of materials generation is to produce stable, unique, and novel (S.U.N.) structures. Predicted structures that meet these criteria, however, typically result from novel chemical compositions mapped onto known structural prototypes or frameworks. We leverage this heuristic insight to present a new generative paradigm for the de novo prediction of inorganic crystalline materials constrained by their structural framework---i.e., the unit cell shapes and respective particle positions. Our method, termed OMatG-FC (Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation), learns via a combination of discrete flow matching on the atomic species and stochastic interpolants for the volume scaling of the unit cell lattice, while fixing in-place the fractional coordinates and the unit-volume lattice vectors, dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the problem compared to unconstrained (framework-free) generation. Our method is more flexible than existing prototype-constrained methods, demonstrating capability for discovery of unseen, stable prototypes derived from known structural frameworks. We also investigate the number of unique frameworks in the MP-20 dataset, demonstrating the propensity of duplicate frameworks within the dataset and providing a framework-split version. We benchmark the performance of our model using the LeMat-GenBench suite using three ML interatomic potentials and achieve state-of-the-art S.U.N. rate below the convex hull, eschewing the need to learn atomic packings for materials discovery.
items.tz: 基于框架的开放材料生成
items.az:
新型材料的理论预测依赖于多种技术，从基于数据挖掘的离子取代方法到完全从头生成的模型。
每种方法在从已知材料的分布外推以发现新材料时，都会施加特定的约束并面临独特的挑战。
材料生成的首要目标是产生稳定、独特且新颖（S.U.N.）的结构。
然而，满足这些标准的预测结构通常源于新型化学组成映射到已知的结构原型或框架上。
我们利用这一启发式见解，提出了一种新的生成范式，用于从头预测受其结构框架约束的无机晶体材料——即晶胞形状及其相应粒子位置。
我们的方法称为 OMatG-FC（开放材料框架-条件生成），通过结合对原子种类的离散流匹配以及单元胞晶格体积缩放的随机插值，在固定分数坐标和单位体积晶格向量的情况下，显著降低了与无约束（框架自由）生成相比的问题维度。
我们的方法比现有的原型约束方法更加灵活，能够发现从已知结构框架中衍生出的未见但稳定的原型。
我们还研究了MP-20数据集中唯一框架的数量，展示了数据集中存在重复框架的倾向，并提供了框架分割版本。
我们使用LeMat-GenBench套件，结合三种机器学习原子间势能，对模型性能进行基准测试，并实现了S.U.N.的最新水平。
在凸包下方的速率，避免了材料发现中需要学习原子堆积的需要。
