items.t: Unraveling Tellurium Defect‐Mediated Structural Phase Stability of Monolayer MoTe 2 Using Fine‐Tuned Machine‐Learning Interatomic Potentials
items.a: Monolayer molybdenum ditelluride (MoTe 2 ) exhibits a small energy difference between its semiconducting 2H and semimetallic 1T’ phases, enabling structural phase transitions under external perturbations such as defects, strain and temperature. However, the combined thermodynamic effects of Te defects and lattice strain at finite temperatures remain insufficiently understood. In this work, the defect‐dependent phase stability of monolayer MoTe 2 is investigated using a machine‐learning interatomic potential (MLIP) fine‐tuned on density functional theory (DFT) training data. Helmholtz free‐energy calculations reveal that both Te vacancies and Te adatoms thermodynamically stabilize the 1T’ phase relative to the 2H phase. The critical defect concentration required for 1T’ phase stabilization decreases systematically with increasing temperature, indicating strong coupling between temperature and defect‐mediated phase stability. Additionally, strain and Te defects exhibit a pronounced synergistic effect: defects significantly reduce the critical strain required for the 2H‐1T’ phase transition, while strain lowers the defect concentration necessary for stabilization of the 1T’ phase. These findings provide new insight into defect‐mediated phase stability in MoTe 2 and establish a thermodynamic framework applicable to other transition metal dichalcogenide systems, offering practical guidance for phase‐controlled synthesis and device engineering.
items.tz: 利用精细调优的机器学习原子势揭示单层MoTe₂中碲缺陷介导的结构相稳定性
items.az:
单层二碲化钼（MoTe₂）在其半导体2H相和半金属1T’相之间存在较小的能量差，使其能够在缺陷、应变和温度等外部扰动下发生结构相变。
然而，Te缺陷和晶格应变在有限温度下的联合热力学效应仍不够清楚。
本文利用一种基于密度泛函理论（DFT）训练数据微调的机器学习原子间势（MLIP），研究了单层MoTe₂中缺陷依赖的相稳定性。
赫尔姆霍兹自由能计算表明，碲空位和碲吸附原子在热力学上均有利于稳定1T’相相对于2H相。
实现1T’相稳定所需的临界缺陷浓度随温度升高而系统性降低，表明温度与缺陷介导的相稳定性之间存在强耦合。
此外，应变和Te缺陷表现出显著的协同效应：缺陷显著降低了2H‐1T’相转变所需的临界应变，而应变则降低了稳定1T’相所需的缺陷浓度。
这些发现为MoTe₂中缺陷介导的相稳定性提供了新的见解，并建立了适用于其他过渡金属二硫属化物体系的热力学框架，为相控合成和器件工程提供了实用指导。

items.t: From molecular generation to process-relevant performance: AI-driven identification of novel working fluids
items.a: The search for working fluids that balance thermodynamic performance, safety, and environmental sustainability remains a pressing challenge for refrigeration and heat pump technologies. Here, we present a hybrid computational workflow combining deep generative learning with classical thermodynamic modelling to identify novel working fluid candidates. Using a graph-based diffusion model, we generate and screen molecules against a quantitative physicochemical profile derived from known working fluids. We characterise five selected candidates in depth through molecular dynamics simulations, the polar soft-SAFT equation of state, COSMO-RS calculations, and two neural network predictors for flammability and GWP. We find that the predicted thermophysical and transport properties of the candidates fall within the range of established hydrofluorocarbons. Benchmarking against R-245fa and R-134a identifies a new compound (3,3,3-trifluoro-2-methylpropene) as the most promising candidate for high-temperature heat pump applications, and confirms another (1,1,1,2,2-pentafluoropropane) as a viable refrigerant for vapour compression cycles. Our work establishes a scalable framework for the rational, data-driven discovery of next-generation working fluids.
items.tz: 从分子生成到工艺相关的性能：基于人工智能的新型工作流体识别
items.az:
寻找在热力学性能、安全性和环境可持续性之间取得平衡的工质仍然是制冷和热泵技术中的一个紧迫挑战。
在此，我们提出一种结合深度生成学习与经典热力学建模的混合计算工作流程，用于识别新型工作流体候选物。
使用基于图的扩散模型，我们生成并筛选分子，针对从已知工作流体中导出的定量物理化学特性进行评估。
我们通过分子动力学模拟、极性软-SAFT状态方程、COSMO-RS计算以及两种用于可燃性和GWP的神经网络预测模型，对五个选定候选物进行了深入表征。
我们发现候选物质的预测热物理和输运性质处于已知氢氟烃的范围内。
与R-245fa和R-134a的对比表明，3,3,3-三氟-2-甲基丙烯是一种适用于高温热泵应用的最有前景的化合物，而1,1,1,2,2-五氟丙烷则被确认为可用于蒸气压缩循环的一种可行制冷剂。
我们的工作建立了一个可扩展的框架，用于理性、数据驱动地发现下一代工作流体。

items.t: Global Potential Energy Surface Exploration Using Generative Stochastic Surface Walking (Gen-SSW)
items.a: Global potential energy surface (PES) exploration offers a unique way to predict the structure of material from first principles. Here, we develop Gen-SSW method to enable autonomous and fast global PES exploration, which combines a general-purpose SE(3)-equivariant 3D diffusion model, LASP-Gen, with stochastic surface walking (SSW) global optimization. Contrary to the conventional SSW global PES exploration that requires a long serial trajectory to overcome high barriers between large structural basins, Gen-SSW establishes an autonomous, massively parallel global optimization framework, which realizes global PES exploration via divide-and-conquer: many short SSW trajectories are performed based on the seed structures batch-generated from LASP-Gen. By applying Gen-SSW across complex materials, we show that (i) LASP-Gen can efficiently yield a structural pool with huge structure diversity and reasonable local chemical bonding patterns, and (ii) By docking LASP-Gen with SSW, Gen-SSW can identify efficiently low-energy polymorphs of materials, as exampled by ionic materials (TiO2, LiFePO4), amorphous alloys (Ge2Sb2Te5), strong covalent materials (boron) and molecular crystals (phenol crystal). In particular, we find a new boron allotropy, namely α̃-B, that is only 6 meV/atom above α-boron but 17 meV/atom more stable than γ-boron, and suggest a synthetical route for making this new phase via solid–solid phase transition.
items.v: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
items.tz: 利用生成式随机表面行走（Gen-SSW）进行全局势能面探索
items.az:
全局势能面（PES）探索为从第一性原理预测材料结构提供了一种独特的方法。
在此，我们提出了Gen-SSW方法，以实现自主且快速的全局势能面探索，该方法结合了通用的SE(3)等变3D扩散模型LASP-Gen与随机表面行走（SSW）全局优化。
与传统的需要长时间串行轨迹来克服大型结构盆地间高能垒的SSW全局势能面探索不同，Gen-SSW建立了一个自主且大规模并行的全局优化框架，通过分而治之的方式实现全局势能面探索：基于LASP-Gen批量生成的种子结构，执行多条短SSW轨迹。
通过将Gen-SSW应用于复杂材料，我们表明：（i）LASP-Gen能够高效生成具有巨大结构多样性和合理局部化学键模式的结构池；（ii）将LASP-Gen与SSW结合后，Gen-SSW能够高效识别材料的低能晶型，例如离子材料（TiO2, LiFePO4）、非晶合金（Ge2Sb2Te5）、强共价材料（硼）和分子晶体（苯酚晶体）。
特别是，我们发现了一种新的硼同素异形体，即α̃-B，其能量仅比α-硼高6 meV/原子，但比γ-硼稳定17 meV/原子，并提出了一种通过固–固相变制备该新相的合成路线。

items.t: Differentiable Electronic Grand Canonical Learning for Electrochemistry
items.a: Electronic grand-canonical density functional theory captures how structure and electronic charge respond to electrode potential and, together with statistical mechanics, how these responses give rise to emergent phenomena. However, its computational cost limits the system sizes and sampling times accessible to first- principles simulations. Here, we introduce a differentiable architecture that represents the grand potential and obtains forces and electronic charge as its derivatives, exactly satisfying the mixed-derivative constraints required for thermodynamic consistency, and implement it within the equivariant MACE framework as GC- MACE. We demonstrate more accurate joint learning across multiple electrochemical interfaces and improved transferability to thicker water films relative to previous models, while enabling constant-potential simulations at substantially larger length and time scales than accessible to ab initio molecular dynamics. With broad training data, the framework offers a route to thermodynamically consistent foundation interatomic potentials for the electronic grand canonical ensemble
items.tz: 可微电子大正则学习用于电化学
items.az:
电子大数密度泛函理论描述了结构和电子电荷如何响应电极电势，并结合统计力学，阐明这些响应如何导致涌现现象。
然而，其计算成本限制了第一性原理模拟可访问的系统尺寸和采样时间。
在这里，我们提出了一种可微架构，该架构表示吉布斯自由能，并通过其导数获得力和电子电荷，精确满足热力学一致性的混合导数约束，并将其在等变MACE框架中实现为GC-MACE。
我们展示了在多个电化学界面之间更准确的联合学习，以及相较于先前模型对较厚水膜的更好可迁移性，同时实现了远超ab initio分子动力学可达的长度和时间尺度下的恒电位模拟。
在大量训练数据的情况下，该框架为电子大正则系综下的热力学一致的本征原子势提供了途径

items.t: Distilling Large-Scale Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials to Predict Long-Timescale Electrolyte Transport Properties
items.a: Accurately predicting the transport properties of liquid electrolytes is critical for next-generation battery design and requires force fields that are both quantum-mechanically accurate and fast enough for long-timescale simulation. Recent large-scale pretrained machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approach density-functional-theory accuracy, but remain too slow to access the necessary timescales to converge transport properties. We provide a knowledge distillation procedure to transfer the accuracy of a large-scale "teacher" MLIP into fast, system-specific "students", without any additional ab initio data. Our distilled models run ~40x faster, reproduce teacher-predicted structural observables, and produce stable 20 ns trajectories in days, rather than the months the teacher would require. Across a diverse set of sodium- and lithium-ion electrolytes, student-predicted self-diffusivities, ionic conductivities, and shear viscosities track experiment and outperform classical force-field predictions, establishing distillation as a practical route to accurate, long-timescale simulations necessary for high-throughput electrolyte screening.
items.tz: 将大规模机器学习原子间势能函数提炼以预测长时序电解质传输性质
items.az:
准确预测液态电解质的传输性质对于下一代电池设计至关重要，需要既具有量子力学准确性又足以支持长时间尺度模拟的力场。
近期大规模预训练的机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）已达到密度泛函理论的精度，但仍然过于缓慢，无法访问收敛输运性质所需的时标。
我们提供一种知识蒸馏流程，将大规模“教师”MLIP的准确性转移到快速、针对特定体系的“学生”模型中，无需任何额外的从头计算数据。
我们的蒸馏模型运行速度快约40倍，能够重现教师模型预测的结构可观测量，并在几天内生成稳定的20 ns轨迹，而教师模型则需要数月时间。
在一系列钠离子和锂离子电解质中，学生预测的自扩散系数、离子电导率和剪切粘度与实验数据一致，并优于经典力场预测，证实了蒸馏作为一种实现高通量电解质筛选所需准确长时尺度模拟的实用途径。

items.t: Prediction of aluminium distributions in zeolites using basin-hopping and machine learning potentials
items.a: We present a new method to predict the structures of aluminosilicate zeolites using an accurate neural network potential and a custom basin-hopping method and demonstrate it's utility on Chabazite, Mordenite and zeolite RHO.
items.tz: 利用盆地跳转和机器学习势函数预测沸石中铝的分布
items.az: 我们提出了一种利用精确神经网络势能和定制的盆地跳转方法来预测沸石类铝硅酸盐晶体结构的新方法，并在Chabazite、Mordenite和zeolite RHO上展示了其有效性。

items.t: Does System Size Matter in Uncertainty Quantification for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials?
items.a: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) commonly use uncertainty estimates to flag out-of-distribution (OOD) configurations and select structures for active learning. A key question is whether the resulting structure-level uncertainty scores remain comparable across different system sizes. A common practice is to aggregate per-atom uncertainties by their mean or maximum and compare the resulting score against a fixed threshold, implicitly assuming such comparability. We test this assumption across several in-distribution (ID)/OOD pairs by characterizing both aggregations as a function of atom count. The two aggregations exhibit distinct size dependencies. Mean aggregation remains size-independent for homogeneous systems but loses sensitivity to defects in large cells. In contrast, maximum aggregation grows with system size for ID systems while remaining approximately flat for defect-containing systems, narrowing the ID-OOD gap in a manner consistent with extreme-value statistics. Although highly uncertain atoms in large structures may indicate novel local environments, retraining on these structures yields little improvement, in contrast to retraining on OOD structures constructed to lie outside the training distribution. Our results reveal a practical limitation of size-unaware uncertainty criteria and motivate size-aware calibration for more reliable OOD detection in large-scale atomistic simulations.
items.tz: 机器学习原子势的不确定性量化中，系统尺寸重要吗？
items.az:
机器学习原子势（MLIPs）通常使用不确定性估计来标记异常分布（OOD）构型，并选择结构用于主动学习。
一个关键问题是，所得的结构层面不确定性评分在不同系统尺寸下是否保持可比性。
一种常见的做法是通过均值或最大值对每个原子的不确定性进行聚合，并将所得得分与一个固定阈值进行比较，这隐含地假设了这种可比性。
我们通过分析原子数量对不同分布（ID）/域外分布（OOD）配对的聚类情况，来检验这一假设。
两种聚集表现出不同的尺寸依赖性。
均聚物的平均聚集在均相体系中与尺寸无关，但在大细胞中对缺陷的敏感性丧失。
相比之下，对于无缺陷系统，最大聚集随系统尺寸增长而增加，而对于含缺陷系统则保持大致平坦，从而以与极值统计一致的方式缩小了ID-OOD差距。
尽管大结构中高度不确定的原子可能指示新的局部环境，但在这些结构上进行再训练带来的改进甚微，与在构造位于训练分布之外的OOD结构上进行再训练形成对比。
我们的结果揭示了尺寸无关不确定性准则的实用局限，并推动了尺寸感知校准，以在大规模原子级模拟中实现更可靠的OOD检测。

items.t: Correcting the Liquid Densities of Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials Using Local-Number-Density Repulsion
items.a: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) such as UMA, trained on reference data from meta-generalized gradient approximation or hybrid functionals that incorporate dispersion interactions, often overestimate molecular-liquid densities, thereby placing every property computed at constant pressure at the wrong state point. This study proposes a correction that adds to the MLIP a repulsive energy quadratic in the local number density of each atom, with two coefficients fitted only to the equations of state of water and ethanol; the forces and stresses follow analytically, so neither electronic-structure calculations nor retraining is required. For UMA, the correction reduces the density mean absolute error (MAE) of 22 liquids from 10.8% to 2.5%, lowering the error for every liquid and bringing 20 of them within ±5% of experiment, while improving the bulk modulus (MAE from 71.6% to 22.1%), heat of vaporization, and second hydration shell of water, none of which was calibrated. Applied to SevenNet-Omni without recalibration, the same coefficients reduce the density MAE from 8.2% to 1.8%, with 21 of 22 liquids within ±5% of experiment.
items.tz: 使用局部数密度排斥修正通用机器学习原子间势的液态密度
items.az:
通用机器学习原子势（MLIPs）如UMA，基于元泛函梯度近似或包含色散相互作用的杂化泛函参考数据训练，往往高估分子液体密度，从而将所有在恒压条件下计算出的性质置于错误的状态点。
本研究提出一种修正，将局部原子数密度的二次排斥能加入MLIP中，其中两个系数仅针对水和乙醇的状态方程进行拟合；力和应力可解析求得，因此无需进行电子结构计算或重新训练。
对于UMA，校正将22种液体的密度平均绝对误差（MAE）从10.8%降低至2.5%，使得每种液体的误差均减小，并使其中20种液体的误差控制在±5%以内，同时提升了体积模量（MAE从71.6%降至22.1%）、汽化热以及水的第二水合壳层，这些性质均未进行校准。
应用于SevenNet-Omni且无需重新校准时，相同的系数将密度MAE从8.2%降低至1.8%，其中22种液体中有21种的预测值在实验值的±5%范围内。

items.t: Fast ON/OFF Emission Photoswitching of Turn-On Mode Fluorescent Diarylethenes
items.a: Fluorescent chromophores having reversible photoswitching ability are applicable for various types of analysis and imaging. 1,2-Bis(2-ethyl-6-phenyl-1-benzothiophene-1,1-dioxide-3-yl)perfluorocyclopentene (1) is known to undergo turn-on mode fluorescent photoswitching. One serious drawback of the chromophore is its very low photocycloreversion (switching off) quantum yield (<10–3). To improve the yield, derivatives bearing various alkyl substituents at 2- and 2′-positions were prepared. It was found that introduction of bulky substituents, such as isobutyl or neopentyl groups, is effective in increasing the yield. The yield increases by almost 3 orders of magnitude from 5.9 × 10–4 to 4.6 × 10–1 by replacing ethyl substituents with neopentyl groups. Theoretical analysis revealed that the energy barrier in the photocycloreversion reaction is inferred from the calculated potential energy difference between 2Ao and 2Ac local minima in the excited-state (S1) potential energy surface, and the decrease in the energy difference by introducing bulky primary alkyl substituents at 2- and 2′-position increases the photocycloreversion quantum yield. Although substitution of primary alkyl groups increases the yield, secondary alkyl substituents are ineffective. 1,2-Bis(2-neopentyl-6-phenyl-1-benzothiophene-1,1-dioxide-3-yl)perfluorocyclopentene (6) undergoes very fast ON/OFF emission photoswitching cycles over 2000 times even in the presence of air without any marked fatigue, and the colored closed-ring isomer is stable at 80 °C for 50 h.
items.v: Journal of the American Chemical Society
items.tz: 快速开/关发射的开启模式荧光二芳基乙烯
items.az:
具有可逆光开关能力的荧光色基适用于多种类型的分析和成像。
1,2-双(2-乙基-6-苯基-1-苯并硫醚-1,1-二氧代-3-基)全氟环戊烯 (1) 已知可发生开启模式的荧光光开关效应。
染料基团的一个严重缺点是其光环化逆转（关闭）量子产率极低（<10–3）。
为提高产率，制备了在2-位和2′-位带有各种烷基取代基的衍生物。
发现引入体积较大的取代基，如异丁基或新戊基基团，有助于提高产率。
产率从 5.9 × 10⁻⁴ 增加到 4.6 × 10⁻¹，几乎提高了三个数量级。
理论分析表明，光环裂解反应中的能垒来源于激发态（S1）势能面上2Ao和2Ac局部极小值之间的计算势能差，而在2-位和2′-位引入体积较大的一级烷基取代基会减小该能差，从而提高光环裂解的量子产率。
尽管将一级烷基取代基引入可提高产率，但二级烷基取代基无效。
1,2-双(2-新戊基-6-苯基-1-苯并硫醚-1,1-二氧代-3-基)全氟环戊烯(6)在空气中即使经过2000次以上的ON/OFF发射光开关循环也无明显疲劳现象，且有色闭环异构体在80 °C下可稳定保持50小时。

items.t: MoLRSI: A Recursive Self-Improving AI agent for Molecular Discovery
items.a: Molecular discovery requires navigating vast combinatorial search spaces while balancing competing biological objectives. AI agents can automate expert-defined molecular design protocols, but automation alone does not address how to optimize workflows for new tasks or improve their development through experience. Here we introduce MoLRSI, an AI agent that combines systematic optimization of workflows and model architectures with persistent cross-task memory to recursively improve its search policy for molecular discovery. Workflow performance, refinement outcomes, and execution feedback guide subsequent searches, allowing the agent to improve both its workflows and its strategy for developing them. We evaluate MoLRSI in two challenging molecular discovery settings that require balancing competing properties. In antibiotic discovery, MoLRSI developed a screening workflow balancing antibacterial activity, cytotoxicity and structural novelty, achieving an experimental hit rate of 15.9%, compared with 8.7% for a previous expert-led workflow using the same training data and screening library. In de novo peptide-MHC binder design, MoLRSI developed workflows that jointly consider target binding and specificity, producing eight experimentally validated hits against MART-1 and SARS-CoV-1 pMHCs with preferential binding over tested off-targets while Claude Science completely failed. These findings demonstrate how experience-guided workflow optimization can address competing discovery objectives while improving the search strategies used in subsequent campaigns.
items.tz: MoLRSI：用于分子发现的递归自改进人工智能代理
items.az:
分子发现需要在庞大的组合搜索空间中进行探索，同时平衡相互竞争的生物学目标。
AI代理可以自动化专家定义的分子设计协议，但仅自动化无法解决如何为新任务优化工作流或通过经验提升其开发的问题。
这里我们介绍了MoLRSI，一种AI代理，它结合了工作流和模型架构的系统性优化以及持久的跨任务记忆，以递归改进其用于分子发现的搜索策略。
工作流性能、优化结果和执行反馈指导后续搜索，使代理能够同时改进其工作流及其开发工作流的策略。
我们在两个具有挑战性的分子发现场景中评估了MoLRSI，这些场景需要在相互竞争的性质之间取得平衡。
在抗生素发现中，MoLRSI 开发了一种平衡抗菌活性、细胞毒性及结构新颖性的筛选工作流程，实验命中率达到了15.9%，相比之前使用相同训练数据和筛选库的专家主导工作流程的8.7%。
在从头设计肽-MHC结合物时，MoLRSI开发了同时考虑靶标结合和特异性的工作流程，针对MART-1和SARS-CoV-1 pMHCs产生了八个经实验验证的命中分子，其对测试的脱靶分子表现出优先结合，而Claude Science则完全失败。
这些发现表明，基于经验的工作流优化能够在处理相互竞争的发现目标的同时，提升后续研究活动中所采用的搜索策略。

items.t: Fast rigid rotational alignment of voxelized 3-D density maps in sliced Wasserstein distance
items.a: We develop a fast method for the rigid alignment of voxelized three-dimensional density functions over $\mathsf{SO}(3)$ using sliced optimal transport. Our approach efficiently transforms each density map into a tensor of one-dimensional quantile functions, taken from central slices over the unit sphere, such that the Euclidean distance of the transformed volumes approximates the sliced 2-Wasserstein distance. Our formulation is therefore compatible with existing, fast, voxel-based Euclidean alignment algorithms. We provide theoretical analysis and numerical experiments demonstrating that the sliced 2-Wasserstein distance is a robust metric for comparing three-dimensional shapes and for computing their rigid alignment.
items.tz: 切片 Wasserstein 距离中体素化 3-D 密度图的快速刚性旋转对齐
items.az:
我们提出一种基于切片最优传输的快速方法，用于在 $\mathsf{SO}(3)$ 上对体素化的三维密度函数进行刚性对齐。
我们的方法高效地将每个密度图转换为一组一维分位数函数张量，这些函数来自单位球面上的中央切片，使得变换后的体积的欧几里得距离近似于切片的2-瓦舍斯坦距离。
我们的方法因此与现有的、快速的基于体素的欧几里得对齐算法兼容。
我们提供了理论分析和数值实验，证明切片2-瓦舍斯坦距离是用于比较三维形状以及计算其刚性对齐的稳健度量。
items.tw: 预印本或来源不明；作者不在关注名单

items.t: sDMD: Sinkhorn Distribution Matching Distillation
items.a: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) distills multi-step diffusion models into few-step generators by minimizing reverse KL divergence. Despite its strong performance, DMD guides samples by local density alone, which introduces two limitations: teacher scores can be unreliable in regions of low teacher density, and the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL can collapse the student onto a subset of the teacher modes. We first connect DMD to Wasserstein gradient flow, showing that its gradient follows from a fixed-point formulation with integral KL (IKL) as the energy functional. This perspective motivates augmenting IKL with an optimal transport term that addresses these limitations by guiding outlier samples toward the target and promoting mode coverage. We realize this term using Sinkhorn divergence estimated from finite batches. In practice, however, errors in the estimated Sinkhorn velocity can perturb in-domain samples for which IKL guidance is already accurate. To this end, we introduce sDMD, which adaptively activates the Sinkhorn correction based on discriminator outputs, focusing on outlier samples where IKL may be unreliable. With 2--4 sampling steps on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image-20B, and Wan2.1-14B, sDMD outperforms distillation baselines on GenEval, DPG, WISE, and VBench while improving sample diversity over DMD2.
items.tz: sDMD：Sinkhorn 分布匹配蒸馏
items.az:
分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）通过最小化反KL散度，将多步扩散模型蒸馏为少步生成器。
尽管其性能优异，DMD 仅依靠局部密度引导样本，这引入了两个局限性：在教师密度较低的区域，教师分数可能不可靠，且反KL散度的模式寻优行为会使学生模型坍缩到教师模式的一个子集上。
我们首先将DMD与Wasserstein梯度流联系起来，表明其梯度来源于一个具有积分KL（IKL）作为能量泛函的不动点公式。
本文观点提出，通过引入最优传输项来增强IKL，以解决这些局限性，即引导异常样本向目标方向发展，并促进模式的覆盖。
我们通过从有限批次中估计的Sinkhorn散度来实现这一术语。
然而，在实际操作中，估算出的Sinkhorn速度误差可能会扰动那些IKL指导已准确的域内样本。
为此，我们引入sDMD，其根据判别器输出自适应激活Sinkhorn校正，重点关注IKL可能不可靠的异常样本。
在FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image-20B和Wan2.1-14B上进行2--4个采样步长时，sDMD在GenEval、DPG、WISE和VBench上的表现优于蒸馏基线，并且在样本多样性方面优于DMD2。

items.t: Learning Between the Lines: Interaction Interpolation in a Multi Element Machine Learning Interatomic Potential
items.a: The continuous development of machine learning inter-atomic potentials (MLIAPs)has greatly accelerated materials research in recent years. However, the need to con- struct custom MLIAPs for each unique problem remains a bottleneck which raises the question of the transferability of MLIAPs. While foundation MLIAPs can achieve transferability due to the broad coverage of chemical space represented in their training sets, their size and computational cost limits their routine use. We address this gap by developing a lightweight general-purpose MLIAP for metal alloys spanning twelve elements (Al, Sc, Ti, V, Cu, Zn, Zr, Nb, Mo, Hf, Ta, W). Here, we utilize a step-wise active learning (AL) approach to develop a compact yet diverse dataset and model that generalizes well by interpolating from previously seen interactions. The resulting potentials transfer effectively to unseen, higher body-order alloys systems, requiring only unary and binary training data to capture ternary and quaternary systems. The model also transfers well to new elements via an alchemical extrapolation within the network, requiring only unary data for the new element and its alloys. These findings suggest that MLIAPs trained on targeted, diversity-driven datasets provide transferability at a relatively low computational cost, offering a practical path toward general-purpose, resource-efficient MLIAPs for materials modeling.
items.tz: 在线条之间学习：多元素机器学习相互作用势中的交互插值
items.az:
机器学习原子势（MLIAPs）的持续发展近年来极大推动了材料研究。
然而，为每个独特问题构建定制的MLIAPs仍是一个瓶颈，这引发了MLIAPs可转移性的疑问。
尽管基础MLIAPs由于其训练集中涵盖的化学空间广泛而具备可转移性，但其规模和计算成本限制了其常规应用。
我们通过开发一种轻量级的通用多物理场机器学习框架（MLIAP），用于覆盖十二种元素（Al、Sc、Ti、V、Cu、Zn、Zr、Nb、Mo、Hf、Ta、W）的金属合金。
在此，我们采用一种分步主动学习（AL）方法，构建一个紧凑且多样化的数据集和模型，该模型通过从前见过的相互作用中插值，能够良好地泛化。
所得势能有效转移到未见的高体相序合金体系中，仅需一元和二元训练数据即可捕捉三元和四元体系。
该模型也通过网络内的alchemical extrapolation很好地推广到新元素，仅需新元素及其合金的unary数据。
这些发现表明，基于目标且具有多样性的数据集训练的MLIAPs在相对较低的计算成本下具备可迁移性，为材料建模领域提供了一条实用路径，以实现通用性、资源高效的MLIAPs。

items.t: What to randomize matters: a controlled study of volume, axis and representation in low-data molecular generation
items.a: Chemical language models can struggle to generate new molecules when trained on small datasets, where a model may reproduce training examples rather than learn a useful generative distribution. Randomized SMILES augmentation varies atom traversal, whereas Sequential Attachment-based Fragment Embedding (SAFE) also allows the order of fragment blocks to vary. How these distinct sources of representational variation affect low-data molecular generation has not been clearly studied. Here, using 1,000 seed molecules to train an autoregressive sequence model, we compare canonical SAFE with randomized SAFE at increasing corpus sizes, isolate atom-order and fragment-order axes of SAFE randomization, and compare fully randomized SAFE with randomized SMILES at molecule-by-molecule matched training corpora. Three findings emerge. First, randomization of SAFE alone raises the genuine yield of novel molecules more than 450-fold, turning a model that merely reproduces its training set into a practical molecular generator. Second, the two axes of randomization act jointly rather than additively: atom order alone reaches a tenth, and fragment order alone a seventh, of the genuine yield obtained when both vary, which is four times their combined contribution. Third, at matched corpus size and compute, randomized SAFE delivers 2.8 times the genuine yield of randomized SMILES. Welch tests with Games-Howell post-hoc comparisons resolve every difference on the primary outcomes. In the low-data regime, thus, what one randomizes rather than only how much determines whether augmentation produces new molecules or merely new spellings of the training set.
items.tz: 随机化的内容很重要：一项关于低数据条件下分子生成中体积、轴向和表示方法的受控研究
items.az:
化学语言模型在基于小数据集训练时，可能难以生成新分子，此时模型可能会重复训练示例而非学习到有用的生成分布。
随机化SMILES增强会变化原子遍历，而基于顺序连接的片段嵌入（SAFE）也允许片段块的顺序发生变化。
这些不同的表征变异来源如何影响低数据量下的分子生成尚未被明确研究。
在此，使用1,000个种子分子训练一个自回归序列模型，我们比较了在不断增加语料库规模下的标准SAFE与随机化SAFE，分离了SAFE随机化中的原子顺序和片段顺序维度，并将完全随机化的SAFE与随机化SMILES在分子对分子匹配的训练语料库中进行对比。
有三个发现。
首先，仅对SAFE进行随机化使其新型分子的真实产率提高了450倍以上，将一个仅仅复现其训练集的模型转变为一个实用的分子生成器。
其次，两个随机化轴共同作用而非相加：仅原子顺序达到联合变化时真实产量的十分之一，而仅片段顺序达到七分之一，其总和仅为两者联合贡献的四倍。
第三，当匹配的语料库大小和计算资源相同时，随机化的SAFE产生的真实产量是随机化SMILES的2.8倍。
威尔克检验结合Games-Howell事后比较在主要结局指标上解析了所有差异。
在数据量较少的 regime 中，因此，随机化的内容而非随机化的程度决定了增强是否产生新分子或仅仅是训练集的重新排列。

items.t: Development and application of a machine learning potential for diamond surfaces and their sliding interfaces with silicon nitride and silica: effect of passivation, orientation and load
items.a: Friction and wear of diamond are controlled by its surface chemistry, which determines whether covalent bonds form across the sliding interface. First-principles simulations have explored the role of surface orientation and passivation, but are limited to a few hundred atoms and tens of picoseconds. To bridge this gap, we develop a reactive machine learning interatomic potential for the C/H/N/O/Si chemical space, covering diamond, silicon nitride, silicon oxide, their surfaces, interfaces, and environmental molecules. The potential is trained on a large dataset of diverse structures and is tested on multiple physical properties, including ab initio reaction barriers on diamond surfaces, and structural/mechanical properties of amorphous Si$_3$N$_4$ and SiO$_2$. We then simulate sliding of diamond-Si$_3$N$_4$ interfaces with four surface orientations, clean and H/OH-passivated terminations, and normal loads from 0.1 to 23 GPa. We identify two different regimes: one where sliding is localized at the interface, and shear stress is proportional to the interfacial bond density, and another where shear is distributed inside the softer material, and adhesion due to full interfacial bonding dominates. These results show how passivation, surface orientation and load together determine interfacial bonding and friction, with implications for the environmental sensitivity of diamond wear. More broadly, the potential enables reactive simulations of diamond, silicon nitride and silica with near-ab initio accuracy at length and time scales beyond first-principles methods, providing a useful tool for future studies of wear at plowing asperities, chemical-mechanical polishing, and properties of amorphous ceramic films.
items.tz: 金刚石表面及其与氮化硅和二氧化硅滑移界面的机器学习势开发与应用：钝化、取向和载荷的影响
items.az:
金刚石的摩擦和磨损由其表面化学性质控制，这决定了滑动界面处是否形成共价键。
基于第一性原理的模拟已探讨了表面取向和钝化的作用，但受限于几百个原子和几十皮秒。
为填补这一差距，我们开发了一种用于C/H/N/O/Si化学空间的反应性机器学习原子间势，涵盖金刚石、氮化硅、氧化硅及其表面、界面和环境分子。
势能函数在多种结构的大型数据集上进行训练，并在多个物理性质上进行测试，包括金刚石表面的从头计算反应能垒，以及非晶Si₃N₄和SiO₂的结构/力学性质。
我们随后模拟了金刚石-Si₃N₄界面在四种表面取向、清洁及H/OH终止态和正常载荷从0.1到23 GPa条件下的滑移。
我们识别出两种不同的情形：一种是滑移局限于界面，剪应力与界面键密度成正比；另一种是剪切力分布在较软材料内部，而由于完全的界面键合导致的粘附占主导地位。
这些结果表明，钝化、表面取向和载荷共同决定了界面结合与摩擦，对金刚石磨损的环境敏感性具有重要意义。
更广泛地，该方法能够在远超第一性原理方法的长度和时间尺度上，以接近从头计算的精度对金刚石、氮化硅和二氧化硅进行反应模拟，为未来关于犁削表面处磨损、化学机械抛光以及非晶陶瓷薄膜性质的研究提供一个有用的工具。
items.tw: 预印本或来源不明；作者不在关注名单

items.t: HERA: Assessing an Autonomous Agent for Quantum Device Measurement
items.a: Large language model agents have begun to carry out laboratory measurements, but their scientific conclusions are useful only if they hold up under scrutiny. Demonstrating this requires controlled studies because models are stochastic and the context a model is given steers its conclusions. Here we introduce HERA, an autonomous agent designed to carry out cryogenic transport measurements of quantum devices. HERA draws on a knowledge base curated by lab members that holds measurement protocols, software tools, and literature references. We assessed HERA with a blinded trial against an expert on the stacking order of two multilayer graphene devices, an ablation of its knowledge base, and hundreds of offline replays in which models designed the trial's central measurement without running it. HERA's conclusions matched the expert's sealed conclusions on both tested devices. The ablation and the replay studies measured the impact of the knowledge base across different models, showing that with it every model designed better measurements and reasoned more soundly. To test how readily HERA extends to a new problem, we tasked it with finding and characterizing superconductivity in a different material system. This required a few hours of expert time to develop a new experimental protocol, after which HERA did both autonomously. These results show that, with a knowledge base designed for the task, language model agents are capable of sound experimental science.
items.tz: HERA：评估量子器件测量的自主代理
items.az:
大型语言模型代理已经开始执行实验室测量，但它们的科学结论只有在经受检验后才能被证明是有用的。
这需要受控的研究，因为模型是随机的，而模型所处的上下文会引导其结论。
在这里，我们介绍了HERA，一种自主代理，用于执行量子器件的低温传输测量。
HERA 借鉴了实验室成员整理的知识库，其中包含测量协议、软件工具和文献参考。
我们通过一项盲测，将HERA与一位专家在双层石墨烯器件堆叠顺序上的表现进行了对比，并对其知识库进行了消减，同时评估了数百次离线重放中的模型设计结果，这些模型在未实际运行实验的情况下设计了试验的核心测量。
HERA的结论与专家对测试器件的密封结论一致。
消融与回放研究测定了知识库在不同模型中的影响，结果表明，借助该知识库，每个模型均能做出更优的测量并进行更严谨的推理。
为了测试HERA如何轻松扩展到新问题，我们要求它在不同的材料体系中寻找并表征超导性。
这需要几小时专家时间来开发一种新的实验方案，之后HERA实现了完全自主运行。
这些结果表明，借助为该任务设计的知识库，语言模型代理能够进行严谨的实验科学。

items.t: Generative discovery of chemical reaction networks
items.a: Chemical kinetics determines molecular stability, reaction selectivity and the evolution of reacting mixtures, but discovering the underlying reaction networks remains challenging. Here we introduce ReactNexus, a generative framework for kinetic-guided network exploration starting solely from reactant graphs. Generative models propose transition states and predict the full reaction trajectories connecting reactants and products, while calculations using a machine-learned interatomic potential verify connectivity and evaluate electronic barriers. On an in-distribution benchmark of 10,000 generated candidates, 80.8% connect to the input reactant after density functional theory (DFT) optimization and intrinsic reaction coordinate verification. The resulting networks uncover lower-barrier cooperative pathways and competition between catalyst release and catalyst-bound branches. In the examined carbocation cascades, coverage of known product precursors saturates after limited expansion and distinct entries converge onto shared intermediates, indicating a compact accessible reaction space. Network-derived candidate structures further assist mass-spectral interpretation of a complex nucleophilic aromatic substitution reaction. Together, these results establish a generative approach to reaction-network discovery and mechanistic analysis without predefined products or reaction templates.
items.tz: 化学反应网络的生成式发现
items.az:
化学动力学决定了分子的稳定性、反应选择性以及反应混合物的演化，但发现其背后的反应网络仍具挑战性。
本文介绍了ReactNexus，一种基于反应物图的生成框架，用于指导动力学引导的网络探索。
生成模型提出过渡态，并预测连接反应物与产物的完整反应路径，而使用机器学习原子间势能的计算则验证路径连通性并评估电子势垒。
在10,000个生成候选物的分布内基准测试中，80.8%的化合物在密度泛函理论（DFT）优化和内在反应坐标验证后连接到输入反应物。
所得网络揭示了更低势垒的协同路径以及催化剂释放与催化剂结合支链之间的竞争。
在所研究的碳正离子级联反应中，已知产物前体的覆盖度在有限扩展后达到饱和，不同的路径收敛于共同的中间体，表明反应空间较为紧凑。
基于网络的候选结构进一步有助于复杂亲核芳香取代反应的质谱解析。
这些结果共同建立了一种无需预先定义产物或反应模板的反应网络发现及机理分析的生成方法。
items.tw: 预印本或来源不明；作者不在关注名单

items.t: Towards Generalizing Pretrained All-Atom Representations to Unified Binder Design
items.a: PairFormer-based all-atom models demonstrate strong capabilities in biomolecular binder design. However, existing methods often use all-atom representations for modality-specific binder design, such as protein and peptide design. In contrast, recent geometric latent diffusion models pursue unified binder design by representing molecular blocks from different modalities in a shared latent space. These complementary strengths motivate us to investigate how to generalize the use of pretrained all-atom representations to unified binder design. We introduce PairFuse, a parameter-efficient method that enables this generalization through representation fusion. Specifically, we use lightweight layerwise adapters to integrate pretrained all-atom representations into an independently pretrained geometric latent diffusion model. Our adapters integrate pretrained all-atom representations through two mechanisms: enriching the diffusion model's molecular block features and incorporating pairwise structural information into the geometric diffusion model's denoiser. Theoretically, we prove that the augmented denoiser preserves geometry and pairwise attention fusion provides additional attention expressivity beyond feature-only fusion. Experimentally, across antibody, peptide, and small molecule binder-design benchmarks, PairFuse achieves stronger performance than the pretrained diffusion model and existing representation-fusion baselines.
items.tz: 朝着将预训练的全原子表示推广到统一结合物设计的方向
items.az:
基于PairFormer的全原子模型在生物分子结合物设计中表现出强大能力。
然而，现有方法通常采用全原子表示来进行模态特异性的结合剂设计，例如蛋白质和肽的设计。
相比之下，最近的几何潜在扩散模型通过在共享的潜在空间中表示来自不同模态的分子单元，实现统一的结合剂设计。
这些互补的优势促使我们研究如何将预训练的全原子表示推广到统一的粘结剂设计中。
我们提出了PairFuse，一种参数高效的 方法，通过表征融合实现这一泛化。
具体而言，我们使用轻量级层间适配器，将预训练的全原子表示集成到一个独立预训练的几何潜在扩散模型中。
我们的适配器通过两种机制集成预训练的全原子表示：丰富扩散模型中分子块的特征，并将成对结构信息纳入几何扩散模型的去噪器中。
理论上，我们证明了增强去噪器保持几何结构，而成对注意力融合在特征仅融合的基础上提供了额外的注意力表达能力。
在抗体、肽和小分子结合设计基准测试中，PairFuse 的性能强于预训练扩散模型及现有的表示融合基线。

items.t: Finite-Step Geometry of Marginal-Preserving Velocity Fields in Generative Flows
items.a: Generative flows can admit different velocity fields that induce the same continuous marginal evolution but behave differently after numerical discretization. We study this finite-step non-equivalence while keeping the marginal path and numerical method fixed. Projected modified equations characterize the component of local integration error that changes the marginal law and give sufficient conditions for higher marginal convergence order. For affine fixed-shape distributions, we characterize exact finite-step reachability and derive spectral obstructions and sharp nearest-reachable Wasserstein errors. For diffusion probability-flow ODEs, we construct skew-score perturbations that preserve the exact marginal path under exact scores and quantify their leakage under score error. Controlled Gaussian and mixture experiments recover the predicted order, reachability, and obstruction phenomena.
items.tz: 生成流中保持边际的velocity场的有限步几何结构
items.az:
生成流可以具有不同的速度场，这些速度场会诱导相同的连续边缘演化，但在数值离散化后表现不同。
我们在此保持边缘路径和数值方法不变的情况下，研究这种有限步非等价性。
投影修正方程刻画了改变边际分布的局部积分误差分量，并给出了更高边际收敛阶的充分条件。
对于仿射固定形状分布，我们刻画了精确的有限步可达性，并推导出谱障碍和尖锐的最近可达Wasserstein误差。
对于扩散概率流ODEs，我们构建了斜率得分扰动，这些扰动在精确得分下保持精确边际路径，并量化其在得分误差下的泄漏。
受控的高斯和混合实验恢复了预测的有序性、可达性及障碍现象。

items.t: Where the Error Lives: Spectral Representations of Learned Kohn-Sham Hamiltonians
items.a: Kohn-Sham density functional theory (DFT) is the standard method for computing the electronic structure of molecules and materials, but its self-consistent-field (SCF) iterations make it expensive for large systems and high-throughput screening. Machine-learned Hamiltonian models offer a shortcut: an equivariant network predicts the Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian matrix in one forward pass, and diagonalizing the prediction yields orbital energies, the HOMO-LUMO gap, molecular orbitals and the electron density. These models are trained to match the reference matrix entry by entry, yet a small entry-wise error does not guarantee accurate eigenvalues or eigenvectors. Two physics-informed alternatives go partway: a recently proposed wavefunction-alignment loss adds a spectral penalty without diagonalizing the prediction, and matching the electron density of the diagonalized prediction supervises it directly. Neither is complete: by representing the prediction error in the eigenbasis of the reference Hamiltonian, we show that each sees only part of the error, and that shifting the predicted orbital energies leaves the electron density exactly unchanged. The same analysis identifies a complete training signal: the cumulative local density of states (cumulative LDOS), the number of electrons at each point in space with energy below a given threshold. The cumulative LDOS is a single physical observable that contains the electron density as a special case, responds to every component of the error, determines the Hamiltonian uniquely, and yields gradients that do not vanish for large orbitalenergy errors. Fine-tuning three Hamiltonian networks on QH9 in this way, which we call FermiScope, reduces the HOMO-LUMO gap error without increasing the element-wise error. The gains carry over to out-of-distribution and molecular-dynamics splits, where the wavefunction-alignment loss helps less.
items.tz: 误差存在的地方：学习到的Kohn-Sham哈密顿量的谱表示
items.az:
Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论（DFT）是计算分子和材料电子结构的标准方法，但其自洽场（SCF）迭代使其在大体系和高通量筛选中成本较高。
基于机器学习的哈密顿量模型提供了一种捷径：一个不变网络在一次前向传播中预测出Kohn-Sham哈密顿量矩阵，对该预测进行对角化可得到轨道能、HOMO-LUMO能隙、分子轨道以及电子密度。
这些模型被训练以逐项匹配参考矩阵，然而仅存在较小的逐项误差并不能保证特征值或特征向量的准确性。
两种融合物理信息的替代方法取得了一定进展：最近提出的一种波函数对齐损失在不进行预测对角化的情况下引入了谱惩罚项，而通过直接监督对角化预测的电子密度来实现对预测的约束。
两者均不完整：通过在参考哈密顿量的本征基中表示预测误差，我们表明每种方法仅看到误差的一部分，且移动预测的轨道能级不会改变电子密度。
相同的分析识别出一个完整的训练信号：累积局域密度态（累积LDOS），即在给定阈值能量以下的每个空间点上的电子数量。
累积局域态密度是一个单一的物理可观测量，它包含电子密度作为特殊情况，对误差的每一个分量都有响应，能唯一确定哈密顿量，并在轨道能量误差较大时产生不消失的梯度。
以这种方式对QH9上的三个哈密顿网络进行微调，我们称之为FermiScope，能够在不增加元素级误差的情况下减小HOMO-LUMO能隙误差。
增益也延伸到了分布外和分子动力学划分中，其中波函数对齐损失的贡献较小。

items.t: Polymorph-Dependent Reconstruction of Excitonic Coupling under Pressure Regulates Room Temperature Phosphorescence
items.a: Pressure-responsive organic room-temperature phosphorescence (RTP) offers a promising platform for optical sensing, information encryption, and anticounterfeiting. Understanding how external mechanical perturbations regulate triplet exciton dynamics in organic crystals remains a fundamental challenge in solid-state photochemistry. Here, density functional theory (DFT) and quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) excited-state calculations are combined to compare the pressure-dependent RTP behavior of ToMoT-α and ToMoT-β. Despite nearly identical emission at ambient pressure, ToMoT-α exhibits a strongly nonmonotonic spectral excursion of 102 nm (449–551 nm), whereas ToMoT-β varies by only 10 nm. This divergence originates from their contrasting anisotropic compressibility and pressure adaptability. Under compression, ToMoT-α undergoes directional lattice relaxation and molecular reorganization, reconstructing intermolecular excitonic coupling and modulating triplet-state decay kinetics, whereas ToMoT-β largely preserves its structure and photophysical properties. These complementary responses support a conceptual dual-polymorph platform for self-referenced pressure readout and recovery-state discrimination. Ambient-pressure reoptimization further suggests that the relative crystal-energy difference can serve as a qualitative descriptor of structural recovery tendency. This work establishes a structure-packing and excited-state relationship for pressure-responsive organic phosphorescence and identifies polymorphism as a strategy for programming RTP responses.
items.v: The Journal of Physical Chemistry Letters
items.tz: 压力下依赖晶型的激子耦合重构调控室温磷光
items.az:
压力响应型有机室温磷光（RTP）为光学传感、信息加密和防伪提供了有前景的平台。
理解外部机械扰动如何调控有机晶体中三重激子动力学仍然是固态光化学中的一个基本挑战。
在这里，密度泛函理论（DFT）和量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）的激发态计算被结合，用于比较ToMoT-α和ToMoT-β在压力依赖下的室温磷光（RTP）行为。
尽管在常压下发射光谱几乎相同，ToMoT-α表现出一个强烈的非单调光谱变化，范围为102 nm（449–551 nm），而ToMoT-β的差异仅为10 nm。
这种差异源于它们在各向异性压缩性和压力适应性上的对比。
在压缩作用下，ToMoT-α 发生方向性的晶格松弛和分子重排，重构了分子间激子耦合并调节三重态衰减动力学，而 ToMoT-β 则 largely 保持其结构和光物理性质。
这些互补响应支持一种概念上的双晶型平台，用于自参考压力读出和恢复态判别。
常压重新优化进一步表明，相对晶体能差可以作为结构恢复倾向的定性描述符。
本工作建立了压力响应有机磷光的结构堆积与激发态之间的关系，并将多晶型性作为编程RTP响应的一种策略。

items.t: Mobilis: an open-source toolkit for charge transport in organic semiconductors, from crystal structures to temperaturedependent mobilities with dynamic disorder and active learning
items.a: Computing a charge mobility for an organic semiconductor involves a chain of steps: monomer site energies, intermolecular couplings, the thermal fluctuation of those couplings, and a transport model whose validity depends on the ratio of coupling to reorganization energy. These steps are usually carried out with separate scripts and different quantum-chemistry codes, which makes results hard to reproduce and models hard to compare. Mobilis is an open-source Python package (GPL-3.0) with a graphical interface and a command-line interface that runs the whole chain from a CIF file or an MD morphology. It prepares and reads Gaussian and ADF calculations (and xtb from the command line), and contains its own extended-Hückel and ZINDO couplings, a polarizable site-energy model, Marcus–Jortner hopping with kinetic Monte Carlo, and transient localization theory. For dynamic disorder it builds coupling surfaces over the six rigidbody intermolecular coordinates and samples them by full-crystal rigid-body molecular dynamics. A Gaussian-process active-learning loop chooses the DFT dimer calculations needed for these surfaces and stops when the posterior uncertainty of the coupling fluctuation σV falls below a target. For pentacene, 24–40 DFT dimers per pair reproduce σV within 4%, against 273 points for a quadratic fit. Chiral molecules in centrosymmetric crystals, such as mer-Alq3 and Ir(III) emitters, are treated by mirror-image fragments. The code is tested by 34 automated test scripts, including an exact-solution check of the kinetic Monte Carlo, and is archived on Zenodo (doi:10.5281/zenodo.23593488).
items.tz: Mobilis：一个用于有机半导体中电荷传输的开源工具包，从晶体结构到温度依赖的迁移率，包含动态无序和主动学习
items.az:
计算有机半导体的电荷迁移率涉及一系列步骤：单体位点能、分子间耦合、这些耦合的热涨落，以及一个其有效性依赖于耦合强度与重构能之比的输运模型。
这些步骤通常通过独立的脚本和不同的量子化学代码完成，导致结果难以复现且模型难以比较。
Mobilis 是一个开源的 Python 包（GPL-3.0），具备图形界面和命令行界面，可从 CIF 文件或 MD 形貌数据运行整个流程。
它准备并读取Gaussian和ADF计算（以及通过命令行执行的xtb），包含其自身的扩展Hückel和ZINDO耦合、极化位能模型、Marcus–Jortner跃迁结合动力学蒙特卡洛方法，以及瞬态局域化理论。
对于动态无序，它在六个刚体分子间坐标上构建耦合表面，并通过全晶体刚体分子动力学对这些坐标进行采样。
一个高斯过程主动学习循环选择这些表面所需的DFT二聚体计算，并在耦合波动的后验不确定性σV降至目标值以下时停止。
对于 pentacene，每对24–40个DFT二聚体可使σV的误差控制在4%以内，而二次拟合需要273个数据点。
中心对称晶体中的手性分子，如mer-Alq3和Ir(III)发射体，采用镜像片段进行处理。
该代码通过了34个自动化测试脚本的检验，包括对动力学蒙特卡洛方法的精确解校验，并已归档于Zenodo（doi:10.5281/zenodo.23593488）。

items.t: Self-Assembly of a Carboxyl -Bipyridinium Zwitterion into a High-Performance Photoswitchable NLO Crystal
items.a: Efficient photoswitchable second-order nonlinear optical (NLO) materials are highly attractive for optical signal processing. However, achieving high-performance switching in molecular crystals remains challenging, requiring simultaneous optimization of response speed (<120 s saturation), modulation depth (∼90%), and operational durability. Here, we report an asymmetric, purely organic carboxylate-bipyridinium salt crystal that satisfies these criteria: peak ON/OFF NLO contrast high up to 95%, saturation within 120 s, and stable cyclability. Upon irradiation, intramolecular electron transfer generates carboxylate-bipyridinium radicals that are molecularly localized yet electronically coupled through cofacial π−π stacking along extended columns. This radical−π coupling broadens visible absorption and enables efficient, reversible switching. The synergy between structurally permitted photoinduced electron transfer and intermolecular radical coupling establishes a design principle for organic photonic switches combining rapid response with high contrast.
items.tz: 羧基-双吡啶两性离子自组装形成一种高性能的光响应非线性光学晶体
items.az:
高效的光响应二级非线性光学（NLO）材料对于光学信号处理具有极大的吸引力。
然而，在分子晶体中实现高性能开关仍具挑战性，需要同时优化响应速度（<120 s饱和）、调制深度（∼90%）和运行耐久性。
在这里，我们报道了一种非对称的、纯有机羧酸盐-双吡啶盐晶体，满足这些条件：峰值开/关非线性光学（NLO）对比度高达95%，饱和时间在120秒以内，并具有稳定的循环性能。
在辐照下，分子内电子转移生成羧酸盐-双吡啶自由基，这些自由基在分子层面被局域化，但通过共面的π−π堆叠沿延伸的柱状结构实现电子耦合。
这种自由基−π耦合拓宽了可见光吸收，并实现了高效且可逆的切换。
结构允许的光诱导电子转移与分子间自由基耦合之间的协同作用，为兼具快速响应与高对比度的有机光子开关设计提供了设计原则。

items.t: Fast and transferable interatomic potential for alloys, compounds, and hydrides in the Fe–Cr–Ni–Ti–H system
items.a: Fast and transferable interatomic potentials are in high demand for atomistic simulations of multicomponent systems, particularly those involving compounds and hydrides. In this work, we present a new classical interatomic model for the Fe–Cr–Ni–Ti–H system in the form of an angular-dependent potential (ADP). The potential accurately reproduces key thermodynamic and kinetic properties, phase stability, elastic properties, defect energetics and migration behavior in different materials: alloys, compounds, and hydrides. Benchmark tests demonstrate that the reported classical potential achieves an accuracy comparable to that of modern machine-learning interatomic models. At the same time, its classical functional form provides high computational efficiency, making the potential well suited for a variety of large-scale simulations involving millions of atoms over extended time scales. As representative examples, we present two large-scale atomistic simulation studies. The first examines strain-induced transformations near a crack tip in Fe-based alloys. The second case investigates hydride formation in FeTi compounds upon exposure to a molecular hydrogen environment. These examples demonstrate that the developed ADP model is capable of capturing complex phenomena in technologically relevant materials.
items.tz: 用于Fe–Cr–Ni–Ti–H体系合金、化合物和氢化物的快速且可迁移的原子间势函数
items.az:
快速且可迁移的原子间势函数对于多组分系统的原子级模拟尤为迫切，特别是涉及化合物和氢化物的情况。
在本工作中，我们提出了一种新的经典原子间模型，用于Fe–Cr–Ni–Ti–H体系，形式为角度依赖势（ADP）。
该势能准确再现了不同材料（合金、化合物和氢化物）中的关键热力学和动力学性质、相稳定性、弹性性质、缺陷能态及迁移行为。
基准测试表明，所报道的经典势能函数的精度与现代机器学习原子间模型相当。
与此同时，其经典函数形式提供了高计算效率，使其非常适合用于涉及数百万原子且时间尺度较长的各种大规模模拟。
作为代表性例子，我们提出了两项大规模原子级模拟研究。
第一个研究了铁基合金裂纹尖端附近的应变诱导相变。
第二种情况研究了在分子氢环境暴露下铁钛化合物中氢化物的形成。
这些例子表明，所发展的ADP模型能够捕捉到在技术相关材料中出现的复杂现象。

items.t: Paired-Isotopologue Hessian Benchmarking for Second-Order Validation of Machine-Learned Water Potentials
items.a: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are commonly validated against energies and forces, yet vibrational predictions depend on the curvature and mode information encoded in the Hessian of the potential-energy surface. Here, we introduce a paired-isotopologue Hessian benchmark for MLIPs using hydrogen-bonded water as a test system. For each MD-sampled water-cluster geometry, a common electronic Hessian is combined with matched HH, DH, and DD mass patterns, enabling the controlled evaluation of vibrational frequencies, normal modes, and isotope responses across nine universal, molecular, and water-specific potentials. Model rankings differ across force-, Hessian-, and vibration-based evaluations, while the paired isotopologue response follows the broad vibrational ordering and remains consistent across structural sources. Beyond global error measures, local coordinate analysis distinguishes Hessian errors with markedly different relevance to specific vibrational observables. Along isotope paths, near-degenerate modes can lose individual mode overlap without a corresponding loss of the vibrational subspace. Together, these results establish Hessian and mode-space validation as necessary complements to energy- and force-based evaluations of MLIPs intended for vibrational calculations.
items.v: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
items.tz: 基于同位素类似物Hessian的基准测试，用于验证机器学习水势能的二阶精度
items.az:
机器学习的原子间势能（MLIPs）通常通过能量和力进行验证，然而振动预测依赖于势能面曲率及模式信息，这些信息编码在势能面的海森矩阵中。
这里，我们引入了一种基于氢键水体系的配对同位素Hessian基准，用于机器学习势函数（MLIPs）的评估。
对于每个MD采样的水团簇几何结构，将一个常见的电子Hessian与匹配的HH、DH和DD质量模式相结合，实现了在九种通用的分子及水特异性势场中对振动频率、正常模式和同位素响应的受控评估。
模型排名在基于力、Hessian和振动的评估中有所不同，而配对同位素响应遵循广泛的振动排序，并在不同结构来源中保持一致。
除了全局误差度量之外，局部坐标分析能够区分哈密顿误差对特定振动可观测量的不同相关性。
沿同位素路径，近简并模式可以失去个体模式重叠，而无需相应失去振动子空间。
这些结果共同确立了Hessian和模式空间验证作为MLIPs在振动计算中应用的能量和力基评估的必要补充。

items.t: The seventh blind test of crystal structure prediction: structure generation methods
items.a: A seventh blind test of crystal structure prediction was organized by the Cambridge Crystallographic Data Centre featuring seven target systems of varying complexity: a silicon and iodine-containing molecule, a copper coordination complex, a near-rigid molecule, a cocrystal, a polymorphic small agrochemical, a highly flexible polymorphic drug candidate, and a polymorphic morpholine salt. In this first of two parts focusing on structure generation methods, many crystal structure prediction (CSP) methods performed well for the small but flexible agrochemical compound, successfully reproducing the experimentally observed crystal structures, while few groups were successful for the systems of higher complexity. A powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) assisted exercise demonstrated the use of CSP in successfully determining a crystal structure from a low-quality PXRD pattern. The use of CSP in the prediction of likely cocrystal stoichiometry was also explored, demonstrating multiple possible approaches. Crystallographic disorder emerged as an important theme throughout the test as both a challenge for analysis and a major achievement where two groups blindly predicted the existence of disorder for the first time. Additionally, large-scale comparisons of the sets of predicted crystal structures also showed that some methods yield sets that largely contain the same crystal structures.
items.v: Acta Crystallographica Section B Structural Science Crystal Engineering and Mate
items.tz: 晶体结构预测的第七次盲测：结构生成方法
items.az:
由剑桥晶体学数据中心组织的第七次盲测晶体结构预测，涉及七个复杂程度不同的目标体系：含硅和碘的分子、铜配位化合物、近刚性分子、共晶、一种近似单态的小农用化学品、一种高度灵活的多晶药物候选物，以及一种多晶吗啉盐。
在本文第一部分关于结构生成方法的探讨中，多种晶体结构预测（CSP）方法对小而灵活的农药化合物表现良好，成功重现了实验观测到的晶体结构，而对于更复杂的体系，仅有少数研究组取得了成功。
一种粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）辅助的实验表明，晶体结构预测（CSP）可用于从低质量的PXRD图谱中成功确定晶体结构。
晶体结构预测在预测可能的共晶化学计量比方面的应用也得到了探索，展示了多种可能的方法。
晶体学无序在测试过程中成为一个重要的主题，既是对分析的挑战，也是重大成就，其中两组研究人员首次盲目预测了无序的存在。
此外，对预测晶体结构集合的大规模比较也显示，某些方法产生的结构集合 largely 包含相同的晶体结构。
items.tw: 作者：Claire S. Adjiman；期刊在重点名单

items.t: The seventh blind test of crystal structure prediction: structure ranking methods
items.a: A seventh blind test of crystal structure prediction has been organized by the Cambridge Crystallographic Data Centre. The results are presented in two parts, with this second part focusing on methods for ranking crystal structures in order of stability. The exercise involved standardized sets of structures seeded from a range of structure generation methods. Participants from 22 groups applied several periodic DFT-D methods, machine learned potentials, force fields derived from empirical data or quantum chemical calculations, and various combinations of the above. In addition, one non-energy-based scoring function was used. Results showed that periodic DFT-D methods overall agreed with experimental data within expected error margins, while one machine learned model, applying system-specific AIMnet potentials, agreed with experiment in many cases demonstrating promise as an efficient alternative to DFT-based methods. For target XXXII, a consensus was reached across periodic DFT methods, with consistently high predicted energies of experimental forms relative to the global minimum (above 4 kJ mol −1 at both low and ambient temperatures) suggesting a more stable polymorph is likely not yet observed. The calculation of free energies at ambient temperatures offered improvement of predictions only in some cases (for targets XXVII and XXXI). Several avenues for future research have been suggested, highlighting the need for greater efficiency considering the vast amounts of resources utilized in many cases.
items.v: Acta Crystallographica Section B Structural Science Crystal Engineering and Mate
items.tz: 晶体结构预测的第七次盲测：结构排序方法
items.az:
由剑桥晶体学数据中心组织了第七次晶体结构预测的盲测。
结果分为两部分，第二部分重点介绍用于对晶体结构按稳定性进行排序的方法。
该研究涉及从多种结构生成方法中筛选出的标准结构集合。
来自22个小组的参与者应用了多种周期性DFT-D方法、机器学习势能、基于经验数据或量子化学计算导出的力场，以及上述方法的各种组合。
此外，使用了一个非基于能量的评分函数。
结果表明，周期性DFT-D方法总体上在预期误差范围内与实验数据一致，而一个应用系统特定AIMnet势能的机器学习模型在许多情况下与实验结果相符，显示出作为基于DFT方法的有效替代方案的潜力。
对于目标XXXII，周期性DFT方法达成了共识，其预测的实验形式相对于全局最小值的能量始终较高（在低温和常温下均高于4 kJ mol⁻¹），表明更稳定的晶型可能尚未被观测到。
在常温下的自由能计算仅在某些情况下（针对目标XXVII和XXXI）提高了预测精度。
已提出若干条未来研究方向，强调在许多情况下由于消耗了大量资源，需要提高效率。

items.t: PET-MAD as a lightweight universal interatomic potential for advanced materials modeling
items.a: Machine-learning interatomic potentials have greatly extended the reach of atomic-scale simulations, offering the accuracy of first-principles calculations at a fraction of the cost. Leveraging large quantum mechanical databases and expressive architectures, recent universal models deliver qualitative accuracy across the periodic table but are often biased toward low-energy configurations. We introduce PET-MAD, a generally applicable interatomic potential trained on a dataset combining stable inorganic and organic solids, systematically modified to enhance atomic diversity. Using a moderate but thoroughly consistent level of electronic-structure theory, we assess PET-MAD's accuracy on established benchmarks and advanced simulations of six materials. Despite the small training set and lightweight architecture, PET-MAD is competitive with the state-of-the-art machine-learned interatomic potentials for inorganic solids, while also being reliable for molecules, organic materials, and surfaces. It is stable and fast, enabling the near-quantitative study of thermal and quantum mechanical fluctuations, functional properties, and phase transitions out of the box. It can be efficiently fine-tuned to deliver full quantum mechanical accuracy with a minimal number of targeted calculations.
items.tz: PET-MAD作为一种轻量级的通用原子间势函数，用于先进材料建模
items.az:
机器学习原子间势能极大地扩展了原子尺度模拟的范围，以极少的成本实现了第一性原理计算的准确性。
借助大规模量子力学数据库和强大的架构，最近的通用模型在周期表范围内实现了定性准确性，但通常倾向于低能构型。
我们提出了PET-MAD，一种基于结合了稳定无机和有机固体数据集的通用原子间势函数，经过系统性修改以增强原子多样性。
使用一种中等但充分一致的电子结构理论，我们评估了PET-MAD在六个材料的已建立基准和高级模拟中的准确性。
尽管训练集较小且架构轻量，PET-MAD 在无机固体的机器学习原子势方面与当前最先进的方法具有竞争力，同时对分子、有机材料和表面也表现出可靠性。
它稳定且快速，能够原生实现对热波动和量子力学波动、功能性质以及相变的近定量研究。
它可以被高效地微调，以在极少的针对性计算中实现全量子力学精度。
items.tw: 作者：Michele Ceriotti；期刊在重点名单

items.t: Porous isoreticular non-metal organic frameworks
items.a: Abstract Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) are useful synthetic materials that are built by the programmed assembly of metal nodes and organic linkers1. The success of MOFs results from the isoreticular principle2, which allows families of structurally analogous frameworks to be built in a predictable way. This relies on directional coordinate covalent bonding to define the framework geometry. However, isoreticular strategies do not translate to other common crystalline solids, such as organic salts3–5, in which the intermolecular ionic bonding is less directional. Here we show that chemical knowledge can be combined with computational crystal-structure prediction6(CSP) to design porous organic ammonium halide salts that contain no metals. The nodes in these salt frameworks are tightly packed ionic clusters that direct the materials to crystallize in specific ways, as demonstrated by the presence of well-defined spikes of low-energy, low-density isoreticular structures on the predicted lattice energy landscapes7,8. These energy landscapes allow us to select combinations of cations and anions that will form thermodynamically stable, porous salt frameworks with channel sizes, functionalities and geometries that can be predicted a priori. Some of these porous salts adsorb molecular guests such as iodine in quantities that exceed those of most MOFs, and this could be useful for applications such as radio-iodine capture9–12. More generally, the synthesis of these salts is scalable, involving simple acid–base neutralization, and the strategy makes it possible to create a family of non-metal organic frameworks that combine high ionic charge density with permanent porosity.
items.tz: 多孔等网状非金属有机框架
items.az:
摘要 金属有机框架（MOFs）是具有实用价值的合成材料，由金属节点和有机连接体的程序化组装构成1。
MOFs的成功源于等孔道原理2，该原理使得结构相似的框架家族能够以可预测的方式构建。
这依赖于方向性坐标共价键来定义框架几何结构。
然而，等孔道策略并不能推广到其他常见的结晶固体，例如有机盐3–5，其中分子间的离子键方向性较弱。
这里我们展示了化学知识可以与计算晶体结构预测（CSP）相结合，设计出不含金属的多孔有机铵卤化物盐。
这些盐框架中的节点是由紧密堆积的离子簇构成，它们引导材料以特定方式结晶，这一点从预测晶格能景观中存在明确的低能量、低密度等网状结构尖峰可以得到验证7,8。
这些能垒景观使我们能够选择阳离子和阴离子的组合，形成在热力学上稳定的、具有可预先预测的孔道尺寸、功能和几何结构的多孔盐框架。
一些这些多孔盐对分子客体（如碘）的吸附量超过大多数金属有机框架材料（MOFs），这可能在诸如放射性碘捕获等应用中具有用途。
更一般地，这些盐的合成具有可扩展性，涉及简单的酸碱中和反应，该策略使得能够制备一类非金属有机框架材料，其兼具高离子电荷密度与永久孔隙性。

items.t: Modelling atomic and nanoscale structure in the silicon–oxygen system through active machine learning
items.a: Silicon-oxygen compounds are among the most important ones in the natural sciences, occurring as building blocks in minerals and being used in semiconductors and catalysis. Beyond the well-known silicon dioxide, there are phases with different stoichiometric composition and nanostructured composites. One of the key challenges in understanding the Si-O system is therefore to accurately account for its nanoscale heterogeneity beyond the length scale of individual atoms. Here we show that a unified computational description of the full Si-O system is indeed possible, based on atomistic machine learning coupled to an active-learning workflow. We showcase applications to very-high-pressure silica, to surfaces and aerogels, and to the structure of amorphous silicon monoxide. In a wider context, our work illustrates how structural complexity in functional materials beyond the atomic and few-nanometre length scales can be captured with active machine learning.
items.tz: 通过主动机器学习在硅–氧体系中建模原子和纳米尺度结构
items.az:
硅-氧化合物是自然科学研究中最重要的化合物之一，存在于矿物的结构单元中，并被用于半导体和催化领域。
除了众所周知的二氧化硅之外，还存在具有不同化学计量比和纳米结构复合物的相。
因此，理解Si-O体系的一个关键挑战在于准确考虑其纳米尺度的异质性，这一尺度超越了单个原子的长度尺度。
我们证明，基于原子级机器学习结合主动学习工作流，确实可以对整个Si-O体系进行统一的计算描述。
我们展示了其在超高压下硅酸盐、表面和气凝胶，以及非晶硅氧化物结构方面的应用。
在更广泛的意义上，我们的工作展示了如何利用主动机器学习捕捉功能材料中超越原子尺度和几纳米长度尺度的结构复杂性。
items.tw: 作者：Volker L. Deringer；期刊在重点名单

items.t: Roadmap for the development of machine learning-based interatomic potentials
items.a: Abstract An interatomic potential, traditionally regarded as a mathematical function, serves to depict atomic interactions within molecules or solids by expressing potential energy concerning atom positions. These potentials are pivotal in materials science and engineering, facilitating atomic-scale simulations, predictive material behavior, accelerated discovery, and property optimization. Notably, the landscape is evolving with machine learning transcending conventional mathematical models. Various machine learning-based interatomic potentials, such as artificial neural networks, kernel-based methods, deep learning, and physics-informed models, have emerged, each wielding unique strengths and limitations. These methods decode the intricate connection between atomic configurations and potential energies, offering advantages like precision, adaptability, insights, and seamless integration. The transformative potential of machine learning-based interatomic potentials looms large in materials science and engineering. They promise tailor-made materials discovery and optimized properties for specific applications. Yet, formidable challenges persist, encompassing data quality, computational demands, transferability, interpretability, and robustness. Tackling these hurdles is imperative for nurturing accurate, efficient, and dependable machine learning-based interatomic potentials primed for widespread adoption in materials science and engineering. This roadmap offers an appraisal of the current machine learning-based interatomic potential landscape, delineates the associated challenges, and envisages how progress in this domain can empower atomic-scale modeling of the composition-processing-microstructure-property relationship, underscoring its significance in materials science and engineering.
items.v: Modelling and Simulation in Materials Science and Engineering
items.tz: 机器学习基于原子势能的发展路线图
items.az:
摘要 一种原子间势能，传统上被视为一个数学函数，通过表达与原子位置相关的势能来描述分子或固体中原子间的相互作用。
这些势函数在材料科学与工程中至关重要，有助于实现原子尺度模拟、预测材料行为、加速发现过程以及性能优化。
值得注意的是，该领域正随着机器学习超越传统数学模型而不断发展。
各种基于机器学习的原子间势能，如人工神经网络、基于核的方法、深度学习和物理信息模型，已相继出现，每种方法都具有独特的优点和局限性。
这些方法解码了原子构型与势能之间的复杂关联，具有精度高、适应性强、信息丰富以及无缝集成等优势。
基于机器学习的原子间势能的变革性潜力在材料科学与工程领域显得尤为突出。
它们有望实现定制材料的发现以及为特定应用优化性能。
然而，严峻的挑战依然存在，包括数据质量、计算需求、可迁移性、可解释性和鲁棒性。
克服这些障碍对于培育准确、高效且可靠的机器学习基互作用势至关重要，这些势函数有望在材料科学和工程领域得到广泛应用。
这条路线图对当前基于机器学习的原子间势能景观进行了评估，阐明了相关挑战，并展望了该领域的发展如何赋能材料组成-加工-微观结构-性能关系的原子级建模，突显其在材料科学与工程中的重要意义。

items.t: Computationally guided synthesis of a hierarchical [4[2+3]+6] porous organic ‘cage of cages’
items.a: Abstract Here we report a two-step, hierarchical synthesis that assembles a trigonal prismatic organic cage into a more symmetric, higher-order tetrahedral cage, or ‘cage of cages’. Both the preformed [2+3] trigonal prismatic cage building blocks and the resultant tetrahedral [4[2+3]+6]cage molecule are constructed using ether bridges. This strategy affords the [4[2+3]+6]cage molecule excellent hydrolytic stability that is not a feature of more common dynamic cage linkers, such as imines. Despite its relatively high molar mass (3,001 g mol −1 ), [4[2+3]+6]cage exhibits good solubility and crystallizes into a porous superstructure with a surface area of 1,056 m 2 g −1 . By contrast, the [2+3] building block is not porous. The [4[2+3]+6]cage molecule shows high CO 2 and SF 6 uptakes due to its polar skeleton. The preference for the [4[2+3]+6]cage molecule over other cage products can be predicted by computational modelling, as can its porous crystal packing, suggesting a broader design strategy for the hierarchical assembly of organic cages with synthetically engineered functions.
items.tz: 基于计算指导的分层[4[2+3]+6]多孔有机“笼中笼”合成
items.az:
摘要 我们报道了一种两步、分层的合成方法，将一个三棱柱形有机笼组装成一种对称性更高、更高级的四面体笼，即“笼中笼”。
既有的[2+3]三棱柱笼状构筑单元以及生成的四面体[4[2+3]+6]笼分子均通过醚桥连接构建。
该策略使得[4[2+3]+6]笼分子表现出优异的水解稳定性，而这一特性在更常见的动态笼连接基团（如亚胺）中并不具备。
尽管其摩尔质量相对较高（3,001 g mol⁻¹），[4[2+3]+6]笼体表现出良好的溶解性，并结晶为一种比表面积为1,056 m² g⁻¹的多孔超结构。
相比之下，[2+3]构建块不具有孔隙结构。
[4[2+3]+6]笼分子由于其极性骨架，表现出对CO₂和SF₆的高吸附能力。
[4[2+3]+6]笼分子相较于其他笼状产物的偏好可以通过计算建模预测，其多孔晶体堆积也可以被预测，这表明有机笼状分子的分层组装具有更广泛的设计策略，可用于合成功能工程。
items.tw: 作者：Graeme M. Day、Kim E. Jelfs

items.t: Ten-electron count rule for the binding of adsorbates on single-atom alloy catalysts
items.a: Single-atom alloys have recently emerged as highly active and selective alloy catalysts. Unlike pure metals, single-atom alloys escape the well-established conceptual framework developed nearly three decades ago for predicting catalytic performance. Although this offers the opportunity to explore so far unattainable chemistries, this leaves us without a simple guide for the design of single-atom alloys able to catalyse targeted reactions. Here, based on thousands of density functional theory calculations, we reveal a 10-electron count rule for the binding of adsorbates on the dopant atoms, usually the active sites, of single-atom alloy surfaces. A simple molecular orbital approach rationalizes this rule and the nature of the adsorbate-dopant interaction. In addition, our intuitive model can accelerate the rational design of single-atom alloy catalysts. Indeed, we illustrate how the unique insights provided by the electron count rule help identify the most promising dopant for an industrially relevant hydrogenation reaction, thereby reducing the number of potential materials by more than one order of magnitude.
items.tz: 十电子计数规则用于单原子合金催化剂上吸附物的结合
items.az:
单原子合金最近涌现出作为高效且选择性的合金催化剂。
不同于纯金属，单原子合金摆脱了近三十年前为预测催化性能而建立的成熟概念框架。
尽管这为我们探索迄今无法实现的化学提供了机会，但这使我们缺乏一个简单指南来设计能够催化特定反应的单原子合金。
在此，基于数千次密度泛函理论计算，我们揭示了吸附物在单原子合金表面掺杂原子（通常是活性位点）上的10电子计数规则。
一种简单的分子轨道方法阐明了这一规则以及吸附剂-掺杂剂相互作用的性质。
此外，我们的直观模型可以加速单原子合金催化剂的理性设计。
确实，我们展示了电子数规则所提供的独特见解如何帮助识别工业相关氢化反应中最有前景的掺杂剂，从而将潜在材料的数量减少超过一个数量级。
items.tw: 作者：Angelos Michaelides；期刊在重点名单

items.t: Uncertainty quantification by direct propagation of shallow ensembles
items.a: Abstract Statistical learning algorithms provide a generally-applicable framework to sidestep time-consuming experiments, or accurate physics-based modeling, but they introduce a further source of error on top of the intrinsic limitations of the experimental or theoretical setup. Uncertainty estimation is essential to quantify this error, and to make application of data-centric approaches more trustworthy. To ensure that uncertainty quantification is used widely, one should aim for algorithms that are accurate, but also easy to implement and apply. In particular, including uncertainty quantification on top of an existing architecture should be straightforward, and add minimal computational overhead. Furthermore, it should be easy to manipulate or combine multiple machine-learning predictions, propagating uncertainty over further modeling steps. We compare several well-established uncertainty quantification frameworks against these requirements, and propose a practical approach, which we dub direct propagation of shallow ensembles, that provides a good compromise between ease of use and accuracy. We present benchmarks for generic datasets, and an in-depth study of applications to the field of atomistic machine learning for chemistry and materials. These examples underscore the importance of using a formulation that allows propagating errors without making strong assumptions on the correlations between different predictions of the model.
items.tz: 通过浅层集成模型的直接传播进行不确定性量化
items.az:
抽象统计学习算法提供了一种普遍适用的框架，以避免耗时的实验或基于物理的精确建模，但它们在实验或理论设置的固有局限之上引入了额外的误差源。
不确定性估计对于量化这一误差至关重要，从而使基于数据的方法更加可信。
为确保不确定性量化被广泛使用，应致力于开发既准确又易于实现和应用的算法。
特别是，在现有架构上加入不确定性量化应是直接可行的，并且仅带来极小的计算开销。
此外，应该很容易对或组合多个机器学习预测进行操作，并将不确定性传播到后续的建模步骤中。
我们将几种成熟的不确定性量化框架与这些要求进行对比，并提出一种实用方法，我们称之为浅层集合的直接传播，该方法在易用性与准确性之间提供了良好的平衡。
我们提供了通用数据集的基准测试，并对原子级机器学习在化学和材料领域的应用进行了深入研究。
这些例子强调了使用一种能够传播误差的公式的重要性，而无需对模型不同预测之间的相关性做出强烈假设。

items.t: The Acridine Polymorph Landscape: Characterization and Selective Control by Additives
items.a: Polymorphism in molecular crystals presents a major challenge for controlling crystallization. Here, we combine experiment and theory to characterize the polymorph landscape of acridine and investigate its selective control by additives. Melt crystallization experiments resolve the previously unknown structure of form VIII, while topological crystal structure prediction recovers all seven known unsolvated polymorphs with determined crystal structures. Combining a fine-tuned machine-learned interatomic potential with anharmonic free energy calculations reproduces the experimentally observed stability relationships and reveals a shallow free energy landscape. Finally, experimentally observed additive-induced polymorph preferences correlate with mixed-crystal substitutional defect energies and topological similarities between additive and acridine crystal structures. Together, these results provide a comprehensive picture of acridine polymorphism, linking crystal structure, thermodynamic stability, and additive-controlled crystallization.
items.tz: 吩嗪多晶型图谱：添加剂对多晶型的表征与选择性调控
items.az:
分子晶体中的多晶型现象给结晶过程的控制带来了重大挑战。
在这里，我们结合实验与理论，表征吖啶的多晶型图谱，并研究添加剂对其选择性调控的作用。
熔融结晶实验揭示了形式VIII的 previously unknown 结构，而拓扑晶体结构预测则恢复了所有七个已知的无溶剂多晶型物及其确定的晶体结构。
结合一种微调的机器学习原子间势与非谐自由能计算，重现了实验观测到的稳定性关系，并揭示了一个浅的自由能景观。
最后，实验观测到的添加剂诱导的多晶型偏好与混合晶体取代缺陷能以及添加剂和吖啶晶体结构之间的拓扑相似性相关。
这些结果共同提供了吖啶多晶型的全面图景，将晶体结构、热力学稳定性以及添加剂控制的结晶过程联系起来。
items.tw: 预印本或来源不明；作者不在关注名单

items.t: Chiral Octahedral Metallomesogens with Δ/Λ Core Chirality: Extending Wallach's Rule from Crystals to Liquid Crystals
items.a: Chirality often induces marked structural changes in liquid crystals (LCs) and can even induce new phases. Where chirality resides in a mesogen is thus a fundamental question, but because mesogens favor planar structures, the effect of chirality at the molecular center (core chirality) on their assemblies has remained poorly understood. This Account explores this question with the octahedral tris(β-diketonato) family M-Cn (M = Ru, Ir), whose Δ/Λ configuration proves to be a decisive design element. Enantiopure Ru-C8 builds helical hexagonal columns, whereas its racemate assembles ΔΛ-alternating paired columns, and longer alkyl chains switch the system to a micellar cubic phase. Strikingly, the racemate is the more stable form: Wallach’s rule, known for crystals, also governs the LC state. This Δ–Λ recognition can be harnessed: pairing Δ-Ru-Cn with Λ-Ir-Cn gives quasi-racemic LCs with emergent chiroptical properties, such as stereoselectively enhanced vibrational circular dichroism.
items.tz: 具有Δ/Λ核心手性的八面体金属介晶材料：将Wallach规则从晶体扩展到液晶
items.az:
手性常常在液晶（LCs）中引起显著的结构变化，甚至可以诱导出新的相。
因此，手性在向列相分子中的存在是一个基本问题，但由于向列相分子倾向于形成平面结构，其分子中心（核心手性）的手性对它们自组装行为的影响仍理解不足。
本文探讨了这一问题，以八面体三(β-二酮配体)家族M-Cn（M = Ru, Ir）为例，其Δ/Λ构型被证明是关键的设计要素。
手性纯的Ru-C8形成螺旋状六边形柱状结构，而其外消旋体则组装成ΔΛ交替配对的柱状结构，更长的烷基链会使体系转变为微乳状立方相。
令人惊讶的是，外消旋体是更稳定的形态：Wallach规则，适用于晶体，也适用于液晶态。
这种Δ–Λ识别可以被利用：将Δ-Ru-Cn与Λ-Ir-Cn配对得到近似外消旋的液晶，表现出新兴的手性光学性质，例如选择性增强的振动圆二色性。

items.t: Pharmacophore-Conditioned Diffusion Model for Ligand-Based De Novo Drug Design
items.a: Developing bioactive molecules remains a central, time- and cost-heavy challenge in drug discovery, particularly for novel targets lacking structural or functional data. Pharmacophore modeling presents an alternative for capturing the key features required for molecular bioactivity against a biological target. In this work, we present PharmaDiff, a pharmacophore-conditioned diffusion model for 3D molecular generation. PharmaDiff employs a transformer-based architecture to integrate an atom-based representation of the 3D pharmacophore into the generative process, enabling the precise generation of 3D molecular graphs that align with predefined pharmacophore hypotheses. Through comprehensive testing, PharmaDiff demonstrates superior performance in matching 3D pharmacophore constraints compared to ligand-based drug design methods. Additionally, it achieves higher docking scores across a range of proteins in structure-based drug design, without the need for target protein structures. By integrating pharmacophore modeling with 3D generative techniques, PharmaDiff offers a powerful and flexible framework for rational drug design.
items.v: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
items.tz: 基于药效团条件的扩散模型用于基于配体的从头药物设计
items.az:
开发具有生物活性的分子仍然是药物发现中的核心挑战，尤其对于缺乏结构或功能数据的新靶点而言，这一过程耗时且成本高昂。
药效团建模为捕捉分子对生物靶标所必需的关键特征提供了另一种途径。
在本工作中，我们提出了PharmaDiff，一种基于药效团条件的三维分子生成扩散模型。
PharmaDiff 采用基于变压器的架构，将基于原子的三维药效团表示整合到生成过程中，从而精确生成与预定义药效团假设相一致的三维分子图。
通过全面测试，PharmaDiff 在匹配三维药效团约束方面相比基于配体的药物设计方法表现出更优越的性能。
此外，它在基于结构的药物设计中对一系列蛋白质实现了更高的对接分数，而无需目标蛋白的结构信息。
通过将药效团建模与3D生成技术相结合，PharmaDiff 提供了一个强大且灵活的理性药物设计框架。

items.t: Physics-Inspired Generative Deep Learning with Application to RNA Structure Prediction
items.a: Biomolecular structure is often treated as a single native conformation, but many molecular systems are more accurately described as thermodynamic ensembles of interconverting structures. This thesis develops a probabilistic generative modeling framework for learning such ensembles from limited molecular data. The central premise is that generative models are most effective for molecular science when physical inductive biases are included. The thesis begins by benchmarking existing classes of probabilistic generative models on molecular data and distributions with tunable dimensionality. These comparisons identify denoising diffusion probabilistic models as especially capable for the moderate-dimensional, multimodal landscapes common in molecular systems. Building on that result, the next study shows that diffusion models trained on replica exchange molecular dynamics data can extrapolate to temperatures not present in the training set. The core methodological contribution, the Thermodynamic Maps framework, represents physical temperature in a diffusion model. This adjustment enables precise thermodynamic extrapolation from sparse data and is validated on both the Ising model and RNA conformational sampling. The framework is then extended to \textit{ab initio} RNA ensemble prediction in RNAnneal, where hierarchical structure generation, thermodynamic scoring, and physics-grounded ranking are combined to recover three-dimensional RNA conformational ensembles from sequence alone. A complementary application, DiffDock-Glide, demonstrates that a similar physics- and data-driven pipeline improves molecular docking and virtual screening outcomes. Together, these studies demonstrate that generative models can extrapolate from highly limited data when provided physical and chemical inductive biases.
