items.tz: 基于物理启发的生成式深度学习及其在RNA结构预测中的应用
items.az:
生物分子结构通常被视为单一的天然构象，但许多分子体系更准确地描述为热力学ensemble中的相互转化结构。
本论文提出了一种概率生成建模框架，用于从有限的分子数据中学习此类集合。
核心观点是，当包含物理归纳偏见时，生成模型在分子科学中的效果最为显著。
该论文首先在分子数据和可调维度分布上对现有类概率生成模型进行基准测试。
这些比较表明，去噪扩散概率模型特别适用于分子系统中常见的中等维度、多模态景观。
在此基础上，下一步的研究表明，基于复制交换分子动力学数据训练的扩散模型可以外推到训练集中未出现的温度。
核心方法论贡献，即热力学地图框架，将物理温度表示在扩散模型中。
这一调整使得从稀疏数据中进行精确的热力学外推成为可能，并在伊辛模型和RNA构象采样中得到了验证。
该框架随后被扩展至RNAnneal中的从头RNA构象集合预测，其中层次结构生成、热力学打分和基于物理的排序相结合，仅从序列信息即可恢复三维RNA构象集合。
一个互补的应用，DiffDock-Glide，表明一种类似的基于物理原理和数据驱动的流程能够提升分子对接和虚拟筛选的结果。
这些研究共同表明，当提供物理和化学的归纳偏见时，生成模型可以从高度有限的数据中进行外推。

items.t: Crystal Structure of the Chiral Iron(II) Δ-[FeCl{(R,R)-Me-Duphos(O)2}2](BF4)·CH2Cl2 Compound
items.a: The development of sustainable catalysts is key in green chemistry to reduce environmental impact. More concretely, iron oxophosphine compounds are of great interest in green chemistry mainly because of the high abundance of iron in the Earth's crust and the high air stability of oxophosphine ligands. In enantioselective homogeneous catalysis, designing iron compounds with enantiopure oxophosphines is highly attractive. In this work, the molecular structure of Δ-[FeCl{(R,R)-Me-Duphos(O)2}2](BF4)·CH2Cl2 is reported. This compound was formed by O2-promoted oxidation of the [FeH(η2-H2){(R,R)-Me-Duphos}2]+ complex in dichloromethane and identified crystallographically. The compound crystallizes in the monoclinic and non-centrosymmetric P21 space group a= 9.6736(3) Å, b=21.4227(6) Å, c= 11.6065(3) Å, α=γ=90º, β =109.487(3), V=2267.49(12) Å3, Z=4. The structure contains a pentacoordinated Fe(II) cation, a BF4- anion, and a molecule of CH2Cl2. The cation shows a κ4O,κCl coordination environment within a distorted square pyramidal geometry. This structure was compared with those of related compounds and with the structure obtained from density functional theory (DFT) calculations. To gain deeper insight into the bonding interactions within the iron compound, crystal packing, Hirshfeld surface analyses, and two-dimensional (2D) fingerprint plots were conducted. The findings reveal that the crystal packing is predominantly influenced by van der Waals interactions and weak to moderate H⋯H and halogen⋯H contacts, which do not play a significant role in the compound's structural configuration. Overall, we report the first example of an enantiomerically pure iron compound bearing the chiral (R,R)-Me-Duphos(O)2 ligand, isolated as an enantiomerically pure crystal.
items.tz: 化合物 Chiral 铁(II) Δ-[FeCl{(R,R)-Me-Duphos(O)2}2](BF4)·CH2Cl2 的晶体结构
items.az:
在绿色化学中，开发可持续催化剂对于减少环境影响至关重要。
更具体地说，铁氧化磷配体化合物在绿色化学中具有重要价值，主要得益于铁在地壳中的丰富储量以及氧化磷配体的高空气稳定性。
在手性均相催化中，设计具有对映纯氧磷ine的铁化合物极具吸引力。
本文报道了Δ-[FeCl{(R,R)-Me-Duphos(O)₂}₂](BF₄)·CH₂Cl₂的分子结构。
该化合物通过二氯甲烷中O2促进[FeH(η2-H2){(R,R)-Me-Duphos}2]+复盐的氧化反应制得，并经晶体学方法鉴定。
该化合物形成单斜且非中心对称的P21空间群，a = 9.6736(3) Å，b = 21.4227(6) Å，c = 11.6065(3) Å，α = γ = 90º，β = 109.487(3)，V = 2267.49(12) Å³，Z = 4。
该结构包含一个五配位的 Fe(II) 阳离子、一个 BF4- 阴离子和一个 CH2Cl2 分子。
阳离子表现出一种κ4O、κCl配位环境，位于畸变的方形锥几何结构中。
该结构与相关化合物的结构以及从密度泛函理论（DFT）计算得到的结构进行了比较。
为深入理解铁化合物中的成键相互作用、晶体堆积、Hirshfeld 表面分析以及二维（2D）指纹图谱，进行了相关研究。
研究结果表明，晶体堆积主要受范德华相互作用以及弱至中等强度的H⋯H和卤素⋯H接触影响，这些相互作用在化合物的结构构型中并不起显著作用。
总体而言，我们报道了首个具有手性(R,R)-Me-Duphos(O)2配体的纯对映体铁化合物，以纯对映体晶体形式分离。

items.t: Crystal structure and Hirshfeld surface analysis of ethyl 4-hydroxy-1-methyl-5-oxo-2-(thiophen-2-yl)-2,5-dihydro-1 H -pyrrole-3-carboxylate
items.a: The molecular and crystal structure of the title compound, C 12 H 13 NO 4 S, has been determined via single-crystal X-ray diffraction. As the compound crystallizes in the centrosymmetric space group P 2 1 / c , the crystal is racemic and contains equal numbers of R and S enantiomers related by inversion symmetry. The thiophene substituent is positionally disordered over two orientations arising from rotation about the C4—C5 bond, with refined site occupancies of 0.929 (2) and 0.071 (2) for the major and minor components, respectively. The major thiophene ring is essentially planar and adopts a nearly orthogonal orientation with respect to the conjugated enaminone fragment. In the crystal packing, the title molecules are linked by intermolecular O—H...O hydrogen bonds to form one-dimensional chains, which are further supported by weak C—H...O interactions, giving rise to a three-dimensional supramolecular architecture. Hirshfeld surface analysis quantitatively revealed that the crystal packing is predominantly governed by H...H (41.5%) and H...O/O...H (31.0%) contacts, with smaller contributions from other intermolecular interactions.
items.v: Acta Crystallographica Section E Crystallographic Communications
items.tz: 乙基 4-羟基-1-甲基-5-氧代-2-(噻吩-2-基)-2,5-二氢-1H-吡咯-3-羧酸酯的晶体结构与Hirshfeld表面分析
items.az:
题目化合物 C₁₂H₁₃NO₄S 的分子结构和晶体结构通过单晶X射线衍射确定。
该化合物在中心对称空间群 P 2₁/c 中结晶，晶体为外消旋体，包含数量相等的R和S对映体，二者通过反演对称性相关。
噻吩取代基由于围绕C4—C5键的旋转而在两个取向上发生位置无序，主要和次要组分的精修位占有率分别为0.929 (2) 和 0.071 (2)。
主要的噻吩环基本上是平面的，并且与共轭的烯胺酮片段呈近似正交的取向。
在晶体堆积中，标题分子通过分子间O—H...O氢键连接形成一维链，这些链进一步由弱的C—H...O相互作用稳定，构建出三维的超分子结构。
Hirshfeld表面分析定量表明，晶体堆积主要由H...H（41.5%）和H...O/O...H（31.0%）相互作用决定，其他分子间相互作用的贡献较小。

items.t: Adaptive Ferroic Bi‐Sb Hybrid Iodides for Multi‐Modal Energy Harvesting and Phototronics
items.a: Organic–inorganic hybrid halides offer a versatile platform for programmable multimodal functionalities, through structural softness and lattice‐charge coupling, despite the challenge of balancing the competing ferroic order, carrier transport, and thermal stability requirements. We present a composition‐driven lattice engineering strategy in a 1D iodide series based on 1,6‐diaminohexane (HDA), comprising orthorhombic non‐centrosymmetric phases of HDABiI 5 (HBI) and HDASbI 5 (HSI) together with a lower‐symmetry non‐centrosymmetric monoclinic phase of HDABi 0.5 Sb 0.5 I 5 (HBSI) identified by its birefringent response, allowing systematic control of symmetry, lattice dynamics, and coupled transport phenomena. Through variable‐temperature crystallography and 1 H NMR, multi‐perturbation Raman spectroscopy, scanning probe microscopy, photophysical measurements, and electronic structure calculations, we demonstrate a progression from a rigid Bi‐dominated lattice exhibiting strong piezoelectric and ferroelectric coupling to a softer Sb‐rich framework with enhanced anharmonicity, pyroelectricity, and photonic activity, while HBSI combines efficient thermal robustness and phonon transport. Density functional theory calculations show that Bi/Sb substitution tunes the electronic structure from indirect to direct bandgap, modulates oscillator strength, spontaneous polarization, pressure‐dependent electronic properties, thermoelectric and piezoelectric responses, while preserving low iodine‐vacancy formation energies. A trilayer HBI‐HSI‐HBSI architecture couples piezoelectric, triboelectric, pyroelectric, thermoelectric, ferroelectric, and photonic effects, showing 5.1‐fold synergistic enhancement in current generation through interfacial polarization and multimodal coupling.
items.tz: 用于多模式能量收集和光电子学的自适应铁电性Bi-Sb杂化碘化物
items.az:
有机-无机杂化卤化物通过结构柔性与晶格电荷耦合，提供了一个可编程的多模式功能平台，尽管在平衡铁性有序、载流子传输和热稳定性要求方面存在挑战。
我们提出了一种基于1,6-二氨基己烷（HDA）的1D碘化物系列中的组分驱动晶格工程策略，该策略包含HDABiI₅（HBI）和HDASbI₅（HSI）的正交非中心对称相，以及通过双折射响应识别出的HDABi₀.₅Sb₀.₅I₅（HBSI）的低对称性非中心对称单斜相，从而实现了对对称性、晶格动力学及耦合输运现象的系统性调控。
通过变温晶体学和¹H NMR、多扰动拉曼光谱、扫描探针显微镜、光电性能测量以及电子结构计算，我们展示了从一个以铋为主的刚性晶格表现出强烈的压电与铁电耦合，到一个富含锑的更柔性的框架展现出更强的非谐性、热电效应和光子活性的转变，而HBSI兼具高效的热稳定性与声子传输能力。
密度泛函理论计算表明，Bi/Sb 替代使电子结构从间接带隙转变为直接带隙，调节振子强度、自发极化、压力依赖的电子性质以及热电和压电响应，同时保持低的碘空位形成能。
一种三层HBI-HSI-HBSI结构耦合了压电、摩擦电、热电、热电、铁电和光子效应，通过界面极化和多模式耦合实现了电流生成的5.1倍协同增强。

items.t: Predicting molecular crystal growth: Automated surface terminations, interchangeable interaction energy models and finite particles in the CrystalClear protocol
items.a: The incorporation of crystal growth processes extends the utility of predictive techniques beyond simply crystal geometry and a thermodynamic ranking with the ultimate goal being actionable information to target specific crystallisation. Pairwise model interaction energies with implicit solvation have been previously demonstrated in the CrystalClear protocol to provide a computationally efficient route to incorporate such processes, though some limitations restricted its use. We present several advancements to overcome these limitations, incorporating a native implementation of the semi-empirical GFN2-xTB model with SMD solvation, and validating both GFN2-xTB and the CE-1p model against reference lattice energies and solubilities. Further, automated enumeration of symmetry-unique faces and construction of solvated surface energies as part of the same protocol facilitates direct prediction of solvent-dependent equilibrium crystal shapes while eliminating the tedium and errors frequently associated with manual construction of surface geometries required to evaluate surface free energies. To demonstrate the potential of these advancements we present two case studies, oxindole and ritonavir, evaluating the accuracy of the crystal growth protocol in reproducing experimental results for particle size effects, polymorph stability and more. All methods presented here are freely available and implemented in open source software, ensuring accessibility, extendability and transferability to the broader community.
items.tz: 分子晶体生长的预测：CrystalClear协议中的自动表面终止、可互换的相互作用能模型以及有限粒子
items.az:
晶体生长过程的引入将预测技术的用途扩展到不仅限于晶体几何结构和热力学排序，最终目标是获得可操作的信息以靶向特定结晶过程。
隐含溶剂化条件下的一对一模型相互作用能此前已在CrystalClear协议中得到验证，可提供一种计算高效的途径来引入此类过程，尽管某些局限性限制了其应用。
我们提出了多项进展以克服这些局限性，整合了半经验GFN2-xTB模型与SMD溶剂化，并将GFN2-xTB和CE-1p模型的计算结果与参考晶格能及溶解度进行验证。
此外，通过同一协议自动枚举对称唯一面并构建溶剂化表面能，有助于直接预测溶剂依赖的平衡晶体形状，同时消除了手动构建用于评估表面自由能的表面几何结构所常伴随的繁琐过程和错误。
为展示这些进展的潜力，我们提出了两个案例研究，即氧吲哚和利托那韦，评估晶体生长协议在重现实验结果方面对于颗粒尺寸效应、晶型稳定性等方面的准确性。
本文介绍的所有方法均免费开放，并已集成到开源软件中，确保了其可及性、可扩展性以及对更广泛社区的可转移性。

items.t: Superlattice stacking- and molecular interface engineering of ferroelectric/ferromagnetic van der Waals heterostructures
items.a: Interface engineering provides a versatile route for tailoring the properties of ferroelectric and ferromagnetic van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures, yet atomistic design principles linking interfacial structure to ferroic and electronic responses remain limited. Here, density functional theory calculations are employed to compare two complementary interface-engineering strategies: a) stacking- and strain-based tuning of CuInP 2 Se 6 /Cr 2 Ge 2 Te 6 (CIPSe/CGeT) superlattices and b) chiral-molecule interface engineering in (R)-(+)-α-methylbenzylamine (R-MBA)-intercalated CuInP 2 S 6 /Fe 3 GaTe 2 (CIPS/FGaT) heterostructures. Stacking composition and biaxial strain in CIPSe/CGeT primarily modify lattice geometry and Cu off-centering while producing only small changes in the relative ferroic-state energetics, local Cr magnetic moments, and spin-resolved electronic states, consistent with relatively weak interfacial electronic coupling. In contrast, single-molecule adsorption of R-MBA on monolayer CIPS forms a localized bonds that breaks the energetic degeneracy of the two ferroelectric states, whereas adsorption on FGaT produces only minor changes in the local Fe magnetic moments. Extending this concept to intercalated CIPS/FGaT heterostructures reveals that intermolecular π–π stacking and molecular packing, rather than direct coordination, govern the stability and interlayer separation of the interface while producing only modest changes in the calculated ferroic-state energetics and local Fe magnetic moments. Charge-density-difference analysis further reveals more pronounced, localized charge redistribution at the molecule–CIPS and molecule–FGaT contact regions than at the direct CIPSe/CGeT interface, while the Fe-derived spin-polarized electronic states remain largely preserved upon CIPS polarization reversal. These comparisons demonstrate that conventional superlattice engineering primarily tunes geometric parameters, whereas molecular interface engineering introduces additional chemical, electrostatic, and structural degrees of freedom whose influence on ferroic behavior depends sensitively on molecular functionality, orientation, packing, and local coordination with the constituent layers. Together, these results show that structural and molecular interface engineering provide distinct routes for controlling ferroic vdW interfaces, with responses governed strongly by molecular functionality, packing, and local coordination.
items.tz: 铁电/铁磁二维范德华异质结构的超晶格堆叠与分子界面工程
items.az:
界面工程为调控铁电和铁磁二维（vdW）异质结构的性能提供了灵活途径，然而将界面结构与铁性及电子响应关联起来的原子级设计原理仍十分有限。
本文采用密度泛函理论计算，比较两种互补的界面工程策略：a) 基于堆叠和应变调控的 CuInP₂Se₆/Cr₂Ge₂Te₆（CIPSe/CGeT）超晶格，以及 b) 在 (R)-(+)-α-甲基苄胺（R-MBA）插层的 CuInP₂S₆/Fe₃GaTe₂（CIPS/FGaT）异质结构中的手性分子界面工程。
CIPSe/CGeT中的堆叠组成和双轴应变主要改变了晶格几何结构和铜的偏移，而对铁电态能级、局部铬磁矩以及自旋分辨电子态仅产生微小变化，这与界面电子耦合相对较弱一致。
相比之下，R-MBA单分子吸附在单层CIPS上形成局域键，打破了两种铁电态之间的能量简并性，而吸附在FGaT上仅导致局部Fe磁矩的微小变化。
将这一概念扩展到插层的CIPS/FGaT异质结构中，发现分子间π–π堆叠和分子排列而非直接配位，决定了界面的稳定性和层间距离，同时仅对计算得到的铁电态能级和局部Fe磁矩产生微小变化。
电荷密度差分析进一步揭示，在分子–CIPS和分子–FGaT接触区域的电荷再分布比在直接CIPSe/CGeT界面更为显著和局域化，而Fe衍生的自旋极化电子态在CIPS极化反转后仍基本保持不变。
这些比较表明，传统的超晶格工程主要调节几何参数，而分子界面工程引入了额外的化学、静电和结构自由度，其对铁电行为的影响高度依赖于分子的功能性、取向、堆积方式以及与组成层的局部配位。
这些结果共同表明，结构和分子界面工程为调控铁电层状材料界面提供了不同的途径，其响应强烈依赖于分子功能、堆积方式以及局部配位。

items.t: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
items.a: We introduce GMMag, a workflow for generating crystal structures together with their site-resolved magnetic moments, built on a conditional variational autoencoder with a graph neural network encoder and a transformer decoder. Gaussian-mixture sampling redirects generation towards selected chemical and magnetic targets without retraining. We systematically investigate how encoder and decoder design, the representation of magnetic-moment magnitudes and relative signs, and sampling choices affect reconstruction, generation quality and diversity. Because a higher screening pass rate does not necessarily yield more qualifying candidates with distinct chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, we model how repeated generation of the same chemical formulas limits their accumulation and test the model in two separate ten-million-draw runs. As an application, the workflow identifies Nd-containing candidates with chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.
items.tz: 通过高斯混合重定向和有限预算产率预测实现位点分辨磁矩的磁性晶体生成
items.az:
我们提出了GMMag，一种基于条件变分自编码器的流程，该流程结合了图神经网络编码器和变压器解码器，用于生成晶体结构及其位点分辨的磁矩。
高斯混合采样将生成过程导向选定的化学和磁性目标，而无需重新训练。
我们系统地研究了编码器和解码器设计、磁矩大小和相对符号的表示方式以及采样选择如何影响重建质量、生成质量和多样性。
因为较高的筛选通过率并不一定意味着会获得更多在参考数据集中不存在的、化学式各不相同的合格候选物，我们建模了相同化学式重复生成对其积累的限制作用，并在两个独立的十万次抽样运行中测试了该模型。
作为应用，该工作流识别出含有钕的候选化合物，其化学式不在参考数据集中，具有负的形成能和较高的估计饱和磁化率。

items.t: Chiral Organic Single Crystals as a Platform for Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity
items.a: The chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS) effect has attracted increasing attention for its unique ability to generate spin-polarized currents without magnetic components, with promising applications in spintronics, optoelectronics, and electrocatalysis. Although a wide range of chiral materials have been demonstrated to exhibit the CISS effect, most reported systems are based on amorphous films, self-assembled monolayers, or supramolecular assemblies, where structural disorder and aggregative traps compromise reliable evaluation of the CISS effect and obscure the structure-property relationship. Here, we overcome these limitations by constructing high-quality single crystals of chiral BN-embedded double helicenes, which feature a rigid chiral backbone and ordered molecular packing. Using magnetic conductive atomic force microscopy, we show that the single-crystal platform yields significantly improved current uniformity and measurement reproducibility compared with spin-coated thin films. Taking advantage of this enhanced reliability, we systematically investigated spin-selective transport in single crystals with thicknesses ranging from 18 to 330 nm. The spin polarization initially increases rapidly with crystal thickness, reaches a broad maximum, and remains pronounced over transport distances of up to 330 nm. This thickness-dependent behavior provides direct evidence for the cumulative spinselective transport along the long-range ordered structure, thereby distinguishing intrinsic bulk spin polarization from interfacial contributions. Our results thus establish chiral organic single crystals as a robust platform for investigating the CISS effect and unveiling clear structureproperty correlations.
items.tz: 手性有机单晶作为手性诱导自旋选择性的平台
items.az:
手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应因其在不包含磁性成分的情况下产生自旋极化电流的独特能力，而在自旋电子学、光电子学和电催化领域引起了越来越多的关注。
尽管已证明多种手性材料表现出CISS效应，但大多数报道的体系基于非晶薄膜、自组装单分子层或超分子组装体，其中结构无序和聚集陷阱会削弱对CISS效应的可靠评估，并掩盖结构与性能之间的关系。
在此，我们通过制备高质量的含手性硼氮杂双螺旋分子单晶，克服了这些局限性，该单晶具有刚性的手性主链和有序的分子堆积。
利用磁导原子力显微镜，我们表明单晶平台相比旋涂薄膜显著提高了电流均匀性和测量重现性。
利用这一增强的可靠性，我们系统地研究了厚度从18到330 nm的单晶中自旋选择性输运。
自旋极化最初随晶体厚度迅速增加，达到一个宽泛的最大值，并在长达330 nm的传输距离上保持显著。
这种厚度依赖性行为为长程有序结构中累积的自旋选择性输运提供了直接证据，从而区分了本征体相自旋极化与界面贡献。
我们的结果因此确立了手性有机单晶作为研究CISS效应和揭示清晰的结构-性能相关性的稳健平台。

items.t: Synthetic Stochastic Time Series from Generative Models
items.a: Obtaining statistically converged time-series data represents a fundamental challenge in computational chemistry, where sampling is constrained by the prohibitive computational cost of high-fidelity simulations. The accuracy attainable from a finite simulation budget is governed by the standard-error scaling $1/\sqrt{n}$, rendering exhaustive sampling challenging for systems of realistic complexity. Here we show that generative models trained on high-quality stochastic trajectories can reproduce key statistical properties of the underlying process and generate additional synthetic trajectories at substantially lower computational cost, thereby enhancing the sampling accessible from a finite set of simulations. We present a systematic comparison of four generative architectures across two complementary data sources: an analytically tractable Ornstein-Uhlenbeck reference and donor-acceptor energy-gap trajectories from all-atom molecular dynamics simulations. Among the four architectures tested, the denoising diffusion probabilistic model reproduces the target statistics most consistently, across both data sources and across the range of correlation times examined, and generates far faster than the sequential Transformer. Specifically, for the energy-gap trajectories, augmentation from 0.1 ns of training data yields statistical estimates comparable in accuracy to those obtained from 0.25-0.50 ns of direct MD sampling. We further show that the benefit of synthetic augmentation is bounded by the information contained in the training data, producing a quality floor determined by both the training data and the generative model. Our findings establish diffusion-based generative models as an effective route to data-driven augmentation of stochastic time series in computational chemistry.
items.tz: 从生成模型中合成随机时间序列
items.az:
获得统计收敛的时间序列数据在计算化学中是一个基本挑战，其中采样受到高保真模拟巨大计算成本的限制。
从有限的模拟预算中可达到的精度由标准误差缩放 $1/\sqrt{n}$ 决定，使得对于具有实际复杂度的系统而言，彻底采样变得具有挑战性。
在这里，我们表明，基于高质量随机轨迹训练的生成模型能够重现底层过程的关键统计特性，并以显著更低的计算成本生成额外的合成轨迹，从而提升有限模拟集可访问的采样能力。
我们对四种生成架构在两个互补数据源上的系统性比较：一个解析可处理的奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克参考模型和来自全原子分子动力学模拟的给体-受体能隙轨迹。
在四种架构中，去噪扩散概率模型在不同数据源以及所考察的相关时间范围内，最一致地再现了目标统计特性，并且其生成速度远快于顺序Transformer。
具体而言，对于能隙轨迹，从0.1 ns训练数据中进行增强所得到的统计估计精度，与通过0.25-0.50 ns直接分子动力学采样获得的结果相当。
我们进一步表明，合成增强的益处受到训练数据中所含信息的限制，其质量下限由训练数据和生成模型共同决定。
我们的研究确立了基于扩散的生成模型作为计算化学中随机时间序列数据驱动增强的有效途径。

items.t: Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (MQE): A Selective State Space Model for Scalable Ground State Simulations in Quantum Chemistry
items.a: Predicting molecular electronic structure using Quantum Computing approaches is a challenge in Computational Chemistry. Traditional Variational Quantum Eigensolvers (VQEs) are typically hindered by optimization challenges. The alternative Generative Quantum Eigensolver (GQE) mitigates this by reformulating ground-state search as discrete sequence generation, but its Transformer backbone suffers from quadratic computational complexity, bottlenecking scalability for larger molecules. To address this, we introduce the Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (Mamba-QE), which replaces the Transformer with a Selective State Space Model (SSM) to process operator sequences with linear $\mathcal{O}(L)$ complexity. Additionally, we integrate a distance-conditioned mechanism enabling the direct prediction of complete potential energy surfaces (PES). Evaluated on the $H_2$ molecule, Mamba-QE reproduces Full Configuration Interaction (FCI) reference energies well within chemical accuracy, achieving an energy error below $3\times10^{-6}$ Ha across 16 geometries with zero variational violations. Mamba-QE maintains high expressive power while establishing a robust, scalable foundation for quantum simulations of complex molecular systems.
items.tz: Mamba Quantum Eigensolver (MQE)：一种用于量子化学中可扩展基态模拟的选择性状态空间模型
items.az:
使用量子计算方法预测分子电子结构是计算化学中的一个挑战。
传统的变分量子本征求解器（VQEs）通常受到优化难题的限制。
替代的生成量子本征求解器（GQE）通过将基态搜索重新表述为离散序列生成来缓解这一问题，但其Transformer主干结构存在二次计算复杂度，限制了对较大分子的可扩展性。
为解决这一问题，我们提出了Mamba量子本征求解器（Mamba-QE），其用选择性状态空间模型（SSM）替代Transformer，以线性$\mathcal{O}(L)$复杂度处理算符序列。
此外，我们引入了一种距离条件机制，能够直接预测完整的势能面（PES）。
在H₂分子上的评估中，Mamba-QE能够很好地再现全配置相互作用（FCI）参考能量，其能量误差在16种几何构型下均低于3×10⁻⁶ Ha，且无变分违规。
Mamba-QE 在保持高表达能力的同时，为复杂分子系统的量子模拟建立了稳健且可扩展的基础。

items.t: Crystal structure and Hirshfeld surface analysis of phenylalanine hydrobromide
items.a: Amino acid salts represent a diverse class of molecular solids in which ionic interactions and hydrogen bonding between protonated amino acid species and counter-ions govern the formation of supramolecular architectures. Phenylalanine hydrobromide (systematic name: 1-carboxy-2-phenylethan-1-aminium bromide, C 9 H 12 NO 2 + ·Br − ) crystallizes in the chiral orthorhombic space group P 2 1 2 1 2 1 . Its structure is built from protonated phenylalaninium cations, which interact with bromide anions through a network of N—H...Br and O—H...Br hydrogen bonds, forming bilayers propagating parallel to the ab plane, with the polar groups oriented toward the interior of the bilayers. The crystal structure is additionally stabilized by three types of weak T-shaped C( sp 2 )—H...π interactions.
items.v: Acta Crystallographica Section E Crystallographic Communications
items.tz: 苯丙氨酸溴化物的晶体结构与Hirshfeld表面分析
items.az:
氨基酸盐是一类多样化的分子晶体，其中质子化氨基酸物种与反离子之间的离子相互作用和氢键决定了超分子结构的形成。
苯丙氨酸溴盐（系统命名：1-羧基-2-苯基乙烷-1-氨基溴化物，C9H12NO2+·Br−）形成手性的正交空间群 P212121。
其结构由质子化的苯丙氨酸阳离子构成，这些阳离子通过N—H...Br和O—H...Br氢键与溴离子相互作用，形成平行于ab平面的双层结构，极性基团朝向双层内部。
晶体结构还通过三种类型的弱T形C(sp²)–H⋯π相互作用得到稳定。

items.t: Enabling Structure-Only Initialization and Out-of-Distribution Generalization in GNN-Based Molecular Dynamics Simulators
items.a: Machine-learning-based simulators offer the potential to model the dynamics of complex systems more efficiently than classical approaches while retaining differentiability, a key property for materials design. Graph neural network (GNN)-based simulators have shown strong performance across a range of physical domains, including molecular dynamics. However, their reliance on temporal context for accurate prediction limits their use in inverse design settings, where simulations must be initialized from a single static configuration. Moreover, inverse design requires robust out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, as candidate structures typically lie outside the training domain. Here, we address both challenges by introducing two complementary strategies that enable the stable and accurate structure-only initialization of GNN-based simulations. To directly target OOD generalization, we propose an inference-time physics-based optimization framework that constrains model predictions to remain physically consistent during the rollout. In addition, we introduce a differentiable, GNN-based barostat that enables accurate tracking of system dimensions and pressure, which is critical for capturing macroscopic responses and supporting OOD generalization. We evaluated these approaches in the context of uniaxial compression of disordered elastic networks spanning a broad range of geometries, Poisson’s ratios, and microscopic behaviors. We find that, together, these methods substantially improve rollout stability and enable reliable OOD generalization, including regimes with distinct, more complex dynamics than those the in training data. These results show that when properly initialized and constrained, GNN-based simulators can serve as efficient and generalizable tools for materials discovery and structural optimization, advancing their use in materials, molecular, and dynamical system design.
items.v: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
items.tz: 在基于图神经网络的分子动力学模拟器中实现仅结构初始化和分布外泛化
items.az:
基于机器学习的模拟器相比经典方法能够更高效地建模复杂系统的动力学，同时保持可微性，这是材料设计中的一个关键属性。
基于图神经网络（GNN）的模拟器在多个物理领域中表现出色，包括分子动力学。
然而，它们对时间上下文的依赖限制了其在逆设计场景中的应用，其中模拟必须从单一静态构型开始初始化。
此外，逆设计需要具备强大的分布外（OOD）泛化能力，因为候选结构通常位于训练域之外。
在此，我们通过引入两种互补策略来同时应对这两个挑战，从而实现基于图神经网络的模拟中结构信息的稳定且准确初始化。
为直接针对OOD泛化，我们提出了一种推理时基于物理的优化框架，该框架在 rollout 过程中约束模型预测保持物理一致性。
此外，我们引入了一种可微的基于图神经网络的压强调节器，能够准确跟踪系统尺寸和压力，这对于捕捉宏观响应以及支持领域外泛化至关重要。
我们在无轴压缩条件下，对具有广泛几何结构、泊松比和微观行为的无序弹性网络所采用的方法进行了评估。
我们发现，这些方法结合使用显著提升了策略 rollout 的稳定性，并实现了可靠的领域外泛化，包括训练数据中未包含的、具有明显更复杂动力学的 regime。
这些结果表明，当经过适当初始化和约束后，基于图神经网络的模拟器可以作为高效且具有泛化能力的工具，用于材料发现和结构优化，推动其在材料、分子及动力学系统设计中的应用。

items.t: Many-Body Second-Order Green’s Function Theory for Ab Initio Molecular Quantum Electrodynamics
items.a: In this work, we develop two many-body quantum electrodynamic methods to calculate the ground-state energies of strongly coupled light-matter molecular systems. Specifically, we extend the second-order many-body Green’s function theory (GF2) for electronic systems to incorporate electron–boson couplings. We employ two ansätze to treat the bosonic part of the system, namely, the coherent-state (CS) and Lang–Firsov (LF) transformed vacuum state. These are combined with the GF2 method to construct two new approaches, which we refer to as CS-GF2 and LF-GF2. We benchmark CS- and LF-GF2 by studying various molecular systems inside an optical cavity. We investigate H2 and LiH potential energy surfaces, keto–enol tautomerization energy barrier, van der Waals interactions between two H2 molecules, and the torsional potential energy surface of the ethylene molecule, C2H4. Both methods provide similar energy profiles, with relatively small differences between CS-GF2 and LF-GF2. Comparisons with the reference calculations also reveal remaining limitations at stretched bond lengths and near the twisted ethylene configuration. We additionally benchmark CS-GF2 against exact diagonalization for a two-site Hubbard–Holstein model and observe that it closely reproduces the coupling-induced energy change in the weakly interacting regime while improving upon CS-MP2 in the strongly interacting regime. Overall, the results demonstrate that CS-GF2 and LF-GF2 provide self-consistent descriptions of correlated molecular electron–boson systems, offering a many-body Green’s function alternative for studying ground-state cavity-modified systems.
items.v: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
items.tz: 用于从头算分子量子电动力学的多体二阶格林函数理论
items.az:
在本工作中，我们发展了两种多体量子电动力学方法，用于计算强耦合光-物质分子系统的基态能量。
具体而言，我们将用于电子系统的二阶多体格林函数理论（GF2）扩展以包含电子-玻色子耦合。
我们采用两种方法来处理系统的玻色子部分，即相干态（CS）和Lang–Firsov（LF）变换后的真空态。
这些方法与GF2方法结合，构建了两种新方法，我们称之为CS-GF2和LF-GF2。
我们通过研究光学腔内的各种分子体系来对CS-和LF-GF2进行基准测试。
我们研究了 H2 和 LiH 的势能面、酮–烯醇互变异构的能垒、两个 H2 分子之间的范德华相互作用，以及乙烯分子 C2H4 的扭转势能面。
两种方法提供了相似的能量曲线，CS-GF2 与 LF-GF2 之间的差异相对较小。
与参考计算的比较也揭示了在拉长键长和接近扭曲乙烯构型时仍存在的局限性。
我们还以两站点Hubbard–Holstein模型对CS-GF2进行了基准测试，并观察到，它在弱相互作用区域中准确再现了耦合引起的能量变化，而在强相互作用区域中优于CS-MP2。
总体而言，结果表明 CS-GF2 和 LF-GF2 对相关分子电子-玻色子系统提供了自洽的描述，为研究基态腔修饰系统的多体格林函数方法提供了一种替代方案。

items.t: Semi-automated workflow to predict polymorph energies as a function of size [software]
items.a: The stability of molecular crystal polymorphs is conventionally predicted from lattice energies alone. This description breaks down at the nanoscale, where surface contributions become comparable to bulk lattice energy differences and can reverse polymorph stability. Although finite-particle thermodynamics has long been recognised in inorganic materials, it has remained largely unexplored in molecular crystals. Here we establish finite-particle thermodynamics as a predictive framework for molecular crystal polymorphism. Using a computational approach that combines calculations of lattice energies, surface energies and crystal morphology, we predict polymorph stability as a function of particle size across nine chemically diverse molecular systems. The framework reproduces established size-dependent polymorphic behaviour, resolves previously unexplained stability relationships that are subsequently confirmed experimentally, and predicts previously unknown crystal-size-dependent polymorphic transitions that are then realised by mechanochemistry. Across four systems investigated prospectively, finite-particle thermodynamics predicted crystal-size-dependent stability reversals for three polymorph pairs, corresponding to six directional polymorphic conversions, while correctly predicting no stability reversal for a fourth pair. Four of the six predicted conversions were realised experimentally, whereas the remaining two were not observed, revealing how kinetic barriers or mechanical instabilities may prevent access to energetically preferred finite-particle polymorphs. The two conversions predicted not to occur were likewise absent experimentally. By extending thermodynamic prediction beyond the bulk limit, this work establishes finite-particle thermodynamics as a robust framework for understanding and predicting molecular polymorphism at the nanoscale, with implications for crystal structure prediction, mechanochemistry, pharmaceutical solid forms and crystallisation under nanoconfinement.
items.tz: 一种半自动化的工作流程，用于预测晶型能量随尺寸的变化 [软件]
items.az:
分子晶体多晶型物的稳定性传统上仅基于晶格能进行预测。
该描述在纳米尺度下失效，其中表面贡献与体相晶格能差异相当，并可能逆转多晶型的稳定性。
尽管有限粒子热力学在无机材料中早已被认识，但在分子晶体中仍长期未被充分探索。
在这里，我们建立有限粒子热力学作为分子晶体多晶型的预测框架。
采用一种结合晶格能、表面能和晶体形貌计算的计算方法，我们预测了在九个化学结构各异的分子体系中，多晶型的稳定性随颗粒尺寸的变化关系。
该框架重现了已知的尺寸依赖性多晶型行为，阐明了此前未被解释的稳定性关系，这些关系随后通过实验得到验证，并预测了此前未知的晶体尺寸依赖性多晶型转变，这些转变随后通过机械化学方法实现。
在前瞻性研究的四个体系中，有限粒子热力学预测了三个晶型对的晶粒尺寸依赖性稳定性反转，对应于六个方向性的晶型转变，同时正确预测了第四对不存在稳定性反转。
六种预测的转化中，有四种在实验中得以实现，而另外两种未被观察到，揭示了动力学障碍或机械不稳定性可能阻止访问能量上更优的有限粒子多晶型物。
同样，实验中也未观察到这两种本应不发生的转化。
通过将热力学预测扩展至超越体相极限，本工作确立了有限粒子热力学作为理解与预测纳米尺度分子多晶型的稳健框架，对晶体结构预测、机械化学、药物固态形式以及纳米受限条件下的结晶具有重要意义。

items.t: Lattice free energies of molecular crystals using normalizing flow
items.a: Accurate free-energy calculations are essential for predicting thermodynamic stability in complex molecular materials, such as the polymorphic crystal landscapes of pharmaceutical molecules. Classical methods such as the Einstein crystal method (ECM) provide benchmark accuracy but are computationally prohibitive in larger crystal landscapes generated by Crystal Structure Prediction. Here, we develop a scalable framework for the anharmonic free-energy ranking of molecular crystals, based on targeted free-energy perturbation. In particular, we utilise the targeted Bennett acceptance ratio (tBAR) method, where the targeting step employs a bijective map learned via a normalising flow. The maps are trained to analytically transform supercell configurations between the crystal Boltzmann ensembles of interest and an analytical reference state. Exact likelihoods, in turn, enable reliable lattice free-energy estimates directly from physical molecular dynamics data, without alchemical sampling. The method handles supercells with up to 3 × 10 3 degrees of freedom and permits multi-state training with a single model. Validation across succinic acid, Veliparib, and Mivebresib demonstrates excellent agreement with ECM at significantly lower cost. By combining statistical mechanics and machine-learning expressivity, this approach advances anharmonic free energies towards automation and high-throughput applications in molecular and materials design.
items.tz: 分子晶体的晶格自由能使用流匹配
items.az:
准确的自由能计算对于预测复杂分子材料中的热力学稳定性至关重要，例如药物分子的多晶型晶体景观。
经典方法如爱因斯坦晶体法（ECM）提供了基准精度，但在由晶体结构预测生成的较大晶体空间中计算上是不可行的。
在此，我们基于靶向自由能扰动发展了一种适用于分子晶体非谐自由能排序的可扩展框架。
特别是，我们采用了目标贝内特接受率（tBAR）方法，其中的目标步骤采用了一种通过归一化流学习到的双射映射。
这些地图被训练以解析地将感兴趣晶体玻尔兹曼集合中的超胞构型转换到一个解析参考态。
精确似然性使得能够直接从物理分子动力学数据中可靠地估计晶格自由能，而无需进行化学势采样。
该方法可处理最多包含 3 × 10³ 个自由度的超胞，并允许使用单个模型进行多态训练。
在戊二酸、Veliparib 和 Mivebresib 上的验证结果与ECM高度一致，且成本显著降低。
通过结合统计力学与机器学习的表达能力，该方法推动了非谐自由能向分子和材料设计领域的自动化及高通量应用。

items.t: Chemical Similarity Enables a Unified Free-Energy Framework for f -Block Solvation Thermodynamics
items.a: f-Block elements underpin many essential technologies, yet their efficient mutual separation remains a foundational challenge in chemistry. The lanthanide series provide a stringent test case: the trivalent lanthanide ions (Ln3+) exhibit near-identical solvation chemistry across the series, distinguished only by the lanthanide contraction. Here, we turn this chemical similarity into a computational advantage. Treating each solvated Ln3+ as a distinct alchemical state, we exploit configurational overlap between neighboring ions by applying the multistate Bennett acceptance ratio (MBAR) to estimate relative hydration free energies from pooled ensembles. We extend this framework to biased simulations by coupling coordination-number-based well-tempered metadynamics with MBAR, enabling enhanced sampling of rare coordination fluctuations within a unified free-energy estimator. Benchmarked in water as a controlled, well-characterized solvent, the workflow yields convergence, overlap, and effective sample size (ESS) diagnostics alongside free-energy trends in good agreement with experiment. MBAR-enabled energy–entropy decomposition reveals discrepancies in the underlying energetic and entropic contributions despite good agreement in total free energy, motivating a multifidelity test with a machine-learned polarizable interatomic potential. MBAR-based reweighting reveals insufficient Hamiltonian overlap, exposing a transferability bottleneck; the pooled classical ensemble does not support reliable post hoc reweighting to the target Hamiltonians. Domain-specific fine-tuning, renewed sampling, and explicit overlap reassessment are therefore required before MACE-polar can be incorporated as a higher-fidelity layer. This framework establishes “UfS”─a unified free-energy framework for f-block solvation─as a scalable, uncertainty-aware approach to lanthanide solvation thermodynamics and a foundation for future applications to related actinides, speciation-rich environments, and data-driven design of new separations chemistries.
items.v: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
items.tz: 化学相似性为f区溶剂化热力学提供了统一的自由能框架
items.az:
f区元素支撑了许多关键技术，然而它们的高效分离仍一直是化学领域中的基础挑战。
镧系元素提供了一个严格的测试案例：三价镧系离子（Ln³⁺）在系列中的溶剂化学几乎完全相同，仅因镧系收缩而有所区别。
在这里，我们将这种化学相似性转化为一种计算优势。
将每个溶剂化的 Ln³⁺ 视为一个独立的阿尔科利状态，我们通过应用多态贝奈特接受比（MBAR）利用相邻离子之间的构型重叠，从合并的集合中估算相对水合自由能。
我们将该框架扩展至有偏模拟，通过将基于配位数的温控元动力学与MBAR相结合，实现了在统一自由能估计器下对稀有配位波动的增强采样。
在水作为受控且特征明确的溶剂条件下进行基准测试，该工作流程产生了收敛性、重叠度以及有效样本量（ESS）诊断信息，并且自由能趋势与实验结果良好一致。
基于MBAR的能量-熵分解揭示了尽管总自由能一致，但潜在的能量和熵贡献之间存在差异，这促使采用一种机器学习可极化的原子间势进行多保真度测试。
基于MBAR的重加权显示了哈密顿量重叠不足，暴露出一个可转移性瓶颈；合并的经典集合无法可靠地对目标哈密顿量进行事后重加权。
因此，在将MACE-polar作为更高保真度的层引入之前，需要进行领域特定的微调、重新采样以及显式重评估重叠。
该框架建立了“UfS”——一种用于f区溶剂化过程的统一自由能框架——作为镧系元素溶剂化热力学中可扩展且具有不确定性意识的方法，并为未来应用于相关锕系元素、组分丰富的环境以及新型分离化学的基于数据的设计奠定基础。

items.t: Designing Geared Molecular Rotors in Flexible Metal-Organic Frameworks
items.a: Translating macroscopic mechanical concepts such as gears to the molecular scale offers a route to precise control over nanoscale motion, inspired by the efficiency of biological machines. In this work, we explore two-dimensional interlocked linker rotations in the flexible metal-organic framework NU-2002. The volume-dependent free energy landscape is mapped using bias-deletion metadynamics to identify six characteristic phases, ranging from very closed to very open pore. We then perform unbiased molecular dynamics simulations at each phase to track rotation events and evaluate co-rotation statistics, calculate free energy barriers, and measure pairwise radial force transfer between neighbouring linkers. We show that the free energy barrier acts as a rotational-speed filter, where rare rotational transitions lead to higher speeds on average. Across the volume profile, we classify four distinct geared regimes: sterically restricted rotations at small volumes (Jammed Gear), rotational coupling extending to third neighbour linkers (First Gear), in-plane partnered linker coupling (Second Gear), and uncoupled, independent rotation at large volumes (Neutral Gear). Together, these results establish framework breathing as a molecular gearbox that switches both the speed and collective coupling of linker rotation. Framework flexibility therefore offers a handle for programming collective motion in solid-state molecular machines.
items.tz: 在柔性金属有机框架中设计齿轮状分子旋转体
items.az:
将齿轮等宏观机械概念转化为分子尺度，为精确控制纳米级运动提供了途径，这一思路受到生物机器高效性的启发。
在本工作中，我们探讨了柔性金属有机框架NU-2002中二维互锁连接体的旋转。
利用偏置删除元动力学方法绘制体积依赖的自由能景观，以识别从非常封闭到非常开放孔道的六个典型相。
我们随后在每个相中进行无偏分子动力学模拟，以追踪旋转事件并评估协同旋转统计，计算自由能势垒，并测量相邻连接体之间的成对径向力传递。
我们表明，自由能势垒起到旋转速度筛选的作用，其中稀有旋转跃迁导致平均速度更高。
在体积轮廓图中，我们划分出四个不同的传动阶段：在小体积处的立体受限旋转（卡死齿轮），延伸至第三邻位连接体的旋转耦合（第一齿轮），平面内配对连接体的耦合（第二齿轮），以及在大体积处的解耦、独立旋转（中性齿轮）。
这些结果共同确立了框架呼吸作为一种分子齿轮箱，能够切换连接体旋转的速度及其集体耦合。
框架的柔性因此为在固态分子机器中编程集体运动提供了手段。

items.t: DeepMuon: generating cosmic-ray Muons based on optimal transport
items.a: Deep learning can learn distributions directly from data, enabling fast event simulation without hand-crafted designs or costly sampling. Yet many mainstream generators, such as diffusion models, require sophisticated architectures and multi-step denoising, which reduces throughput. Neural generators also struggle with sharp, high-kurtosis distributions common in physics, such as the cosmic-ray muon energy spectrum. Cosmic-ray muon simulation underpins non-destructive imaging, positioning and navigation, timing, and cryptography, and is traditionally performed with Monte Carlo or parametric models. Here we propose DeepMuon, a deep learning-based cosmic-ray muon generator that targets both efficiency and accuracy while addressing high-kurtosis fitting. We first apply an inverse Box--Cox transformation to reduce energy-spectrum kurtosis and simplify the learning task. We then optimize the generator with the Sliced Wasserstein Distance loss, achieving statistically consistent, one-step cosmic-ray muon generation with only a 2-layer Transformer encoder. DeepMuon also learns muon distribution patterns from limited data, enabling simulation of real detector-measured distributions. At sea level, DeepMuon substantially accelerates muon generation relative to the Cosmic-ray Shower Library (CRY). We further develop a DeepMuon-based pipeline to directly simulate underwater muon distributions and compare against CRY, demonstrating suitability for simulation and imaging tasks. For more details about our open-source project, please visit: https://github.com/wangab0/deepmuon.
items.v: Journal of Physics G Nuclear and Particle Physics
items.tz: DeepMuon：基于最优传输生成宇宙射线缪子
items.az:
深度学习可以直接从数据中学习分布，从而实现快速事件模拟，而无需手工设计或昂贵的采样。
然而，许多主流生成器，如扩散模型，需要复杂的架构和多步去噪，这降低了处理速度。
神经生成器也难以处理物理学中常见的尖锐、高峰度分布，例如宇宙射线缪子能谱。
宇宙射线缪子模拟支撑了非破坏性成像、定位与导航、时间同步和密码学，传统上采用蒙特卡洛或参数模型进行。
这里我们提出了DeepMuon，一种基于深度学习的宇宙射线μ子生成器，旨在同时提升效率和准确性，并解决高峰度拟合问题。
我们首先对能量谱峰度应用逆Box--Cox变换以降低能量谱的峰度，并简化学习任务。
我们随后使用切片瓦瑟斯坦距离损失优化生成器，仅用一个2层Transformer编码器，实现了统计上一致的单步宇宙射线μ子生成。
DeepMuon 也从有限数据中学习缪子分布模式，从而实现对真实探测器测得分布的模拟。
在海平面，DeepMuon 相比宇宙射线簇库（CRY）显著加速了μ子的生成。
我们进一步开发了一种基于DeepMuon的流程，直接模拟水下μ子分布，并与CRY进行对比，证明其适用于模拟和成像任务。
关于我们的开源项目更多详情，请访问：https://github.com/wangab0/deepmuon。

items.t: Spin-Charge Conversion in an Epitaxial Kagome Flat-Band Metal
items.a: The formation of topological flat bands near the Fermi level in kagome-structured metals has generated substantial research interest. One key consequence of this electronic structure is the strong anisotropy in charge transport, such as the significantly higher in-plane resistivity relative to the out-of-plane direction. However, the spin transport properties of these flat-band kagome metals are still largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate spin-charge conversion in CoSn, a representative flat-band kagome metal. Scanning tunneling microscopy is employed to image the CoSn surface with atomic resolution, and $dI/dV$ spectroscopy shows clear signatures of the flat bands. Using magneto-optical techniques, we quantify the spin-orbit torque (SOT) in bilayers of ferromagnetic nickel (Ni) and c-plane CoSn thin films. We find a large effective spin Hall angle of $θ_{SH} = 0.484 \pm 0.005$ within the CoSn layers, significantly exceeding the value measured for Pt of $θ_{SH} = 0.0436 \pm 0.0003$ in Ni/Pt bilayers. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations provide a microscopic understanding of the intrinsic spin Hall effect in CoSn, elucidating the sources of Berry curvature in momentum space. These findings establish kagome metals as promising materials for efficient spin-charge conversion and low-power spintronics.
items.tz: 分子晶体中二维蜂窝平带金属的自旋-电荷转换
items.az:
在kagome结构金属中靠近费米能级处形成拓扑平带引起了广泛的研究兴趣。
这一电子结构的一个关键后果是电荷传输的强各向异性，例如平面内电阻显著高于垂直方向。
然而，这些平带凯格莱金属的自旋输运性质仍 largely 未被探索。
在本工作中，我们研究了CoSn中自旋-电荷转换，其中CoSn是一种具有平坦能带的kagome金属。
扫描隧道显微镜用于以原子分辨率成像CoSn表面，dI/dV光谱显示出明显平坦带的特征。
利用磁光技术，我们量化了铁磁性镍（Ni）与c面CoSn薄片双层结构中的自旋轨道扭矩（SOT）。
我们在CoSn层中测得较大的有效自旋霍尔角$θ_{SH} = 0.484 \pm 0.005$，显著高于在Ni/Pt异质结中测得的Pt的自旋霍尔角$θ_{SH} = 0.0436 \pm 0.0003$。
密度泛函理论（DFT）计算为CoSn中本征自旋霍尔效应提供了微观理解，阐明了动量空间中Berry曲率的来源。
这些发现确立了kagome金属作为高效自旋-电荷转换和低功耗自旋电子学材料的潜力。

items.t: Second-order Sinkhorn Geometry and $\sqrt{n}$-Inference
items.a: The Sinkhorn divergence, a debiased form of entropic optimal transport, has been widely used in various scientific disciplines due to its computational and statistical tractability. Unlike the Wasserstein distance, however, the Sinkhorn divergence is not a metric and it does not naturally admit a formal Riemannian structure. These properties are central to many applications of optimal transport methods that utilize interpolation, barycentric averaging, parallel transport or other geometric operations. Recent work addresses these shortcomings by constructing a formal Riemannian tangent space and a metric tensor on the space of probability measures that quadratically approximates the Sinkhorn divergence. In this work, we extend this framework with two major threads of contributions. For a suitable class of finite-smoothness cost functions, we prove Hadamard differentiability of the Sinkhorn metric tensor and we derive the Levi-Civita covariant derivative in this geometry; we then use the covariant derivative to obtain the geodesic and parallel transport equations, each of which amount to an ODE on a fixed Reproducing Kernel Hilbert Space (RKHS) with smooth coefficients. Our second contribution is to linearize the solutions to the geodesic and parallel transport equations using standard tools from Banach space ODE theory. We show that under standard regularity conditions these linearizations imply $\sqrt{n}$-limiting Gaussian processes centered at population values for the plugin estimators of the exponential map, the logarithmic map, parallel transport and the induced Sinkhorn distance. Moreover, we show that the nonparametric bootstrap is consistent for all objects mentioned. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first $\sqrt{n}$--limit theorems and bootstrap consistency results for canonical geometric operations in a transport-based geometry on the space of probability measures.
items.tz: 二阶 Sinkhorn 几何与 $\sqrt{n}$-推断
items.az:
Sinkhorn散度，作为熵优化传输的一种去偏形式，因其计算和统计上的可处理性，已被广泛应用于各个科学领域。
然而，与Wasserstein距离不同，Sinkhorn散度不是一个度量，并且不自然地具备形式上的黎曼结构。
这些性质是许多利用插值、重心平均、平行传输或其他几何操作的最优传输方法应用的核心。
近期工作通过构建概率测度空间上的形式黎曼切空间和度量张量，该张量以二次近似方式逼近Sinkhorn散度。
在本工作中，我们在此框架中增加了两个主要方面的贡献。
对于一类合适的有限光滑度成本函数，我们证明了Sinkhorn度量张量的Hadamard可微性，并推导出该几何中的Levi-Civita共变导数；随后我们利用共变导数得到了测地线和平行传输方程，每一项都相当于在固定复现核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）上的一个具有光滑系数的常微分方程。
我们的第二个贡献是使用巴拿赫空间常微分方程理论中的标准工具，对测地线和平行传输方程的解进行线性化。
我们证明，在标准正则性条件下，这些线性化意味着对指数映射、对数映射、平行传输以及诱导的Sinkhorn距离的插值估计量而言，其极限过程是均值为总体值的$\sqrt{n}$-尺度高斯过程。
此外，我们表明非参数自助法对上述所有对象均具一致性。
据我们所知，这些是针对基于传输几何的测度空间中标准几何操作的首次$\sqrt{n}$极限定理和自助一致性结果。

items.t: Extended Active Learning-Guided Design of Multi-Component Electrolytes with Opposing Cosolvent Properties for Aqueous Zinc-Ion Batteries
items.a: Multi-component electrolytes offer expanded tunability over electrochemical properties, yet their rational design is constrained by a lack of generalizable principles. Intricate intercomponent interactions obscure the relationship between the molecular properties and battery performance, rendering material selection and compositional optimization intractable. Here, we present an extended active learning-guided framework to efficiently navigate the vast materials space and refine formulations for tri-solvent-based electrolytes in aqueous zinc-ion batteries with minimal experimental workload. Specifically, co-solvent candidates are clustered by molecular properties; co-solvents are then selected, and their pairwise combinations undergo rigorous formulation optimization. Our data-driven approach discovered a nonintuitive electrolyte composition: combining co-solvents with fundamentally opposing properties. This unique formulation, which disrupts the hydrogen-bonded network while reconstructing the solvation structure, enables Zn||NH4V4O10 full-cells to retain 90.2% capacity after 1,000 cycles. This study unveils the possibility of using active learning to discover unconventional electrolyte formulations that would otherwise be infeasible to identify through human insights.
items.v: Journal of the American Chemical Society
items.tz: 具有相反共溶剂特性的多组分电解质的扩展主动学习引导设计用于水系锌离子电池
items.az:
多组分电解质在电化学性能方面提供了更广泛的可调性，但其合理设计受到缺乏通用原理的限制。
组分间的复杂相互作用掩盖了分子性质与电池性能之间的关系，使得材料选择和组分优化变得不可行。
在此，我们提出了一种扩展的主动学习引导框架，以高效探索庞大的材料空间，并在极小的实验工作量下优化基于三溶剂的电解质配方。
具体而言，共溶剂候选物根据分子性质进行聚类；随后选择共溶剂，并对其成对组合进行严格的配方优化。
我们的数据驱动方法发现了非直观的电解质组成：将具有根本相反性质的共溶剂相结合。
这种独特的配方在破坏氢键网络的同时重建溶剂化结构，使得Zn||NH4V4O10全电池在1000个循环后仍能保持90.2%的容量。
本研究揭示了利用主动学习发现否则无法通过人类经验识别的非常规电解质配方的可能性。

items.t: Fracture Mechanics and Self-Healing in Molecular Crystal Resonators for Lasing
items.a: Microscale damage poses a significant challenge to the reliability and longevity of miniaturized photonic devices; however, the mechanisms and repair of microscopic cracks and fractures in organic optical crystals remain largely unexplored. Here, we employ a mechanophotonic approach to induce microscale cracks and complete fractures in single crystals of 3-[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]-1-(2-hydroxyphenyl)prop-2-en-1-one (HDMAC) using an atomic force microscopy (AFM) cantilever tip. We demonstrate the self-healing capability of these crystals while retaining their optical waveguiding and resonator properties, which are essential for lasing applications. HDMAC microcrystals exhibit self-healing of cracks introduced along the (010) and (001) crystallographic planes, demonstrating the versatility of this phenomenon across distinct crystal orientations. Furthermore, we identify different fracture mechanisms and establish a comprehensive assessment of healing efficiency by integrating optical loss measurements, resonator characteristics, and nanomechanical analyses. This multifaceted approach enables fair evaluation of the recovery of structural integrity and photonic functionality following self-healing.
items.tz: 分子晶体谐振子的断裂力学与自修复机制用于激光
items.az:
微尺度损伤对微型光子器件的可靠性与寿命构成了重大挑战；然而，有机光学晶体中微观裂纹和断裂的形成机制及其修复仍 largely 未被探索。
在此，我们采用一种机光机制，利用原子力显微镜（AFM）探针在3-[4-(二甲基氨基)苯基]-1-(2-羟基苯基)丙-2-烯-1-酮（HDMAC）单晶中诱导微尺度裂纹并实现完全断裂。
我们展示了这些晶体在保持其光学波导和谐振器性能的同时具备自修复能力，这对于激光应用至关重要。
HDMAC微晶在(010)和(001)晶面方向上引入的裂纹表现出自修复行为，展示了这一现象在不同晶体取向中的通用性。
此外，我们识别了不同的断裂机制，并通过结合光学损耗测量、谐振器特性以及纳米力学分析，建立了对修复效率的全面评估。
这种方法使得能够公平地评估自修复后结构完整性和光子功能的恢复情况。

items.t: Retention-constrained fine-tuning of a pre-trained aluminium MACE potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity
items.a: Adapting a pre-trained machine-learning interatomic potential for non-equilibrium defect dynamics and plasticity requires improving defect accuracy without degrading the near-equilibrium elastic and vibrational response. Here we achieve this balance for the aluminium MACE potential QP17 by integrating conditional readout uncertainty, iterative full-parameter updates and protocol-compatible relative-energy anchoring. Sensitivities over 144 linear readout weights guide acquisition, with within-batch covariance updates and evolving neural representations. After four active-learning rounds (32 acquired configurations and 400 gradient updates), force-uncertainty acquisition reduces mean development force error from 22.43 to 21.52 meV/Angstrom, outperforming random sampling (22.70), geometry-diversity selection (22.46) and uniform training across all 104 candidate labels (22.71) under the same update budget. All three force-uncertainty runs satisfy bulk-mechanical retention criteria: historical relative-energy error decreases from 0.375 to 0.207 meV/atom, while harmonic phonon root-mean-square drift remains below 0.05 THz. Matched objective ablations reveal that relative-energy anchoring suppresses harmonic drift. Out-of-sample evaluations across planar faults, twin boundaries and grain boundaries demonstrate transferable gains in defect energies and deviatoric stresses, even though virial stresses are never fitted. A closed-loop molecular dynamics and density functional theory (MD-DFT) pilot confirms that automated acceptance gating intercepts updates that violate historical elastic-group energy or vibrational tolerances. Together, these components establish a retention-constrained fine-tuning protocol for improving plastic-deformation observables while preserving the tested bulk mechanical response.
items.tz: 在非平衡缺陷动力学和塑性中对预训练的铝MACE势进行保留约束微调
items.az:
将预先训练的机器学习原子间势函数适应于非平衡缺陷动力学和塑性，需要在不损害近平衡弹性与振动响应的前提下提升缺陷精度。
我们通过整合条件读出不确定性、迭代全参数更新以及协议兼容的相对能量锚定，实现了铝MACE势能QP17的这一平衡。
超过144个线性读出权重的敏感度指导数据采集，结合批次内的协方差更新和不断演化的神经表征。
经过四轮主动学习（获取32个配置和400次梯度更新后），力不确定性获取将平均开发力误差从22.43降至21.52 meV/Å，优于随机采样（22.70）、几何多样性选择（22.46）以及在所有104个候选标签上均匀训练（22.71），在相同的更新预算下。
所有三个力-不确定性运行均满足体积机械保留标准：历史相对能量误差从 0.375 降至 0.207 meV/原子，而谐波声子均方漂移保持在 0.05 THz 以下。
匹配目标的消融实验表明，相对能量锚定抑制了谐波漂移。
在平面断层、孪晶界和晶界上的离样评估表明，即使没有拟合virial应力，缺陷能和偏应力仍表现出可转移的提升。
一个闭环分子动力学和密度泛函理论（MD-DFT）试点表明，自动接受门拦截了违反历史弹性组能量或振动容限的更新。
这些组件共同建立了一种保留约束的微调协议，用于在保持测试的 bulk 机械响应的同时提升塑性变形可观测量。

items.t: Synthesis-by-design of ferroelectric Dion–Jacobson two-dimensional hybrid organic–inorganic perovskites
items.a: Dion–Jacobson two-dimensional hybrid organic–inorganic perovskites are promising ferroelectric materials, combining chemically tunable polarity enabled by their organic spacers with enhanced environmental stability. However, rational discovery remains difficult owing to uncertain phase formability and scarce, biased ferroelectric data. Here we show a staged, physically guided synthesis-by-design workflow that integrates learning from scarce ferroelectric data with structure-aware screening. Starting from 11 known ferroelectric compounds in this family, symbolic regression defines a descriptor-bounded ferroelectric-consistent region. Similarity-guided expansion and chemical filtering reduce 83,924 molecules to 1012 candidate divalent spacers, while machine-learned interatomic-potential relaxation and connectivity analysis identify 338 candidates retaining Dion–Jacobson connectivity. Sequential prioritization by connectivity retention, chemical similarity, energetic refinement and synthetic accessibility selects s −2-fluorobutane-1,4-diamine, leading to the synthesis of a PbI 4 -based Dion–Jacobson perovskite with experimentally confirmed ferroelectric switching. This prospective proof of concept shows how sparse property knowledge can be coupled with structural screening to prioritize organic spacer candidates for experimental synthesis.
items.tz: 基于设计的铁电狄昂–雅各布森二维杂化有机–无机钙钛矿的合成
items.az:
Dion–Jacobson 二维杂化有机–无机钙钛矿是具有前景的铁电材料，其有机spacer带来的可调极性与增强的环境稳定性相结合。
然而，由于相形成性的不确定性以及铁电数据的稀缺且具有偏差，理性发现仍然困难。
在这里，我们展示了一种分阶段、基于物理原理的“设计—合成”工作流程，该流程将从稀缺铁电数据中学习与结构感知筛选相结合。
从这一家族中已知的11种铁电化合物出发，符号回归定义了一个描述符有界的铁电一致区域。
基于相似性引导的扩展和化学筛选将83,924个分子缩减至1012个候选的二价 Spacer，而基于机器学习的原子间势能松弛和连接性分析则识别出338个保留Dion–Jacobson连接性的候选结构。
基于连接保留、化学相似性、能量优化和合成可及性的顺序优先级筛选，得到s−2-氟丁烷-1,4-二胺，成功合成了基于PbI₄的Dion–Jacobson钙钛矿，并通过实验验证其铁电开关行为。
本前瞻性概念验证展示了如何将稀疏的物性知识与结构筛选相结合，以优先筛选有机连接体候选者用于实验合成。

items.t: Accelerating SO(2)-Equivariant Materials Models through Low-Precision Emulation
items.a: Rotationally equivariant architectures improve the physical fidelity of machine-learned (ML) universal materials models based on graph neural networks (GNNs). However, their scalability is limited by the use of non-trivial, high-precision tensor operations during both training and inference. Adopting the reduced-precision formats of matrix multiplication units (MMUs), e.g., FP8 instead of FP32, provides massive increases in throughput, up to 30x (60x) on NVIDIA Hopper (Blackwell) GPUs, but may lead to drastic loss of accuracy. Here, we introduce tailored 'emulated' low-precision operations under the integer Ozaki scheme to accelerate the 'SO(2)-equivariant' processing layers of GNNs, which dominate the runtime of (1) many state-of-the-art ML interatomic potentials (MLIPs) and (2) most universal ML Hamiltonian (MLH) models. Our framework, FlashSO(2), outperforms TF32, the most accurate native low-precision MMU format, in throughput, accuracy, and memory footprint at once. At the SO(2) layer level, it reaches 40x (7x) the throughput of MALOQ's (UMA's) reference implementation, an MLH (MLIP) model, sustaining up to 236 (232) effective Tflop/s on an NVIDIA GH200, 3.5x the FP32 peak. At the model level, FlashSO(2) helps train MALOQ 3.9x faster than its pure-FP32 version while reducing peak memory by 58% at no loss in accuracy. In molecular dynamics simulations with UMA, the speedup factor is 3.3x, and the peak memory is reduced by 51%. FlashSO(2) thus pushes the speed-accuracy Pareto frontier of equivariant materials models beyond the native low-precision formats and substantially lowers the resources required to exploit their scaling laws.
items.tz: 通过低精度模拟加速SO(2)-等变材料模型
items.az:
具有旋转不变性的架构能够提升基于图神经网络（GNNs）的机器学习（ML）通用材料模型的物理真实性。
然而，它们的可扩展性受限于训练和推理过程中使用了非平凡且高精度的张量运算。
采用矩阵乘法单元（MMUs）的低精度格式，例如FP8而非FP32，可在NVIDIA Hopper（Blackwell）GPU上实现高达30倍（60倍）的吞吐量提升，但可能导致精度大幅损失。
在此，我们引入基于整数Ozaki方案的定制化“模拟”低精度运算，以加速图神经网络（GNNs）中占主导地位的“SO(2)-等变”处理层，这些处理层决定了（1）众多最先进的机器学习原子间势能（MLIPs）和（2）大多数通用机器学习哈密顿量（MLH）模型的运行时间。
我们的框架 FlashSO(2) 在吞吐量、准确性和内存占用方面同时优于 TF32，即最精确的原生低精度 MMU 格式。
在SO(2)层级别，其吞吐量达到MALOQ的（UMA的）参考实现（MLH（MLIP）模型）的40倍（7倍），在NVIDIA GH200上可维持高达236（232）有效Tflop/s，FP32峰值的3.5倍。
在模型层面，FlashSO(2) 使 MALOQ 的训练速度比其纯 FP32 版本快 3.9 倍，同时在不损失准确率的情况下将峰值内存降低 58%。
在使用UMA的分子动力学模拟中，加速因子为3.3倍，峰值内存减少了51%。
FlashSO(2) 因此将等变材料模型的速度-准确性帕累托前沿推进到了原生低精度格式之外，并显著降低了利用其扩展规律所需资源。

items.t: Active Learning of Conditional Generative Models via the Transport Neural Tangent Kernel
items.a: Many high-throughput scientific experiments produce distributional outputs, requiring conditional generative models to interpret the data, and to predict outcomes at new inputs. Acquiring experimental data at new conditions (e.g., for a new antigen or a new cell type) is often expensive, motivating the need for automated experimental design methods. However, existing active learning frameworks are limited as they assume scalar or vector-valued outputs. We first show that the Wasserstein test risk of a conditional generative task decomposes into a mean term and a shape term, demonstrating why mean-based active learning is blind to distributional shape. To capture both, we propose the transport Neural Tangent Kernel (tNTK), a tractable kernel that measures how sensitive a generative model's predicted distribution is with respect to its parameters. The tNTK recovers the standard NTK in the deterministic limit and upper-bounds the posterior Fréchet variance of the prediction under small parameter perturbations. It admits a closed-form expression for affine Gaussian transport and tractable Monte Carlo estimators otherwise. Treating the tNTK as the covariance function of a Gaussian process, we greedily select inputs that minimize the total GP posterior variance across the pool, yielding a distribution-aware active learning strategy. We evaluate this strategy across four classes of conditional generative models, including conditional flow matching and conditional Monge gap, on synthetic distributions, intent-labeled sentences, and single-cell perturbation responses. In these experiments, the tNTK outperforms the baseline NTK computed from the conditional mean, demonstrating the value of distribution-aware active learning for generative-modeling tasks.
items.tz: 通过最优传输神经切片核实现条件生成模型的主动学习
items.az:
许多高通量科学实验产生分布型输出，需要条件生成模型来解读数据，并对新输入的预测结果进行预测。
在新条件下获取实验数据（例如，针对新的抗原或新的细胞类型）通常成本高昂，这推动了自动化实验设计方法的需求。
然而，现有的主动学习框架存在局限性，因为它们假设输出为标量或向量值。
我们首先证明，条件生成任务的Wasserstein测试风险分解为一个均值项和一个形状项，这说明了基于均值的主动学习对分布形状是盲目的。
为了同时捕捉这两方面，我们提出了传输神经切触核（tNTK），这是一种可处理的核函数，用于衡量生成模型的预测分布对其参数的敏感性。
tNTK 在确定性极限下恢复标准 NTK，并在小参数扰动下对预测的后验 Fréchet 方差提供上界。
它对仿射高斯传输具有闭式表达，对于其他情况则具有可处理的蒙特卡洛估计器。
将tNTK视为高斯过程的协方差函数，我们贪婪地选择那些在池中最小化总GP后验方差的输入，从而得到一种分布感知的主动学习策略。
我们在这四种条件生成模型中评估了该策略，包括条件流匹配和条件Monge间隙，涵盖合成分布、意图标注的句子以及单细胞扰动响应。
在这些实验中，tNTK 比从条件均值计算出的基线 NTK 性能更优，展示了分布感知主动学习在生成模型任务中的价值。

items.t: TCSP3.0: Template-Based Crystal Structure Prediction with Coefficient-Preserving Element Substitution and Structural Diversity
items.a: Template-based crystal structure prediction (CSP) transfers a known crystal structure to a new composition by element substitution, so its accuracy depends on retrieving suitable templates, mapping elements and ranking the resulting candidates correctly. Auditing the original TCSP2.0 implementation on the T180 benchmark, we found that 469 of its 2,347 selected structures (20%) have the wrong composition, caused by element mappings that ignore stoichiometric coefficients and by sequential text substitution that cascades or corrupts element symbols. We propose TCSP3.0, which enforces coefficient-preserving mappings, substitutes species simultaneously on parsed structures and validates every candidate's composition and cell. It further adds periodic-number retrieval, soft oxidation-state evidence, radius-compatibility scoring, structural deduplication, and ORB-v3 machine-learning-potential relaxation and energy ranking of its candidates, as used by deep generative CSP baselines. TCSP3.0 achieves Top-1 and Top-20 match rates of 72.2% and 90.6% on T180, compared with 28.3% and 45.6% for TCSP2.0, and a Top-20 match rate of 74.0% on a new 800-target benchmark (T800). On T180 it also outperforms PNcsp+ and deep generative models CrystalFlow and MaskGXT (Top-1 72.2% versus at most 63.9%). Even without relaxation, TCSP3.0 reaches 67.8% at Top-1 and 90.6% at Top-20 in a median of 28 s per target on two CPU cores, about ten times faster than CrystalFlow. Paired ten-arm ablations on T180 and T800 show that most of the improvement comes from the correctness fixes; structural deduplication significantly improves the Top-5 match rate, embedding-based retrieval is required for coverage, and the remaining scoring features have small or null effects.
items.tz: TCSP3.0：基于模板的晶体结构预测——保持系数的元素替换与结构多样性
items.az: 基于模板的晶体结构预测（CSP）通过元素替换将已知晶体结构迁移到新组成，因此其准确性取决于检索合适的模板、正确映射元素以及对生成的候选结构进行正确排序。在 T180 基准上审计原始 TCSP2.0 实现时，我们发现其 2,347 个选定结构中有 469 个（20%）组成错误，原因是元素映射忽略了化学计量系数，以及顺序文本替换会导致元素符号级联或损坏。我们提出 TCSP3.0，该方法强制实施保持系数的映射，在解析后的结构上同时替换物种，并验证每个候选结构的组成和晶胞。它还进一步添加了原子序数检索、软氧化态证据、半径兼容性评分、结构去重，以及 ORB-v3 机器学习势弛豫和能量排序（与深度生成式 CSP 基线方法所用相同）。TCSP3.0 在 T180 上达到 72.2% 和 90.6% 的 Top-1 和 Top-20 匹配率，而 TCSP2.0 仅为 28.3% 和 45.6%，在新的 800 目标基准（T800）上 Top-20 匹配率为 74.0%。在 T180 上，它还优于 PNcsp+ 以及深度生成模型 CrystalFlow 和 MaskGXT（Top-1 为 72.2%，而后者最高为 63.9%）。即使不进行弛豫，TCSP3.0 在两个 CPU 核心上每个目标的中位时间为 28 秒，Top-1 达到 67.8%，Top-20 达到 90.6%，速度约为 CrystalFlow 的十倍。在 T180 和 T800 上进行的配对十臂消融实验表明，大部分改进来自正确性修复；结构去重显著提高了 Top-5 匹配率，基于嵌入的检索对于覆盖率是必需的，而其余评分特征的效果较小或为零。
items.rv: 针对基于模板的无机晶体结构预测方法 TCSP，修复了元素替换中忽略化学计量系数及文本替换级联损坏的问题，并加入原子序数检索、氧化态证据、半径评分、结构去重和 ORB-v3 机器学习势弛豫。与「生成模型」有间接关联（对比了 CrystalFlow、MaskGXT 等深度生成基线），但本质是模板检索与组合化学修正，与有机分子晶体、视觉生成、相关数学关系较弱。

items.t: How Geometry Shapes Generative Model Evaluation on Riemannian Manifolds
items.a: On Riemannian manifolds, generative-model evaluation is geometry-dependent since curvature and dimension jointly determine distances and volume growth. Our framework systematically compares geodesic, ambient, and tangent-space versions of Wasserstein and MMD across different geometries. Using controlled-noise perturbations and Riemannian Flow Matching samples, we study metric agreement, noise sensitivity, and their relation to geometry-induced volume scaling. We find that no metric is uniformly reliable: evaluation distance can affect both measured discrepancies and noise sensitivity, varying across curvature and dimension. Our analysis leads to practical recommendations for reporting evaluation distances, comparing metric types, and calibrating metrics to the geometry of the samples.
items.tz: 黎曼流形上几何结构如何塑造生成模型评估
items.az: 在黎曼流形上，生成模型的评估依赖于几何结构，因为曲率和维度共同决定了距离和体积增长。我们的框架系统地比较了不同几何下 Wasserstein 和 MMD 的测地线版本、环境版本和切空间版本。利用受控噪声扰动和黎曼流形流匹配样本，我们研究了度量一致性、噪声敏感性及其与几何诱导的体积缩放之间的关系。我们发现没有度量是统一可靠的：评估距离可以同时影响所测量的差异和噪声敏感性，且随曲率和维度而变化。我们的分析得出了关于报告评估距离、比较度量类型以及将度量校准到样本几何结构的实用建议。
items.rv: 本文研究黎曼流形上生成模型评估的几何依赖性，系统比较 Wasserstein 与 MMD 的测地线、环境及切空间版本在曲率和维度变化下的一致性、噪声敏感性与体积缩放关系。方法核心是受控噪声扰动加黎曼流形流匹配样本。与「相关数学」最接近，属黎曼几何与度量空间理论在评估指标校准中的应用，与有机分子晶体、视觉生成关系弱。

items.t: Semantic-First MixGRPO: Reliable Emotional Image Generation via Temporal Decoupling
items.a: Controllable image synthesis should modify visual affect without replacing the objects, layout, or relations specified by a prompt. Existing methods address this tension through conditioning architectures or auxiliary losses, while mixed ordinary differential equation (ODE) and stochastic differential equation (SDE) sampling has mainly been used to accelerate group relative policy optimization (GRPO). We instead study stochastic-window position as an attribute-control variable for flow-based image generation. Using FLUX.1-dev with EmotiCrafter-style valence-arousal conditioning, we compare fixed early, middle, and late four-transition SDE windows, progressive MixGRPO, and full-path Flow-GRPO under matched settings. Because step 0 has the highest noise, our semantic-first schedule uses deterministic ODE sampling at steps 0-19 to establish content, then confines stochastic exploration and policy updates to steps 20-23. Across three seeds, it achieves a CLIPScore of $29.662\pm0.276$, cross-affect DINO consistency of $80.1\pm0.9$, and semantic drift of 2.9%, while reducing training cost by 33.5% relative to full-path Flow-GRPO. Full-path stochastic training remains more accurate on valence-arousal targets, revealing a genuine trade-off. Semantic-first nevertheless improves both affect and semantic metrics over progressive scheduling, preserves the principal subject in 95.98% of images at five extreme or neutral targets, and receives the highest semantic-preservation and overall-preference ratings in a 30-participant study. These results identify probability-flow time as a practical graphics control dimension for reliable affective appearance manipulation.
items.tz: 语义优先 MixGRPO：通过时间解耦实现可靠的情感图像生成
items.az: 可控图像合成应在不替换提示词所指定的对象、布局或关系的前提下修改视觉情感。现有方法通过条件架构或辅助损失来解决这一矛盾，而混合常微分方程（ODE）与随机微分方程（SDE）采样则主要用于加速组相对策略优化（GRPO）。我们转而研究随机窗口位置作为基于流的图像生成中的属性控制变量。使用 FLUX.1-dev 配合 EmotiCrafter 风格的效价-唤醒度条件，我们在匹配设置下比较了固定的早期、中期和晚期四过渡 SDE 窗口、渐进式 MixGRPO 以及全路径 Flow-GRPO。由于第 0 步噪声最高，我们的语义优先调度在第 0-19 步使用确定性 ODE 采样以建立内容，然后将随机探索与策略更新限制在第 20-23 步。在三个随机种子下，该方法取得了 29.662±0.276 的 CLIPScore、80.1±0.9 的跨情感 DINO 一致性以及 2.9% 的语义漂移，同时相比全路径 Flow-GRPO 将训练成本降低了 33.5%。全路径随机训练在效价-唤醒度目标上仍然更准确，揭示了一种真实的权衡。尽管如此，语义优先方法在情感指标和语义指标上均优于渐进式调度，在五个极端或中性目标下于 95.98% 的图像中保留了主要主体，并在 30 名参与者的研究中获得了最高的语义保持和整体偏好评分。这些结果将概率流时间确定为可靠情感外观操控的一个实用图形控制维度。
items.rv: 语义优先 MixGRPO 在基于流的图像生成中将随机窗口位置作为属性控制变量，用早期 ODE 确定性采样建立语义内容、后期 SDE 随机探索操控情感，在 FLUX.1-dev 上实现效价-唤醒度可控的情感图像生成。与「视觉生成」最接近，涉及生成模型采样策略设计，与有机分子晶体及相关数学关系弱。

items.t: Learning Population Dynamics with Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow
items.a: This paper introduces a novel simulation-free framework for learning unbalanced population dynamics on the Riemannian Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) manifold, termed Variational Doob-Wasserstein Flow (VDWF), built upon the theory of the unbalanced mean-field Schrödinger bridge (MFSB). First, by independently learning a geometry model equipped with a data-dependent metric, our model captures the intrinsic geometric structure of population dynamics. Furthermore, leveraging Doob's h-transform, the proposed method incorporates boundary information to improve flow-based trajectory inference. For unbalanced transport, a growth model is employed to learn the dynamics while constructing intermediate mass samples in the WFR space without simulation. Additionally, we analyze the convergence rate of the proposed framework using a uniform Log-Sobolev inequality (LSI). Finally, we validate the proposed approach on multiple real-world datasets, demonstrating competitive performance in learning both balanced and unbalanced population dynamics compared with state-of-the-art methods.
items.tz: 基于变分 Doob-Wasserstein 流学习种群动力学
items.az: 本文提出了一种新颖的无仿真框架，用于在黎曼 Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao（WFR）流形上学习非平衡种群动力学，称为变分 Doob-Wasserstein 流（VDWF），其建立在非平衡平均场 Schrödinger 桥（MFSB）理论之上。首先，通过独立学习一个配备数据依赖度量的几何模型，我们的模型捕捉了种群动力学的内在几何结构。此外，利用 Doob 的 h 变换，所提方法引入边界信息以改进基于流的轨迹推断。对于非平衡传输，采用一个增长模型来学习动力学，同时在 WFR 空间中无需仿真地构造中间质量样本。此外，我们利用一致 Log-Sobolev 不等式（LSI）分析了所提框架的收敛速率。最后，我们在多个真实数据集上验证了所提方法，展示了与最先进方法相比，在学习平衡和非平衡种群动力学方面具有竞争力的性能。
items.rv: 本文在黎曼 WFR 流形上提出变分 Doob-Wasserstein 流（VDWF），基于非平衡平均场 Schrödinger 桥理论，结合数据依赖几何模型与 Doob h 变换，无需仿真即可学习平衡与非平衡种群动力学，并用一致 Log-Sobolev 不等式分析收敛速率。方法核心为 Wasserstein 几何与最优传输，与「相关数学」最为接近，亦涉及生成模型中的流式轨迹推断，与有机分子晶体及视觉生成无直接关联。

items.t: Trajectory Matching: Discrete Flow Matching with Structured Actions
items.a: The natural units of structured discrete generation are often not independent single-component edits but richer actions: attaching a fragment to a molecule, inserting a node together with an incident edge, or growing a hierarchy by adding a child. Yet most existing discrete flow matching methods (DFM) are restricted to independent component-wise edits over fixed-size states. This restriction stems from endpoint conditioning: endpoints fix the source and target during training but not the action sequence between them, making tractable conditional rates hard to define for complex actions that cannot be factorized component-wise. We propose trajectory matching, which conditions the flow on a full sequence of actions connecting the endpoints. This yields principled, simulation-free training targets for user-defined action spaces, including actions that change state size, modify multiple components, or depend on earlier actions. We prove that the resulting objective recovers the marginal flow and that trajectory matching strictly subsumes factorized DFM, while additionally capturing actions with prerequisite structure such as hierarchy growth or fragment-based molecule generation. Empirically, on tree and molecular graph generation, trajectory matching with domain-aligned actions matches or surpasses factorized DFM baselines (lifting MOSES validity from 92.8% to 99.2%) and transfers without retraining to substructure extension and linking. Trajectory matching enlarges the design space of discrete flow matching by turning the action vocabulary into a modeling choice. An interactive explanation of trajectory matching is available at https://niklaskemper.com/blog/trajectory-matching/.
items.tz: 轨迹匹配：基于结构化动作的离散流匹配
items.az: 结构化离散生成的自然单元往往不是独立的单分量编辑，而是更丰富的动作：将片段连接到分子上、插入一个节点及其关联边、或通过添加子节点来扩展层级结构。然而，大多数现有的离散流匹配方法（DFM）仅限于对固定大小状态进行独立的逐分量编辑。这一限制源于端点条件化：端点在训练时固定了源和目标，但未固定它们之间的动作序列，使得对于无法逐分量分解的复杂动作，难以定义可处理的条件速率。我们提出轨迹匹配（trajectory matching），将流条件化于连接端点的完整动作序列上。这为用户自定义的动作空间提供了有原则的、无需仿真的训练目标，包括改变状态大小、修改多个分量或依赖于先前动作的动作。我们证明了所得目标函数能恢复边缘流，且轨迹匹配严格包含因子化DFM，同时还能捕获具有前置结构的动作，如层级扩展或基于片段的分子生成。在实验上，在树和分子图生成任务中，使用领域对齐动作的轨迹匹配达到或超越了因子化DFM基线（将MOSES有效性从92.8%提升至99.2%），并且无需重新训练即可迁移到子结构扩展和连接任务。轨迹匹配通过将动作词汇表转化为建模选择，扩大了离散流匹配的设计空间。轨迹匹配的交互式解释可在 https://niklaskemper.com/blog/trajectory-matching/ 获取。
items.rv: 提出轨迹匹配方法，将离散流匹配的条件从端点扩展为完整动作序列，支持改变状态大小、多分量修改等结构化动作。在分子图生成上MOSES有效性达99.2%，无需重训即可迁移至子结构扩展。与「生成模型」最接近，属离散分子生成方向；与有机分子晶体、视觉生成关系弱；数学上涉及边缘流恢复的严格证明。

items.t: Optimal-transport flow matching for stochastic model ipdating
items.a: Deep generative models have attracted considerable attention as inference engines for stochastic model updating. Among these deep generative models, conditional flow matching offers a particularly efficient formulation, in which a continuous transport map from a latent distribution to the posterior is learned by regression against optimal-transport probability paths, avoiding both the invertibility constraints of normalising flows and the iterative denoising of diffusion models. However, its performance in engineering model updating has not been examined against an established baseline such as the Bayesian updating framework under controlled conditions. In this work, conditional flow matching is therefore assessed against the Bayesian model updating approach with transitional Markov chain Monte Carlo, in which the Bhattacharyya distance provides the approximate likelihood for the Bayesian approach. The two methods are assessed with respect to posterior fidelity, evaluated by statistical distances against the known ground truth and computational expenditure in model evaluations, with the offline training budget reported separately from the inference cost of each subsequent conditioning. A 3-DOF spring–mass system with uncertain stiffness parameters serves as the benchmark. Since the calibrated posterior constitutes the input description upon which subsequent reliability assessment depends, the accuracy and the marginal cost of the updating step both bear directly on reliability computations. In addition, the amortised nature of the learned transport map is discussed in this work, as it permits the posterior to be re-evaluated under new observations at negligible cost, which is a property of practical relevance to reliability assessment under sequentially acquired monitoring data.
items.v: Technische Universität Dortmund Eldorado (Technische Universität Dortmund)
items.tz: 最优传输流匹配用于随机模型更新
items.az: 深度生成模型作为随机模型更新的推理引擎已引起广泛关注。在这些深度生成模型中，条件流匹配提供了一种特别高效的表述形式，其中通过针对最优传输概率路径进行回归来学习从隐分布到后验的连续传输映射，从而避免了归一化流的逆约束和扩散模型的迭代去噪。然而，其在工程模型更新中的性能尚未在受控条件下与贝叶斯更新框架等已确立的基线进行过对比检验。因此，本工作将条件流匹配与采用过渡马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛的贝叶斯模型更新方法进行评估对比，其中Bhattacharyya距离为贝叶斯方法提供近似似然。两种方法从后验保真度（通过与已知真值之间的统计距离评估）和模型评估中的计算开销两方面进行评估，离线训练预算与每次后续条件化的推理成本分别报告。一个具有不确定刚度参数的三自由度弹簧-质量系统作为基准。由于校准后的后验构成后续可靠性评估所依赖的输入描述，更新步骤的精度和边际成本都直接影响可靠性计算。此外，本工作还讨论了所学习传输映射的摊销性质，因为它允许在新观测下以极低的成本重新评估后验，这一特性对于顺序获取监测数据条件下的可靠性评估具有实际意义。
items.rv: 条件流匹配（沿最优传输路径回归）用于工程结构随机模型更新，与贝叶斯MCMC在3-DOF弹簧-质量系统上对比后验保真度与计算成本，并讨论摊销推理。属生成模型（流匹配/最优传输）在贝叶斯推断中的应用，与生成模型类较近，与有机分子晶体、视觉生成关系弱。

items.t: Density-Level Backward Error for Low-NFE Generative Flows
items.a: Low-NFE generative ODE sampling is constrained not only by solver order, but also by how a fixed budget of network evaluations is distributed along the flow. We develop a density-level backward-error framework that identifies the component of a solver's modified-equation defect that changes the evolving marginal, while excluding solenoidal trajectory distortion that is invisible in Wasserstein tangent geometry. The resulting residual induces a solver-order-aware compute-allocation rule and, through gauge freedom, an objective for selecting numerically favorable velocity representatives of the same density path. This separates our approach from schedule search driven by trajectory or endpoint surrogates and from higher-order solver design. Exact Gaussian and mixture models establish the mechanism, including cases where curvature-based allocation fails and continuum-optimal transport is not discretization-optimal. On a pretrained CIFAR-10 EDM probability-flow ODE, density-aware allocation consistently improves fixed-update Euler sampling in the low-NFE regime. Matched-seed convergence to a dense Euler reference confirms that the method accelerates approximation of the same high-NFE flow rather than changing the asymptotic sampler.
items.tz: 低NFE生成流中的密度层面后向误差
items.az: 低NFE（网络函数评估次数）生成式ODE采样不仅受求解器阶数的限制，还受固定网络评估预算沿流分布方式的影响。我们发展了一个密度层面的后向误差框架，该框架识别求解器修正方程缺陷中改变演化边缘分布的组分，同时排除在Wasserstein切几何中不可见的无散度轨迹畸变。由此产生的残差诱导了一个感知求解器阶数的计算分配规则，并通过规范自由度，为选择同一密度路径上数值上有利的速度代表提供了目标函数。这使我们的方法与由轨迹或端点代理驱动的调度搜索以及高阶求解器设计区分开来。精确的高斯模型和混合模型建立了该机制，包括基于曲率的分配失效以及连续最优传输并非离散化最优的情况。在预训练的CIFAR-10 EDM概率流ODE上，密度感知分配在低NFE区间内一致地改善了固定步长Euler采样。与密集Euler参考的匹配种子收敛性确认，该方法加速了对同一高NFE流的近似，而非改变渐近采样器。
items.rv: 本文针对生成式ODE采样中低NFE条件下的计算分配问题，提出密度层面后向误差分析框架，用以指导固定预算下沿流的计算分配策略。属于「生成模型」与数值ODE求解的交叉方向，涉及Wasserstein几何、最优传输等数学工具，与有机分子晶体、视觉生成无直接关系。

items.t: Disentangling total-variance and signal-to-noise-ratio improves diffusion models
items.a: Diffusion models have been widely adopted as a powerful generative framework across numerous scientific domains, yet their inherently iterative sampling process remains a significant computational bottleneck. While this is typically mitigated by reducing the number of reverse diffusion steps, sample quality becomes highly sensitive to the chosen noise schedule, i.e., the manner in which noise is introduced and the signal is reduced at each step. Although prior work has improved on the original variance-preserving and variance-exploding schedules, these approaches passively adjust the total variance, without direct independent control over it. In this work, we propose a novel total-variance/signal-to-noise-ratio disentangled (TV/SNR) framework, where TV and SNR can be controlled independently. Our approach reveals that schedules with exponentially exploding TV can be consistently improved by adopting a constant TV schedule while preserving the underlying SNR schedule. Furthermore, we demonstrate that generalizing the SNR schedule of optimal transport flow matching significantly enhances generation efficiency. Crucially, these gains remain consistent across various reverse diffusion solvers and reduce the search space to two independent and interpretable parameters, enabling fast and robust sampling for complex scientific applications, such as molecular structure generation.
items.tz: 解耦总方差与信噪比改进扩散模型
items.az: 扩散模型已被广泛采用为众多科学领域中强大的生成框架，但其固有的迭代采样过程仍然是显著的计算瓶颈。虽然这通常通过减少反向扩散步数来缓解，但样本质量对所选择的噪声调度（即噪声引入和信号衰减的方式）变得高度敏感。尽管先前工作改进了原始的方差保持和方差爆炸调度，但这些方法只是被动地调整总方差，而无法对其进行直接的独立控制。在本工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的总方差/信噪比解耦（TV/SNR）框架，其中总方差和信噪比可以被独立控制。我们的方法揭示，具有指数爆炸总方差的调度可以通过采用恒定总方差调度来一致地改进，同时保留底层的信噪比调度。此外，我们证明泛化最优传输流匹配的信噪比调度能显著提升生成效率。关键的是，这些增益在各种反向扩散求解器中保持一致，并将搜索空间缩减为两个独立且可解释的参数，从而为复杂科学应用（如分子结构生成）实现快速且鲁棒的采样。
items.rv: 本文针对扩散模型噪声调度问题，提出TV/SNR解耦框架，将总方差与信噪比拆为两个独立可控参数，发现恒定TV调度可一致优于指数爆炸TV调度，并泛化了最优传输流匹配的SNR调度以提升采样效率。属于生成模型方向，核心贡献在扩散采样调度的数学结构上，与视觉生成和分子结构生成均有应用关联，与有机分子晶体无直接关系。

items.t: Representation Learning via Composite Subspace Flow Matching
items.a: Distilling semantic meaning from raw image data remains a challenge in machine learning. Current self-supervised paradigms face a trade-off: joint-embedding architectures produce relevant features by aggressively discarding intra-class variance, irreversibly spatial and reconstruction. Conversely, generative models preserve spatial details but struggle to isolate semantics, as their optimization is dominated by pixel variations. To bridge this divide, we propose composite subspace flow matching (CSFM). Rather than corrupting data with unstructured isotropic noise, CSFM formulates representation learning as the variance-minimizing inversion of a deterministic degradation curriculum across spectral, color, and illumination subspaces. By bounding trajectory variance with hard temporal style truncation, a capacity-constrained encoder is driven to ignore transient style artifacts and encode persistent content. Empirical evaluations across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and STL-10 show that CSFM yields competitive discriminative transferability while preserving generative synthesis across both convolutional and vision transformer architectures. By avoiding the collapse pathologies of non-generative methods, CSFM forms a smooth latent space that outperforms standard optimal transport flows on linear probing and few-shot classification, while enabling coherent synthesis and trajectory interpolation. These results confirm that steering the physical dynamics of generative flows offers a scalable paradigm for learning representations that are simultaneously linearly separable and generatively invertible.
items.tz: 基于复合子空间流匹配的表示学习
items.az: 从原始图像数据中提炼语义信息仍然是机器学习领域的一项挑战。当前自监督范式面临一个权衡：联合嵌入架构通过激进地丢弃类内方差来产生相关特征，但不可逆地丧失了空间信息和重建能力。相反，生成模型保留了空间细节，但难以分离语义，因为其优化过程被像素变化所主导。为了弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出了复合子空间流匹配（CSFM）。CSFM 不使用无结构的各向同性噪声来破坏数据，而是将表示学习表述为在光谱、颜色和光照子空间上对确定性退化课程进行方差最小化逆过程。通过硬性时间风格截断来约束轨迹方差，容量受限的编码器被驱动去忽略瞬态风格伪影并编码持久内容。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 STL-10 上的实证评估表明，CSFM 在卷积和视觉 Transformer 架构上均能产生有竞争力的判别性迁移能力，同时保留生成式合成能力。通过避免非生成方法的坍缩病理，CSFM 形成了一个平滑的潜空间，在线性探测和少样本分类上优于标准最优传输流，同时支持连贯合成和轨迹插值。这些结果证实，引导生成流的物理动力学为学习同时具有线性可分性和生成可逆性的表示提供了一个可扩展的范式。
items.rv: CSFM 将自监督表示学习建模为在光谱、颜色、光照子空间上对确定性退化课程的方差最小化逆过程，以硬性时间风格截断约束轨迹方差，驱动容量受限编码器忽略瞬态风格、编码持久内容。在 CIFAR 系列和 STL-10 上验证了判别迁移与生成合成的兼顾。与「视觉生成」和「生成模型」关系较近，核心工具是流匹配与最优传输，与有机分子晶体无关。
