items.t: Lifting PCA in the Wasserstein Space
items.a: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a fundamental tool for statistical dimension reduction, yet no canonical extension to distribution-valued data has emerged within the framework of optimal transport. While Wasserstein barycenters and Wasserstein least-squares regression provide canonical liftings of Euclidean averaging and linear regression in the Wasserstein space, an analogous principle for PCA has remained unexplored. In this paper, we introduce Lifted PCA, a canonical extension of Euclidean PCA to Wasserstein space, obtained through the framework of lifting functionals in the space of probability measures by convex extension. Starting from the classical variational formulations of PCA on the Stiefel and Grassmann manifolds, we derive two equivalent minimization problems over probability measures supported on these manifolds that correspond to Wasserstein barycenters with generalized costs. We establish an exact analogue of the equivalence between the Stiefel and Grassmann formulations of Euclidean PCA, preserving PCA's original variational structure under lifting. We further derive dual formulations and optimality conditions, and establish equivalences with multimarginal optimal transport and matching-for-teams problems. We also establish statistical consistency for empirical estimators and develop computational algorithms based on the Wasserstein barycenter formulation over the Stiefel manifold. Whereas Euclidean PCA summarizes vectors through projections onto an optimal low-dimensional linear subspace, Lifted PCA summarizes probability distributions through an optimal probability measure supported on multiple low-dimensional subspaces. Numerical experiments on distributional datasets illustrate the practical performance of the proposed methodology and its benefits for distributional data analysis.
items.tz: 在 Wasserstein 空间中提升 PCA
items.az: 主成分分析（PCA）是统计降维的基本工具，然而在最优化传输框架内，尚未出现面向分布值数据的规范推广。尽管 Wasserstein 质心和 Wasserstein 最小二乘回归分别为 Wasserstein 空间中欧氏平均和线性回归提供了规范提升，但 PCA 的类似原理一直未被探索。本文引入 Lifted PCA，即欧氏 PCA 到 Wasserstein 空间的规范推广，通过概率测度空间中泛函提升的凸延拓框架获得。从 PCA 在 Stiefel 流形和 Grassmann 流形上的经典变分表述出发，我们推导出关于支撑在这些流形上的概率测度的两个等价极小化问题，它们对应于具有广义代价的 Wasserstein 质心。我们建立了欧氏 PCA 的 Stiefel 表述与 Grassmann 表述之间等价性的精确等价性的类比，在提升下保持了 PCA 原有的变分结构。我们进一步推导了对偶表述和最优性条件，并建立了与多边缘最优传输及团队匹配问题的等价性。我们还建立了经验估计量的统计一致性，并开发了基于 Stiefel 流形上 Wasserstein 质心表述的计算算法。欧氏 PCA 通过向最优低维线性子空间的投影来概括向量，而 Lifted PCA 则通过支撑在多个低维子空间上的最优概率测度来概括概率分布。在分布数据集上的数值实验展示了所提方法的实际性能及其对分布数据分析的优势。
items.rv: 本文将欧氏 PCA 经凸延拓提升到 Wasserstein 空间，得到 Lifted PCA，核心是在 Stiefel 与 Grassmann 流形上求广义代价的 Wasserstein 质心，并给出对偶、最优性条件及算法。方法属最优传输与流形变分分析交叉，与有机分子晶体、生成模型、视觉生成均无直接关联，与「相关数学」最为接近。

items.t: Stabilizing Filters for Graph Signal Generation
items.a: Generating graph signals is an important task in machine learning, and incorporating the underlying graph into a generative model enables structurally-informed distribution modeling. However, said graph is often noisy or imperfectly estimated, and structural errors can affect the generative process and the resulting signal distribution. While recent work has established stability guarantees for graph neural ordinary differential equations, the robustness of graph-aware reference dynamics, as used in topological Schrödinger bridge models, remains largely unexplored. Here, we investigate the structural stability of continuous-time generative models whose dynamics combine a graph filter with a learned graph neural network. We first derive a Wasserstein stability bound that quantifies the effect of graph perturbations on the generated signal distributions. Informed by this analysis, we then propose a principled framework for designing graph filters that balance structural stability with induced signal smoothing. We characterize the optimal filter design and provide an explicit family of polynomial filters with provable stability guarantees. Experiments on synthetic graphs and real-world fMRI signals support our theoretical findings, illustrating the enhanced structural stability of the proposed filters while preserving generative performance.
items.tz: 图信号生成的稳定化滤波器
items.az: 生成图信号是机器学习中的重要任务，将底层图结构纳入生成模型可以实现结构感知的分布建模。然而，该图往往存在噪声或估计不完美，结构误差可能影响生成过程及所得信号分布。尽管近期工作已为图神经常微分方程建立了稳定性保证，但拓扑薛定谔桥模型中所使用的图感知参考动力学的鲁棒性仍 largely 未被探索。本文研究一类连续时间生成模型的结构稳定性，其动力学由图滤波器与学习得到的图神经网络组合而成。我们首先推导了一个 Wasserstein 稳定性界，用以量化图扰动对生成信号分布的影响。基于该分析，我们进一步提出了一个有原则的框架，用于设计在结构稳定性与所诱导的信号平滑之间取得平衡的图滤波器。我们刻画了最优滤波器设计，并给出了一族具有可证明稳定性保证的显式多项式滤波器。在合成图和真实 fMRI 信号上的实验支持了我们的理论发现，表明所提滤波器在保持生成性能的同时增强了结构稳定性。
items.rv: 本文针对连续时间图信号生成模型，研究图滤波器在底层图存在结构扰动时的稳定性。核心工作是推导 Wasserstein 稳定性界，并据此设计一族具有可证明稳定性保证的多项式图滤波器，在合成图与 fMRI 数据上验证。与「生成模型」及「相关数学」（Wasserstein 几何、图信号处理）关系较近，与有机分子晶体、视觉生成关系弱。

items.t: Generative Modeling via Nonlinear Schrödinger Bridges and Branching Diffusions
items.a: We propose a new generative modeling framework grounded in forward-backward partial differential equations (PDEs). These equations arise naturally in mean-field game (MFG) theory, and are closely related to nonlinear Schrödinger systems. Our main contribution is to reinterpret this connection within the setting of generative modeling and to develop an efficient numerical methodology for its practical implementation. Specifically, we derive and characterize a nonlinear extension of the classical Schrödinger bridge problem through a coupled system of PDEs, yielding a model we call SBNL (Schrödinger Bridge NonLinear). To compute its solution, we design a simulation algorithm based on branching diffusions and the probabilistic representation of semilinear PDEs. The resulting method is embarrassingly parallel, scalable to high dimensions, and applicable to a broad class of nonlinear interaction functionals. We validate the approach through numerical experiments, including recovery of the classical Schrödinger bridge, nonlinear extensions with convex penalties (Gross-Pitaevskii) as well as potential interaction terms, and high-dimensional generative tasks such as image synthesis on the MNIST and FFHQ human face dataset. Furthermore, the same framework embeds score-based generative modeling, diffusion models, and tractable gaussian Schrödinger bridges.
items.tz: 基于非线性薛定谔桥与分支扩散的生成建模
items.az: 我们提出了一种基于前向-后向偏微分方程（PDE）的新型生成建模框架。这些方程自然地出现在平均场博弈（MFG）理论中，并与非线性薛定谔系统密切相关。我们的主要贡献是在生成建模的语境下重新诠释这一联系，并开发一种高效的数值方法以实现其实际应用。具体而言，我们通过一个耦合的PDE系统推导并刻画了经典薛定谔桥问题的非线性扩展，得到了我们称为SBNL（薛定谔桥非线性）的模型。为计算其解，我们设计了一种基于分支扩散和半线性PDE概率表示的模拟算法。所得方法具有天然的并行性，可扩展到高维空间，并适用于广泛的非线性交互泛函。我们通过数值实验验证了该方法，包括恢复经典薛定谔桥、带有凸惩罚项（Gross-Pitaevskii）以及势交互项的非线性扩展，以及高维生成任务，如在MNIST和FFHQ人脸数据集上的图像合成。此外，同一框架还嵌入了基于分数的生成建模、扩散模型以及可处理的gaussian薛定谔桥。
items.rv: 提出SBNL模型，将平均场博弈中的前向-后向PDE与薛定谔桥问题结合，用分支扩散算法求解非线性扩展，在MNIST和FFHQ上完成图像合成。方法本质是扩散生成模型的PDE化表述，与「生成模型」最接近，数学工具涉及半线性PDE的概率表示，与「相关数学」也有交叉。
items.tw: 预印本或来源不明；作者不在关注名单

items.t: Schrödinger-Bass Bridge Barycenter Models for Measure-Valued Data
items.a: Barycenter models, based on stochastic and deterministic optimal transport bridges between probability measures, have proven to be useful for supervised and unsupervised learning for (probability) measure-valued data. In this paper, we utilize the directional asymmetry and dual drift-diffusion control arising in the recently proposed Schrödinger-Bass Bridge (SBB) between two measures, and propose \textit{SBB-encoder}, \textit{SBB-decoder}, \textit{SBB-symmetric}, and \textit{SBB-Markovian} barycenter models. For each of these novel models, our first theoretical result establishes the existence of the SBB-barycenter under mild assumptions. Our second theoretical result characterizes the decoder SBB-barycenter of Gaussians where we show that for Gaussian input measures, the decoder formulation admits a Gaussian minimizer, reducing barycenter computation to a finite-dimensional optimization and yielding a compact algorithm. For general input measures, we derive a hybrid Wasserstein gradient particle descent scheme for all four formulations using the SBB dual representation. Finally, we utilize these algorithms for solving distributional-inverse/interpolation problems arising in the context of spatial images and single-cell RNA sequencing data, where we show that the SBB-decoder and Markovian barycenter allow us to interpolate between successive time points. Results show that our method outperforms existing barycenter models for measure interpolation and inference.
items.tz: 基于 Schrödinger-Bass 桥的测度值数据重心模型
items.az: 基于概率测度之间随机与确定性最优传输桥的重心模型，已被证明对（概率）测度值数据的有监督和无监督学习非常有用。在本文中，我们利用最近在两个测度之间提出的 Schrödinger-Bass 桥（SBB）中出现的方向不对称性和对偶漂移-扩散控制，提出了 SBB-encoder、SBB-decoder、SBB-symmetric 和 SBB-Markovian 重心模型。对于每个新型模型，我们的第一个理论结果在温和假设下建立了 SBB 重心的存在性。我们的第二个理论结果刻画了高斯分布的解码器 SBB 重心，我们证明对于高斯输入测度，解码器形式存在高斯极小化器，将重心计算归约为有限维优化问题，并给出一个紧凑算法。对于一般输入测度，我们利用 SBB 对偶表示为所有四种形式推导了一种混合 Wasserstein 梯度粒子下降方案。最后，我们利用这些算法解决空间图像和单细胞 RNA 测序数据中出现的分布逆问题与插值问题，其中我们表明 SBB-decoder 和 Markovian 重心允许我们在连续时间点之间进行插值。结果表明，我们的方法在测度插值和推断方面优于现有的重心模型。
items.rv: 基于 Schrödinger-Bass 桥的方向不对称性与对偶漂移-扩散控制，提出 encoder、decoder、symmetric、Markovian 四种测度重心模型，证明存在性，给出高斯情形有限维优化与一般情形混合 Wasserstein 梯度粒子下降算法，应用于空间图像及单细胞 RNA 测序的分布插值。与「相关数学」（最优传输、Schrödinger 桥、Wasserstein 几何）最接近，与生成模型有弱关联，与有机分子晶体、视觉生成关系弱。

items.t: Structure and Stability Prediction of Binary and Ternary Molecular Mixed Crystals Using Ensemble Free Energies
items.a: Mixed crystals provide a route to tune the properties of molecular solids through continuous changes in composition. However, predicting their stability is challenging because it requires determining both substitution energies and configurational entropy across large configuration spaces. Here, we combine crystal structure prediction, force field lattice energy and lattice dynamics calculations, and Δ-machine-learning energy corrections with a scaled partition-function approach to assess structure prediction and evaluate binary and ternary mixed crystals of anthracene (ANT), acridine (ACR), and phenazine (PNZ). The composition-dependent ensemble free energy (ΔGensemble) was estimated without exhaustive enumeration of all configurations from representative ensembles of substituted supercell models of mixed crystals. Crystal structure prediction reproduces the known polymorphs as the lowest energy structures and the mixed crystal modelling approach reproduces the main experimental binary trends: ACR incorporation into ANT and the α and β polymorphs of PNZ, ANT incorporation into ACR form II, and the formation of a PNZ β-type ternary phase. Furthermore, we predict additional thermodynamically stable compositions, including PNZ incorporation into ACR form IX, and ternary crystals based on ACR forms II, VI and VII. Stable three-component regions arise from binary trends, with ACR mediating between both ANT and PNZ. These results demonstrate a practical framework for predicting the structure, thermodynamic stability and composition limits of molecular mixed crystals. The mixed crystal modelling methods are available within the mol-CSPy crystal structure prediction package.
items.tz: 使用系综自由能预测二元和三元分子混合晶体的结构与稳定性
items.az: 混合晶体为通过组成的连续变化来调节分子固体性质提供了一条途径。然而，预测其稳定性具有挑战性，因为它需要在大构型空间中同时确定取代能和构型熵。在此，我们将晶体结构预测、力场晶格能和晶格动力学计算以及Δ机器学习能量校正与缩放配分函数方法相结合，以评估结构预测并评价蒽（ANT）、吖啶（ACR）和吩嗪（PNZ）的二元和三元混合晶体。组成依赖的系综自由能（ΔGensemble）通过混合晶体取代超胞模型的代表性系综进行估算，而无需对所有构型进行穷举枚举。晶体结构预测将已知多晶型复现为最低能量结构，混合晶体建模方法复现了主要的实验二元趋势：ACR掺入ANT以及PNZ的α和β多晶型、ANT掺入ACR II型，以及PNZ β型三元相的形成。此外，我们预测了额外的热力学稳定组成，包括PNZ掺入ACR IX型，以及基于ACR II型、VI型和VII型的三元晶体。稳定的三组分区域源于二元趋势，其中ACR在ANT和PNZ之间起中介作用。这些结果展示了一个预测分子混合晶体结构、热力学稳定性和组成极限的实用框架。混合晶体建模方法可在mol-CSPy晶体结构预测软件包中使用。
items.rv: 针对蒽、吖啶、吩嗪的二元与三元分子混合晶体，结合晶体结构预测、力场晶格能、晶格动力学、Δ机器学习能量校正与缩放配分函数，估算组成依赖的系综自由能，无需穷举构型。复现了已知多晶型及实验二元趋势，并预测了新的热力学稳定组成。与「有机分子晶体」直接相关，属结构预测与热力学评估，与生成模型、视觉生成关系弱。
items.tw: 作者：Graeme M. Day；期刊在重点名单

items.t: Automatically Building and Updating a Knowledge Graph of MLIP Models
items.a: Complementing the many efforts in providing semantic representations of concepts, notions, and entities in materials science, we report and illustrate a process by which we can automatically build a knowledge graph of the fast evolving field of machine learning applied to the prediction of material properties, focusing on MLIP (Machine Learning Interatomic Potential). This LLM-based process relies on multiple steps, from information extraction in documents and articles to a validation loop using SHACL constraints to detect and correct errors. It is carried out on a model-by-model basis, focusing on the consistency of representation, therefore enabling an iterative construction where the addition of new models is facilitated. We illustrate the process by showing a few interesting aspects that can be queried from a knowledge graph built from the models listed in the Matbench Discovery leaderboard.
items.tz: 自动构建和更新 MLIP 模型知识图谱
items.az: 作为材料科学中为概念、观念和实体提供语义表示的众多工作的补充，我们报告并展示了一个流程，通过该流程可以自动构建一个知识图谱，覆盖机器学习应用于材料性质预测这一快速演进的领域，重点聚焦于 MLIP（机器学习原子间势）。这一基于大语言模型（LLM）的流程依赖多个步骤，从文档和文章中的信息提取，到使用 SHACL 约束进行验证循环以检测和纠正错误。该流程以逐模型为基础进行，关注表示的一致性，从而实现了迭代式构建，使得新模型的添加更加便捷。我们通过展示从基于 Matbench Discovery 排行榜中所列模型构建的知识图谱中可以查询到的若干有趣方面来说明该流程。
items.rv: 该工作利用 LLM 结合 SHACL 约束，逐模型自动构建并迭代更新 MLIP（机器学习原子间势）领域的知识图谱，核心贡献在于语义表示的一致性与可查询性。属于材料信息学与知识工程交叉方向，与「有机分子晶体」「生成模型」「视觉生成」「相关数学」均无实质关联，关系较弱。

items.t: Machine‐Learning‐Potential‐Driven Volcano Relationship in Grain Boundary Amorphicity and Ionic Transport of Antiperovskite Solid Electrolytes
items.a: Ionic transport in solid‐state electrolytes is governed by interfacial disorder and local chemical environments, yet their microscopic design principles remain challenging because large‐scale interfacial kinetics are simulated using molecular dynamics (MD), where predictive design requires quantum‐level accuracy. Here, we use an actively learned machine learning interatomic potential (MLIP) to bridge this scale‐accuracy gap in halide‐tunable antiperovskite solid electrolytes. By varying the local Cl − /Br − ratio and quantifying interfacial amorphicity and ion flux, we identify an MLIP‐driven volcano relationship between structural disorder and ionic transport. Cl‐enriched grain boundaries remain overly ordered, whereas Br − enrichment induces excessive disorder that disrupts migration. Intermediate halide compositions maximize ionic transport through moderately amorphous environments. Guided by this relationship, we design an anion‐engineered grain boundary through selective halide tuning. These results establish controlled anion segregation as a strategy for reducing interfacial resistance and highlight MLIP‐enhanced MD as a predictive framework for transport and disorder engineering in solid‐state materials.
items.tz: 机器学习势驱动的反钙钛矿固体电解质晶界非晶化与离子传输中的火山关系
items.az: 固态电解质中的离子传输受界面无序度和局部化学环境控制，但其微观设计原则仍具挑战性，因为大规模界面动力学需借助分子动力学（MD）模拟，而预测性设计需要量子级别的精度。在此，我们使用主动学习的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）来弥合卤化物可调反钙钛矿固体电解质中这一尺度-精度差距。通过改变局部 Cl−/Br− 比例并量化界面非晶化程度和离子通量，我们识别出结构无序度与离子传输之间由 MLIP 驱动的火山关系。富 Cl 晶界仍过于有序，而富 Br 则诱导过度无序从而破坏迁移。中间卤化物组成通过适度非晶化环境实现离子传输最大化。在该关系指导下，我们通过选择性卤化物调控设计了阴离子工程化晶界。这些结果确立了受控阴离子偏析作为降低界面电阻的策略，并突出了 MLIP 增强 MD 作为固态材料中传输与无序工程预测性框架的价值。
items.rv: 用主动学习 MLIP 做反钙钛矿固体电解质晶界分子动力学模拟，发现卤化物比例与离子传输间的火山关系，据此设计阴离子工程化晶界。属计算材料与分子动力学范畴，与有机分子晶体、生成模型、视觉生成均无直接关联，与相关数学也关系较弱，更接近统计物理与计算化学。

items.t: Orbitol: Crystal Generation on Wyckoff Orbits
items.a: Generative models propose crystalline materials by learning composition and geometry, but unconditional sampling gives no direct control over the space group, which constrains whether responses such as piezoelectricity are symmetry-allowed. We present Orbitol, a crystal generator built on the Crystalite diffusion Transformer that replaces atom tokens with Wyckoff-orbit tokens. Given a space group and a collection of occupied Wyckoff positions, Orbitol generates the atom type and free coordinates of each orbit together with a compatible lattice, so every valid structure is invariant under the operations of the requested group. It generates structures two to three orders of magnitude faster than the symmetry-aware baselines at the evaluated settings. On MP-20, 13.8% of Orbitol's attempts yielded stable or metastable, unique and novel structures that retained the requested space group after relaxation, compared with 10.8% for SGFM, the next best model. We also introduce SPARC, a score that combines retention of the raw detected space group with agreement between the retained-group and training distributions. Finally, we used Orbitol to generate candidates in piezoelectric crystal classes. Of the structures selected by internal screening, 89% passed our density functional theory checks, and 79% also matched no Materials Project or Alexandria entry with the same space group. Their median figure of merit was nine times that of the piezoelectric materials computed in the Materials Project, and 24% of the new candidates ranked in that set's top 10%.
items.tz: Orbitol：基于 Wyckoff 轨道的晶体生成
items.az: 生成模型通过学习成分和几何结构来提出晶体材料，但无条件采样无法直接控制空间群，而空间群决定了压电性等响应是否在对称性上被允许。我们提出 Orbitol，一个基于 Crystalite 扩散 Transformer 的晶体生成器，用 Wyckoff 轨道 token 替代原子 token。给定一个空间群和一组被占据的 Wyckoff 位置，Orbitol 生成每个轨道的原子类型和自由坐标以及一个兼容的晶格，使得每个有效结构在所请求群的对称操作下保持不变。在评估的设置下，它比对称性感知基线快两到三个数量级地生成结构。在 MP-20 上，Orbitol 13.8% 的尝试产生了稳定或亚稳的、独特且新颖的结构，且在弛豫后保留了所请求的空间群，而次优模型 SGFM 为 10.8%。我们还引入了 SPARC，一个将原始检测空间群的保留率与保留群分布和训练分布之间的一致性相结合的评分。最后，我们使用 Orbitol 在压电晶体类中生成候选结构。在内部筛选选出的结构中，89% 通过了我们的密度泛函理论检验，79% 也未与 Materials Project 或 Alexandria 中具有相同空间群的条目匹配。它们的中位数品质因数是 Materials Project 中计算的压电材料的九倍，24% 的新候选结构排在该集合的前 10%。
items.rv: Orbitol 是基于扩散 Transformer 的晶体生成器，用 Wyckoff 轨道 token 替代原子 token，在生成时直接约束空间群对称性，比对称性感知基线快两到三个数量级。属于晶体结构生成与生成模型方向，与有机分子晶体关系较弱，但条件生成与对称性约束的方法论对分子晶体生成有参考意义。

items.t: Machine Learning-Assisted Discovery of Carbon-Related Defect Formation Mechanisms in Diamond
items.a: Diamond is an important host material for functional defects such as solid-state spin qubits. During the defect creation by irradiation and subsequent thermal annealing, carbon-related defects, including vacancies and interstitials, are generated and can migrate to form new defect complexes. To investigate this kinetically driven process and reveal the formation mechanisms of the di-interstitials and di-vacancies in the neutral charge state, we fine-tuned a universal machine learning interatomic potential using a small dataset generated from density functional theory calculations. We obtained a barrier of 1.84 eV for mono-interstitial migration and found that two initially separated mono-interstitials only need to overcome a lower barrier to form di-interstitial configurations. Beyond the training data, the MLIP also identified the formation pathway for an additional di-interstitial configuration and a stepwise divacancy dissociation mechanism. These results reveal migration-assisted defect complex formation mechanisms and demonstrate how targeted MLIP training can identify reaction pathways.
items.tz: 机器学习辅助发现金刚石中碳相关缺陷形成机制
items.az: 金刚石是固态自旋量子比特等功能缺陷的重要宿主材料。在辐照产生缺陷及随后的热退火过程中，会产生包括空位和间隙原子在内的碳相关缺陷，这些缺陷可以迁移并形成新的缺陷复合体。为了研究这一动力学驱动过程并揭示中性电荷态下双间隙原子和双空位的形成机制，我们使用由密度泛函理论计算生成的小数据集对一个通用机器学习原子间势进行了微调。我们得到单间隙原子迁移势垒为1.84 eV，并发现两个初始分离的单间隙原子只需克服更低的势垒即可形成双间隙原子构型。在训练数据之外，该机器学习原子间势还识别出另一种双间隙原子构型的形成路径以及逐步双空位解离机制。这些结果揭示了迁移辅助的缺陷复合体形成机制，并展示了如何通过针对性的机器学习原子间势训练来识别反应路径。
items.rv: 本文用微调的机器学习原子间势（MLIP）研究金刚石中碳相关缺陷（空位、间隙原子）的迁移与复合形成机制，属于计算材料与缺陷物理范畴。与「有机分子晶体 / 生成模型 / 视觉生成 / 相关数学」四类均关系较弱，最接近的或许是「相关数学」中势函数与能量面搜索，但本质仍是凝聚态物理问题。

items.t: CrystalAR: Autoregressive Modeling for Symmetric Crystal Generation
items.a: Deep generative modeling has achieved remarkable progress in crystal generation. Given the rich symmetries inherent in crystalline structures, recent work has sought to explicitly incorporate space-group symmetry into generative models, enabling more effective exploration of novel symmetry templates. Yet introducing symmetry templates increases the combinatorial complexity of stoichiometric relationships between atomic species and crystallographic sites, while creating a fundamental tension between flexible exploration of discrete crystallographic templates and faithful realization of these templates as continuous three-dimensional structures. To address these challenges, we propose CrystalAR, a unified autoregressive framework that models Wyckoff symmetry templates and complete crystal structures within a single generative sequence. Specifically, CrystalAR reformulates continuous coordinate generation as a symmetry-conditioned hierarchy of discrete spatial localization decisions, autoregressively refining the positions of all symmetry-inequivalent sites across resolution levels while jointly modeling their spatial configuration within each level. This discrete hierarchical formulation further enables constraint-aware search over both crystallographic templates and geometric realizations. As a result, CrystalAR retains strong symmetry-template generation capability while achieving competitive de novo generation performance and template-free crystal structure prediction (CSP) accuracy. These results suggest that symmetry-template generation can be retained alongside broadly competitive de novo generation performance and competitive CSP without reliance on symmetry templates retrieved from prior data, providing a promising alternative paradigm for symmetry-preserving crystal generation.
items.tz: CrystalAR：面向对称晶体生成的自回归建模
items.az: 深度生成建模在晶体生成方面取得了显著进展。鉴于晶体结构中固有的丰富对称性，近期工作试图将空间群对称性显式地纳入生成模型，从而更有效地探索新型对称模板。然而，引入对称模板会增加原子种类与晶体学位点之间化学计量关系的组合复杂度，同时在灵活探索离散晶体学模板与将这些模板忠实地实现为连续三维结构之间产生了根本性张力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 CrystalAR，一个统一的自回归框架，在单一生成序列中对 Wyckoff 对称模板和完整晶体结构进行建模。具体而言，CrystalAR 将连续坐标生成重新表述为对称性条件下的离散空间定位决策层级，自回归地跨分辨率层级细化所有对称不等价位点的位置，同时在每个层级内联合建模其空间构型。这种离散层级化表述进一步支持了对晶体学模板和几何实现的约束感知搜索。因此，CrystalAR 在保持强大的对称模板生成能力的同时，实现了具有竞争力的从头生成性能和无模板晶体结构预测（CSP）精度。这些结果表明，对称模板生成可以与广泛具有竞争力的从头生成性能和具有竞争力的 CSP 精度并存，且无需依赖从先前数据中检索的对称模板，为保持对称性的晶体生成提供了一种有前景的替代范式。
items.rv: CrystalAR 将 Wyckoff 对称模板与完整晶体结构统一于单一自回归序列，把连续坐标生成重构为对称性条件下的离散空间定位决策层级，实现约束感知的模板与几何联合搜索。属生成模型在晶体结构预测中的应用，与「生成模型」关系最近，与「有机分子晶体」关系较弱，主要面向无机晶体。

items.t: Slipping into Solvates: Structure-Surface-Solvent Interplay in the Mechanochemical Solvate Formation of Ivacaftor
items.a: Solvate formation in molecular crystals remains difficult to predict, particularly under non-equilibrium conditions, where the initial solid state, mechanically generated surfaces, anisotropic surface chemistry, and solvent properties collectively influence solid-solvent interactions. While mechanochemical processing is widely used to access new solid forms, the structural features that control solvent incorporation during mechanical activation are not yet well understood. In this work, we investigate mechanochemically induced solvate formation in ivacaftor as a model molecular crystal, focusing on the effects of solvent nature, liquid-additive volume, milling duration, and starting solid form. Form C transformed selectively to a solvate, in MeOH, THF, and DMSO, whereas the amorphous material exhibited broader solvate-forming behavior, including hydrate and non-polar solvate formation. The observed transformations could not be explained by solvent class or apparent dissolution capacity alone, demonstrating the importance of the starting solid state and specific host-solvent interactions. Crystal structure and surface analyses of form C identified the (200) plane as a plausible mechanically responsive plane whose alternative termination exposes polar groups involved in the resulting solvate structures. Overall, the results support a model in which mechanochemical solvate formation is governed by the interplay among the initial solid state, mechanically generated surfaces, and specific solid-solvent interactions.
items.tz: 滑入溶剂化物：Ivacaftor 机械化学溶剂化物形成中结构-表面-溶剂的相互作用
items.az: 分子晶体中溶剂化物的形成仍然难以预测，特别是在非平衡条件下，初始固相状态、机械生成的表面、各向异性表面化学和溶剂性质共同影响固-溶剂相互作用。虽然机械化学加工被广泛用于获取新的固相形态，但在机械活化过程中控制溶剂纳入的结构特征尚未得到充分理解。在本工作中，我们以 ivacaftor 作为模型分子晶体，研究机械化学诱导的溶剂化物形成，重点关注溶剂性质、液体添加剂体积、研磨时间和起始固相形态的影响。C 型选择性地转化为溶剂化物，在 MeOH、THF 和 DMSO 中均如此，而无定形材料则表现出更广泛的溶剂化物形成行为，包括水合物和非极性溶剂化物的形成。观察到的转化不能仅用溶剂类别或表观溶解能力来解释，这表明起始固相状态和特定的主-溶剂相互作用的重要性。对 C 型的晶体结构和表面分析确定了 (200) 面作为一个可能的机械响应面，其替代终止面暴露出参与所形成溶剂化物结构的极性基团。总体而言，结果支持这样一个模型：机械化学溶剂化物形成受初始固相状态、机械生成的表面和特定固-溶剂相互作用之间相互作用的支配。
items.rv: 以 ivacaftor 为模型分子晶体，通过机械化学研磨探究溶剂化物形成机制，发现 C 型晶体 (200) 面在机械活化后暴露极性基团，是溶剂纳入的关键结构特征。工作聚焦有机分子晶体的固相转化与表面化学，与「有机分子晶体」直接相关，与生成模型、视觉生成及数学基本无关。

items.t: Symmetry-Based Parameter Efficient Low-Rank Fine-Tuning for High-Throughput Calculation of Lattice Thermal Conductivity
items.a: Accurate and efficient prediction of lattice thermal conductivity (LTC) is essential for developing materials for thermoelectric, microelectronic, and photovoltaic applications. Here, we present a methodology for high-throughput calculation of LTC across large datasets of compounds sharing a common crystal symmetry. Our approach combines fine-tuning of the MatterSim 1M universal machine-learned interatomic potential with LTC calculations based on the solution of the Boltzmann transport equation. We introduce a symmetry-based few-shot fine-tuning strategy (SBFS-FT) based on low-rank adaptation. In this approach, MatterSim 1M is fine-tuned on a small, carefully selected set of compounds that share a common crystal symmetry. The resulting potential is then applicable for accurate LTC calculations for compounds with this crystal symmetry, even if they were not included in the fine-tuning set. We tested our methodology on datasets of half-Heusler compounds (space group 216), materials with space group 225, and spinels (space group 227). We demonstrated that LTC calculations with MatterSim 1M fine-tuned using SBFS-FT exhibited a mean absolute relative difference from the reference results (obtained using moment tensor potentials and polyMLPs) 2-3 times smaller than that achieved with the non-fine-tuned MatterSim 1M potential. Moreover, the accuracy of LTC calculations with MatterSim 1M after SBFS-FT was comparable to that achieved using the MatterSim 1M potentials individually fine-tuned for each compound. Importantly, SBFS-FT enabled generation of the potential suitable for accurate LTC calculations across large compound datasets substantially faster than fine-tuning of MatterSim 1M for each compound individually, reducing the computational time by approximately a factor of 5-7 for a dataset of 100 compounds.
items.tz: 基于对称性的参数高效低秩微调用于晶格热导率高通量计算
items.az: 准确且高效地预测晶格热导率（LTC）对于开发热电、微电子和光伏应用材料至关重要。在此，我们提出了一种方法，用于对共享共同晶体对称性的大规模化合物数据集进行晶格热导率的高通量计算。我们的方法将 MatterSim 1M 通用机器学习原子间势的微调与基于玻尔兹曼输运方程求解的晶格热导率计算相结合。我们提出了一种基于低秩适配的对称性少样本微调策略（SBFS-FT）。在该方法中，MatterSim 1M 在一组经过精心挑选的、共享共同晶体对称性的少量化合物上进行微调。所得到的势函数可应用于具有该晶体对称性的化合物的精确晶格热导率计算，即使这些化合物未包含在微调集中。我们在半赫斯勒化合物（空间群 216）、空间群 225 的材料以及尖晶石（空间群 227）的数据集上测试了该方法。我们证明，使用 SBFS-FT 微调后的 MatterSim 1M 进行晶格热导率计算，其相对于参考结果（使用矩张量势和 polyMLP 获得）的平均绝对相对偏差比未微调的 MatterSim 1M 势小 2 至 3 倍。此外，SBFS-FT 微调后 MatterSim 1M 的晶格热导率计算精度与对每个化合物单独微调 MatterSim 1M 势所达到的精度相当。重要的是，与对每个化合物单独微调 MatterSim 1M 相比，SBFS-FT 能够显著更快地生成适用于大规模化合物数据集精确晶格热导率计算的势函数，对于 100 个化合物的数据集，计算时间减少了约 5 至 7 倍。
items.rv: SBFS-FT 基于对称性对 MatterSim 1M 原子间势做低秩适配少样本微调，用共享对称性的少量化合物微调通用势，实现晶格热导率高通量计算，精度接近逐化合物微调，计算时间减少约 5 至 7 倍。属材料计算与机器学习势领域，与「有机分子晶体/生成模型/视觉生成」关系弱，最接近「相关数学」中低秩适配，核心为凝聚态热输运。

items.t: Unconstrained learning of equivariant atomistic properties
items.a: Machine-learned interatomic potentials based on graph neural networks (GNNs) have made first-principles accuracy routine for the potential energy surface (PES). Their backbones, often O(3)-equivariant by design, are increasingly used to learn other atomistic properties. Many of these are of high angular order or pseudotensorial character, defined per atom, or expanded on large atom-centered basis sets. Such targets strain equivariant GNNs, whose tensor products grow steeply in cost with angular order and can fail to represent the target if truncated, forcing difficult trade-offs between hyperparameters. Unconstrained models like the Point-Edge Transformer (PET) instead replace explicit O(3) algebra with edge-to-edge attention and learn equivariance from data, so that the same backbone can in principle learn any equivariant property. We demonstrate how to use PET to learn molecular dipoles and polarizabilities, NMR chemical shielding tensors, and auxiliary-basis expansions of the electron density. Increasing the backbone size systematically improves both accuracy and equivariance error, and targeted architectural and training choices reduce the symmetry breaking further. PET matches or improves on the released reference models at lower inference cost and, compared with equivariant models, a smaller memory footprint. The predictions give accurate IR and Raman spectra and isotropic shieldings; the predicted densities accelerate self-consistent field calculations and give one-shot ground-state properties, and pretrained density models transfer to higher levels of theory by fine-tuning on little data. The impact of approximate equivariance is small for most observables, further validating this approach to train fast, accurate, and useful surrogate models for properties beyond the PES.
items.tz: 无约束学习等变原子性质
items.az: 基于图神经网络（GNN）的机器学习原子间势已使势能面（PES）达到第一性原理精度成为常规操作。其骨干网络通常在设计上具有O(3)等变性，正被越来越多地用于学习其他原子性质。其中许多性质具有高角阶或伪张量特征，按原子定义，或在大型原子中心基组上展开。这类目标对等变GNN构成压力，因为其张量积的计算成本随角阶急剧增长，且截断后可能无法表示目标，迫使在超参数之间做出艰难的权衡。以Point-Edge Transformer（PET）为代表的无约束模型则用边到边注意力替代显式O(3)代数，从数据中学习等变性，使得同一骨干网络原则上可以学习任何等变性质。我们展示了如何用PET学习分子偶极矩和极化率、NMR化学屏蔽张量以及电子密度的辅助基展开。增大骨干网络规模可系统性地同时提升精度和降低等变误差，针对性的架构与训练选择可进一步减少对称性破缺。PET在更低的推理成本下匹配或超越了已发布的参考模型，且与等变模型相比内存占用更小。预测结果可给出精确的红外和拉曼光谱及各向同性屏蔽值；预测密度可加速自洽场计算并一次性给出基态性质，预训练密度模型通过少量数据微调即可迁移到更高理论水平。近似等变对大多数可观测量的影响很小，进一步验证了该方法在训练快速、精确且实用的PES以外性质代理模型方面的有效性。
items.rv: 本文以Point-Edge Transformer（PET）替代显式O(3)等变代数，用边到边注意力从数据学习等变性，预测分子偶极矩、极化率、NMR屏蔽张量及电子密度展开。推理成本与内存占用低于等变模型，预测密度可加速自洽场计算。与「相关数学」中群表示、等变张量积有交叉，主体属计算化学分子性质代理模型，与有机分子晶体、生成模型、视觉生成关系较弱。

items.t: Mechanistic Insights of Jahn–Teller Effect Suppression in High-Entropy Prussian Blue Analogue Cathodes
items.a: The Jahn–Teller (J-T) effect, as discovered by Hermann Jahn and Edward Teller in 1937, often causes lattice distortion and structural instability in Mn-based battery materials. Recent studies suggest that high-entropy design may help suppress J-T distortion, yet the underlying mechanism remains largely elusive due to their compositional complexity and structural disorder. Herein, using a Mn-based Prussian blue analogue as a case study, we employed a machine learning interatomic potential combined with synchrotron extended X-ray absorption fine structure spectroscopy (EXAFS) to elucidate the fundamental mechanism of the J-T suppression in high-entropy materials. Unexpectedly, EXAFS spectra reveal the absence of the typical J-T Mn–N bond-length splitting in our high-entropy Prussian blue analogue sample, but instead a broader Mn–N bond-length distribution. Machine learning-assisted calculations demonstrate the [MnN6] octahedra exhibit randomly oriented distortions along x-, y-, and z-axes in high-entropy lattices, resulting in the local distortion averaging out at the macroscopic scale. Further analysis of the local Mn coordination environment reveals that the high-entropy configuration enhances d-electron delocalization and reduces the energy splitting between Mn dx2–y2 and dz2 orbitals. This allows two structurally and electronically distinct distortion modes to coexist within the lattice, which disrupts long-range cooperative J-T order. Strikingly, the ultralong cycling stability of high-entropy K0.46[Mn0.21Co0.19Ni0.21Cu0.20Zn0.19][Fe(CN)6]0.98·1.69H2O is experimentally demonstrated, achieving 91.0% capacity retention over 50,000 cycles for aqueous ammonium-ion storage, which surpasses all of the Mn-based rechargeable batteries to date. Our study uncovers the microscopic mechanism of J-T suppression in high-entropy materials and provides an effective strategy for designing durable high-entropy battery electrodes.
items.v: Journal of the American Chemical Society
items.tz: 高熵普鲁士蓝类似物正极中Jahn–Teller效应抑制的机理研究
items.az: Jahn–Teller（J-T）效应由Hermann Jahn和Edward Teller于1937年发现，常在锰基电池材料中引起晶格畸变和结构不稳定性。近期研究表明高熵设计可能有助于抑制J-T畸变，但由于其成分复杂性和结构无序性，其内在机理在很大程度上仍不清楚。本文以锰基普鲁士蓝类似物为案例，采用机器学习原子间势结合同步辐射扩展X射线吸收精细结构光谱（EXAFS），阐明了高熵材料中J-T抑制的基本机理。出乎意料的是，EXAFS光谱显示我们的高熵普鲁士蓝类似物样品中不存在典型的J-T Mn–N键长分裂，而是呈现出更宽的Mn–N键长分布。机器学习辅助计算表明，[MnN6]八面体在高熵晶格中沿x、y、z轴呈现随机取向的畸变，导致局部畸变在宏观尺度上相互抵消。对Mn局部配位环境的进一步分析揭示，高熵构型增强了d电子离域化，并减小了Mn dx2–y2和dz2轨道之间的能量分裂。这使得两种在结构和电子上截然不同的畸变模式能够在晶格中共存，从而破坏了长程协同J-T有序。引人注目的是，高熵K0.46[Mn0.21Co0.19Ni0.21Cu0.20Zn0.19][Fe(CN)6]0.98·1.69H2O的超长循环稳定性得到了实验验证，在水性铵离子存储中实现了50,000次循环后91.0%的容量保持率，超越了迄今为止所有锰基可充电电池。本研究揭示了高熵材料中J-T抑制的微观机理，并为设计耐用的高熵电池电极提供了有效策略。
items.rv: 本文以锰基高熵普鲁士蓝类似物为对象，结合机器学习原子间势与同步辐射EXAFS光谱，揭示Jahn–Teller效应在高熵晶格中被抑制的微观机理：局部八面体畸变随机取向、d电子离域增强、长程协同有序被破坏。属无机电池材料研究，与「有机分子晶体/生成模型/视觉生成/相关数学」四类均关系较弱。

items.t: Atomic-scale mechanisms of SiO2 plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition revealed by molecular dynamics with a machine-learning interatomic potential
items.tz: 基于机器学习原子间势的分子动力学揭示SiO2等离子体增强化学气相沉积的原子尺度机制
items.rv: 本文以SiO2等离子体增强化学气相沉积（PECVD）为对象，采用机器学习原子间势（ML-IAP）驱动的分子动力学模拟，揭示沉积过程的原子尺度机制。研究属于计算材料科学与表面物理范畴，与「有机分子晶体」「生成模型」「视觉生成」「相关数学」均无直接关联，关系较弱。

items.t: Combining Simulations and Spectroscopy to Design Protective Coatings on Sulfide Solid Electrolytes
items.a: Sulfide solid electrolytes are attractive for all-solid-state batteries because of their high Li-ion conductivity and favorable processability, but their practical use is limited by electrochemical instability and moisture-induced degradation. Molecular surface coatings offer a scalable strategy to improve humidity tolerance and interfacial stability, yet there is limited understanding of the molecular-level factors governing surface interactions. By combining large-scale atomistic simulations enabled by a machine-learning potential with targeted experiments, we present a comprehensive framework for designing molecular coatings on Li$_6$PS$_5$Cl (LPSCl). Using a PET-MAD interatomic potential fine-tuned on an r$^2$SCAN reference dataset covering LPSCl surfaces, molecular adsorbates, and their interactions, we model surface adsorption of carboxylic (CA), sulfonic (SA), and phosphonic (PA) acids with alkyl chains of varying lengths and the interaction of these coated surfaces with water at finite temperature. The simulations show that lithiated head groups generally exhibit more favorable adsorption energies. Impedance spectroscopy shows that the lithiated coatings maintain 40--55\% of the initial ionic conductivity after powder processing. While adsorption strength is largely controlled by head-group chemistry and lithiation state, coating morphology depends primarily on alkyl-chain length and surface coverage. In particular, long-chain lithiated carboxylates form dense, brush-like hydrophobic layers that reduce water access to reactive Li surface sites, with protection setting in at a coating thickness of approximately 0.8 nm. Consistent with these predictions, longer carboxylate chains suppress H$_2$S evolution more effectively. Because thicker coatings also hinder Li-ion transport, intermediate chain lengths offer the best balance between moisture protection and ionic conductivity.
items.tz: 结合模拟与光谱设计硫化物固体电解质保护涂层
items.az: 硫化物固体电解质因其高锂离子电导率和良好的可加工性而在全固态电池中颇具吸引力，但其实际应用受到电化学不稳定性和水分诱导降解的限制。分子表面涂层为提高耐湿性和界面稳定性提供了一种可扩展的策略，但对控制表面相互作用的分子层面因素的理解仍然有限。通过将机器学习势函数驱动的大规模原子模拟与针对性实验相结合，我们提出了一个在 Li$_6$PS$_5$Cl（LPSCl）上设计分子涂层的综合框架。利用在覆盖 LPSCl 表面、分子吸附质及其相互作用的 r$^2$SCAN 参考数据集上微调的 PET-MAD 原子间势函数，我们模拟了具有不同长度烷基链的羧酸（CA）、磺酸（SA）和膦酸（PA）的表面吸附，以及这些涂层表面在有限温度下与水的相互作用。模拟表明，锂化头基通常表现出更有利的吸附能。阻抗谱显示，锂化涂层在粉末加工后保持了初始离子电导率的 40–55%。虽然吸附强度主要受头基化学和锂化状态控制，但涂层形貌主要取决于烷基链长度和表面覆盖率。特别是，长链锂化羧酸盐形成致密的刷状疏水层，减少了水对活性锂表面位点的接触，保护效应在涂层厚度约为 0.8 nm 时开始显现。与这些预测一致，更长的羧酸盐链能更有效地抑制 H$_2$S 的释放。由于较厚的涂层也会阻碍锂离子传输，中等链长在耐湿保护和离子电导率之间提供了最佳平衡。
items.rv: 用机器学习势（PET-MAD）驱动的大规模原子模拟结合阻抗谱实验，研究硫化物固体电解质 LPSCl 表面分子涂层的设计。对象是有机小分子（羧酸、磺酸、膦酸）在无机晶体表面的吸附与成膜，与「有机分子晶体」有弱关联（涉及有机分子在晶体表面吸附），但核心是电池界面工程，与生成模型、视觉生成、相关数学关系较弱。

items.t: Mechanical versus thermal amorphization of ZIF-4: from local rearrangements to network disorder
items.a: There is mounting evidence that different amorphization routes can produce metalorganic framework (MOF) glasses with distinct structures and properties, yet the microscopic origins of these differences remain difficult to establish experimentally. Focusing on the two main synthesis methods, which are melt-quenching and ball-milling, we use molecular dynamics simulations with a machine-learning interatomic potential to compare different glasses obtained from ZIF-4. While both routes largely preserve tetrahedral zinc coordination, mechanical deformation generally produces more distorted local environments, showing that average coordination numbers alone do not capture the structural differences between these glasses. At smaller applied strain, mechanical glasses retain substantial memory of the crystalline network topology, despite pronounced changes in ring geometry. Larger strains erase this topological memory, yielding ring-size distributions similar to those of melt-quenched glasses, while differences in local geometry and porosity persist. Simulations of larger systems reveal a heterogeneous amorphization mechanism, involving the formation and growth of disordered domains. These findings from in silico amorphization support process-dependent polyamorphism in ZIF glasses and identify local geometry, topological memory, and spatial heterogeneity as complementary features needed to characterize their structure and understand the influence of mechanical processing.
items.tz: ZIF-4 的机械非晶化与热非晶化：从局部重排到网络无序
items.az: 越来越多的证据表明，不同的非晶化途径可以产生具有不同结构和性质的金属有机框架（MOF）玻璃，但这些差异的微观起源在实验上仍难以确定。聚焦于两种主要合成方法——熔体急冷和球磨，我们使用基于机器学习原子间势的分子动力学模拟来比较从 ZIF-4 获得的不同玻璃。虽然两种途径在很大程度上都保留了四面体锌配位，但机械变形通常产生更扭曲的局部环境，表明仅凭平均配位数无法捕捉这些玻璃之间的结构差异。在较小的施加应变下，机械玻璃尽管环几何发生了显著变化，但仍保留了对晶体网络拓扑的大量记忆。较大的应变会抹去这种拓扑记忆，产生与熔体急冷玻璃相似的环尺寸分布，而局部几何和孔隙率的差异仍然存在。更大体系的模拟揭示了一种非均匀的非晶化机制，涉及无序畴的形成和生长。这些来自计算机模拟非晶化的发现支持了 ZIF 玻璃中依赖于工艺的多非晶态现象，并指出局部几何、拓扑记忆和空间异质性是表征其结构和理解机械加工影响所需的互补特征。
items.rv: 对象为 ZIF-4 金属有机框架玻璃，采用机器学习原子间势驱动分子动力学模拟，对比熔体急冷与球磨两条非晶化路径下局部配位、环拓扑与孔隙率的差异。与「有机分子晶体」有一定关联（涉及晶态到非晶态转变），但核心是 MOF 玻璃结构表征，与生成模型、视觉生成及相关数学关系较弱。

items.t: Microscopic origin of polytype-dependent melting in SiC revealed by machine-learning molecular dynamics
items.a: Predicting how crystal structure influences high-temperature stability remains a key challenge in materials modeling and design. Silicon carbide (SiC), one of the most thermally and chemically stable materials known, provides an ideal system for studying this problem because its many polytypes preserve similar local tetrahedral bonding while differing in long-range stacking geometry. To determine the impact of polytype structure on the high-temperature stability of SiC, we combine phase-coexistence machine-learning molecular dynamics with finite-temperature phonon analysis, enabled by a fine-tuned MACE interatomic potential that accurately describes crystalline, high-temperature, and disordered configurations across multiple SiC polytypes. We identify a clear stability ordering, 3C > 2H > 9R, reflected consistently in structural disordering, interlayer sliding, and finite-temperature phonon spectra. Across all polytypes, melting initiates through the formation of short C-C contacts and carbon-rich local regions, followed by a progressive loss of tetrahedral Si-C connectivity. The reduced stability of the long-period 9R polytype is associated with a denser manifold of low-frequency transverse-acoustic modes arising from its stacking periodicity and associated zone folding, which broaden and soften further at high temperature. These modes can provide additional low-energy channels for thermally activated lateral bilayer motion, consistent with the larger sliding amplitudes observed in 9R and their positive correlation with local structural disorder.
items.tz: 机器学习分子动力学揭示碳化硅多型依赖熔化的微观起源
items.az: 预测晶体结构如何影响高温稳定性仍然是材料建模与设计中的关键挑战。碳化硅（SiC）是已知热稳定性和化学稳定性最高的材料之一，为研究这一问题提供了理想体系，因为其众多多型体保持了相似的局部四面体键合，但在长程堆垛几何上存在差异。为确定多型结构对碳化硅高温稳定性的影响，我们将相共存机器学习分子动力学与有限温度声子分析相结合，借助一个经过微调的 MACE 原子间势，该势能够准确描述多种碳化硅多型体中晶态、高温及无序构型。我们识别出明确的稳定性排序 3C > 2H > 9R，该排序在结构无序化、层间滑移和有限温度声子谱中均得到一致反映。在所有多型体中，熔化均始于短 C-C 接触和富碳局部区域的形成，随后是四面体 Si-C 连接性的逐步丧失。长周期 9R 多型体稳定性的降低与其堆垛周期性及相关布里渊区折叠所产生的一组更密集的低温横声学模有关，这些模在高温下进一步展宽和软化。这些模可以为热激活的横向双层运动提供额外的低能通道，这与在 9R 中观察到的更大滑移幅度及其与局部结构无序的正相关性一致。
items.rv: 采用微调 MACE 势的相共存机器学习分子动力学，结合有限温度声子分析，揭示碳化硅 3C、2H、9R 多型体的高温熔化微观机制与稳定性排序。对象为无机半导体晶体，方法属机器学习力场原子模拟，与「有机分子晶体」在晶体多型与熔化行为上有一定关联，但与「生成模型」「视觉生成」「相关数学」关系较弱。
items.tw: 期刊在关注名单；正式发表

items.t: Spontaneous defect formation as the origin of superionic transitions in antifluorite-type structures
items.a: Solid-state electrolytes offer the possibility of safer and higher energy density batteries, yet only a limited number of materials achieve ionic conductivities suitable for practical applications. Type-II superionic conductors, which undergo continuous temperature-driven transitions between low and high ionic conductivity regimes are strong candidates for high-performance solid state electrolytes, but the transition mechanism is not sufficiently understood. In this study, we investigate the archetypical superionic conductors Li2O and Li2S with the antifluorite structure using long-time-scale molecular dynamics simulations with an Allegro machine-learning force field (MLFF) trained on density functional theory data selected using an on-the-fly active learning procedure. To this end, superionic transitions are identified around 1450 K for Li2O and around 1100 K for Li2S through continuous peaks in the heat capacity. Diffusion coefficients and concentration of Frenkel defects are found to exhibit strong non-Arrhenius behavior coinciding with the superionic transition where both diffusion activation energy and defect formation energy decrease significantly across the transition. This suggests a self-enhanced spontaneous defect formation mechanism, which drives the superionic transition and promotes increased ionic diffusion. These results identifies the microscopic origin of type-II superionic behavior as a result of correlated defect formation and support the design of improved solid-state electrolytes.
items.tz: 反萤石型结构中自发缺陷形成作为超离子转变的起源
items.az: 固态电解质为更安全、更高能量密度的电池提供了可能，但只有少数材料能达到适用于实际应用的离子电导率。II型超离子导体在低离子电导率区和高离子电导率区之间经历连续的、由温度驱动的相变，是高性能固态电解质的有力候选材料，但其转变机制尚未得到充分理解。在本研究中，我们使用基于密度泛函理论数据训练的Allegro机器学习力场（MLFF）进行长时间尺度分子动力学模拟，该数据通过在线主动学习程序选取，研究了具有反萤石结构的典型超离子导体Li2O和Li2S。为此，通过热容中的连续峰，确定了Li2O在约1450 K、Li2S在约1100 K附近的超离子转变。发现扩散系数和Frenkel缺陷浓度表现出强烈的非Arrhenius行为，与超离子转变相吻合，在转变过程中扩散激活能和缺陷形成能均显著降低。这表明存在一种自增强的自发缺陷形成机制，该机制驱动超离子转变并促进离子扩散的增加。这些结果将II型超离子行为的微观起源确定为关联缺陷形成的结果，并支持改进型固态电解质的设计。
items.rv: 用Allegro机器学习力场做长时间尺度分子动力学模拟，研究反萤石结构Li2O和Li2S的超离子转变。核心发现是自发Frenkel缺陷形成具有自增强效应，驱动超离子相变。与有机分子晶体关系较弱，与生成模型、视觉生成无直接关联，属于固态离子导体与缺陷物理范畴，数学上涉及非Arrhenius扩散和热容分析。

items.t: Factorised Cartesian Atomic Cluster Expansion for Low-Cost Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
items.a: Machine-learning interatomic potentials can reach the accuracy of density functional theory at a fraction of its cost, but the most accurate equivariant models remain expensive, mainly because of the tensor operations they perform for every pair of neighbouring atoms. We present FACE, a factorised Cartesian atomic cluster expansion that removes this bottleneck. Each neighbour contributes only a small set of radial functions and messages, and all mixing of feature channels is done once per atom, so the cost per neighbour no longer grows with the size of the model. Custom GPU kernels evaluate the remaining steps, and long-range electrostatics, dispersion and short-range repulsion attach through a single interface. We show that the training divergences we encountered originate in how the network weights are scaled, and we introduce a distillation scheme in which an ensemble generates additional, uncertainty-checked training data. On five rMD17 molecules, with identical training budgets and hardware, FACE is about as accurate as a 64-channel MACE model (over three seeds: better on one molecule, within the seed spread on two, 7–14% higher force errors on two), while it is 5.7 times faster at inference (4.9 times at the same cutoff) and needs 3.5–3.9 times less GPU memory. Training costs about the same per step. Distillation lowers the energy and force errors of a single aspirin model by 20% at fixed width, to 2.26 meV and 6.74 meV/Å, close to the published MACE values (2.2 and 6.6), and the distilled model runs stably in molecular dynamics.
items.tz: 分解笛卡尔原子簇展开用于低成本机器学习原子间势能
items.az: 机器学习原子间势能以密度泛函理论一小部分的成本达到其精度，但最精确的等变模型仍然昂贵，主要因为它们对每一对邻近原子都执行张量运算。我们提出 FACE，一种分解的笛卡尔原子簇展开，消除了这一瓶颈。每个邻居仅贡献一小组径向函数和消息，所有特征通道的混合每原子仅执行一次，因此每个邻居的成本不再随模型规模增长。自定义 GPU 内核评估剩余步骤，长程静电、色散和短程排斥通过单一接口接入。我们表明所遇到的训练发散源于网络权重的缩放方式，并引入一种蒸馏方案，其中集成模型生成额外的、经不确定性检验的训练数据。在五个 rMD17 分子上，在相同的训练预算和硬件条件下，FACE 的精度与 64 通道 MACE 模型相当（三个随机种子：一个分子上更优，两个分子上在种子波动范围内，两个分子上力误差高 7–14%），同时推理速度快 5.7 倍（相同截断距离下为 4.9 倍），GPU 内存需求减少 3.5–3.9 倍。每步训练成本大致相同。蒸馏在固定宽度下将单个阿司匹林模型的能量和力误差降低 20%，分别降至 2.26 meV 和 6.74 meV/Å，接近已发表的 MACE 数值（2.2 和 6.6），且蒸馏后的模型在分子动力学中运行稳定。
items.rv: FACE 是分解的笛卡尔原子簇展开，用于低成本机器学习原子间势能。核心将特征通道混合从每对邻居降为每原子一次，使单邻居成本不再随模型规模增长，并引入集成蒸馏改善训练稳定性。rMD17 分子上精度接近 MACE，推理快约 5.7 倍。与「有机分子晶体」有弱关联（涉及小分子势能），核心属等变原子簇展开的效率优化，与生成模型、视觉生成关系弱。

items.t: Can DFT-Trained Neural Network Potentials Reproduce Structure, Solvation, and Water-Exchange Properties in Aqueous Magnesium Solutions?
items.a: Magnesium ions play an essential role in many biological processes but remain challenging to model in biomolecular simulations. Despite considerable scientific effort, classical force fields fail to simultaneously reproduce key structural, thermodynamic, and kinetic solution properties, likely due to their inability to explicitly account for quantum many-body effects. Here, we develop and systematically benchmark MACE neural network potentials (NNPs) for aqueous MgCl2 solutions, trained on revPBE-D3/zd and revPBE0-D3/zd density functional theory reference data, and assess their ability to reproduce a broad range of experimental solution properties including the structure of the first hydration shell, diffusion coefficient, activity derivative, water-exchange rate, and mechanism as well as solvation free energy. Both NNPs accurately reproduce the octahedral structure of the first hydration shell, ion-pairing properties, and diffusion coefficients. Combining the NNPs with transition path sampling and other enhanced sampling techniques allows us to capture the rare event of water exchange in the first hydration shell of Mg2+, revealing a dissociative exchange mechanism. Transition interface sampling yields exchange rates within 1 order of magnitude of experiment, representing a substantial improvement over classical dissociative force fields. In contrast, the NNP-derived solvation free energy significantly underestimates the experimental value, revealing a limitation of the present local NNP architecture for describing ion solvation thermodynamics.
items.v: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
items.tz: 基于DFT训练的神经网络势函数能否再现水溶液中镁离子的结构、溶剂化和水交换性质？
items.az: 镁离子在许多生物过程中发挥关键作用，但在生物分子模拟中仍难以建模。尽管已有大量科学研究，经典力场仍无法同时再现关键的溶液结构、热力学和动力学性质，这很可能是由于其无法显式考虑量子多体效应。本文开发并系统基准测试了用于水溶液MgCl2的MACE神经网络势函数（NNP），其训练数据来自revPBE-D3/zd和revPBE0-D3/zd密度泛函理论参考数据，并评估了它们再现广泛实验溶液性质的能力，包括第一水合壳层结构、扩散系数、活度导数、水交换速率及机制以及溶剂化自由能。两种NNP均能准确再现第一水合壳层的八面体结构、离子对性质和扩散系数。将NNP与过渡路径采样及其他增强采样技术相结合，使我们能够捕捉Mg2+第一水合壳层中水交换这一稀有事件，揭示了解离型交换机制。过渡界面采样得到的交换速率与实验值相差在1个数量级以内，相较于经典解离型力场是实质性改进。相比之下，NNP推导的溶剂化自由能显著低估了实验值，揭示了当前局部NNP架构在描述离子溶剂化热力学方面的局限性。
items.rv: 本文用MACE神经网络势函数（基于DFT数据训练）模拟水溶液中Mg2+的结构、扩散和水交换动力学，结合过渡路径采样捕捉稀有交换事件。属于计算化学与分子模拟方向，与「有机分子晶体/生成模型/视觉生成/相关数学」四类均关系较弱，最接近「相关数学」中的统计力学与增强采样方法，但本质是离子溶液模拟。

items.t: SU(2)-Equivariant Spinor Message Passing for Molecular Magnetism
items.a: Predicting molecular magnetism often requires electronic-structure calculations with spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which are costly to repeat across many molecules. The underlying electronic states can transform as spinors, yet equivariant surrogates typically use only integer-rank features. Inspired by the spinor nature of these electronic states, we develop eSpinor, an SU(2)-equivariant graph neural network that propagates spinor features. We initialize spinor features from eigenvectors of an approximate SOC Hamiltonian and use gauge-covariant message passing with a gauge-invariant readout to make predictions independent of the arbitrary eigenbasis choice. On cobalt single-molecule magnet candidates, eSpinor improves zero-field-splitting predictions relative to NequIP, including for unseen ligands. For a dysprosium magnetic resonance imaging probe, eSpinor improves real electron-spin correlations over a Hamiltonian-informed baseline despite similar static crystal-field errors and fewer parameters, while accurately predicting low-field nuclear relaxation in water and after transfer to methanol without retraining. Overall, these results demonstrate that SU(2)-equivariant spinor message passing is a useful inductive bias for molecular magnetism. We also find that similar static tensor errors can yield different dynamical errors, motivating model selection based on accuracy for the intended physical observables.
items.tz: 用于分子磁性的 SU(2) 等变旋量消息传递
items.az: 预测分子磁性通常需要包含自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）的电子结构计算，而这些计算在大量分子上重复进行代价高昂。其底层电子态可以按旋量变换，然而等变代理模型通常仅使用整数阶特征。受这些电子态的旋量性质启发，我们开发了 eSpinor，一个传播旋量特征的 SU(2) 等变图神经网络。我们从近似 SOC 哈密顿量的特征向量初始化旋量特征，并使用规范协变消息传递配合规范不变读出，使预测不依赖于任意特征基的选择。在钴单分子磁体候选物上，eSpinor 相较于 NequIP 改进了零场分裂预测，包括对未见配体的预测。对于镝磁共振成像探针，eSpinor 在静态晶体场误差相近且参数更少的情况下，相较于哈密顿量引导的基线改进了真实电子自旋关联，同时准确预测了水中低场核弛豫以及迁移至甲醇后无需重新训练的核弛豫。总体而言，这些结果表明 SU(2) 等变旋量消息传递是分子磁性中一种有用的归纳偏置。我们还发现，相似的静态张量误差可能产生不同的动力学误差，这促使我们基于目标物理观测量上的精度来进行模型选择。
items.rv: eSpinor 是 SU(2) 等变图神经网络，以近似自旋-轨道耦合哈密顿量特征向量初始化旋量特征，通过规范协变消息传递与规范不变读出预测零场分裂及电子自旋关联。对象为钴单分子磁体与镝 MRI 探针，属分子磁性与电子结构计算范畴，与有机分子晶体、生成模型、视觉生成关系弱，与群表示论及规范理论有直接关联。
items.tw: 预印本或来源不明；作者不在关注名单

items.t: Δ-HGPR: A Hierarchical Gaussian Process Framework for Active-Learning Δ-Potentials
items.a: Δ-learning, which uses machine learning to represent only the difference between a high-accuracy reference and a lower-accuracy base calculator, is a promising route to high-fidelity molecular dynamics (MD) with limited training data, but it has lacked a unified protocol combining hierarchical descriptors with well-defined equilibrium sampling. We propose Δ-HGPR (hierarchical Gaussian process regression for Δ-learning), a framework for learning difference potentials, and its MD instantiation, Δ-HGPR-MD. The framework combines (i) a difference potential written as an additive radial (inverse-distance) term plus a many-body machine-learning correction, determined by a single regularized least-squares fit; (ii) the ensemble force standard deviation as an active-learning indicator with an automatically scaled threshold; and (iii) a difference potential held fixed within each round so that equilibrium NVT sampling is well-defined in both exploration and production. The many-body term of Δ-HGPR-MD uses smooth overlap of atomic positions (SOAP) descriptors with random Fourier features (Δ-HGPR-RFF). On a toy system whose difference potential contains a 1/r contribution beyond the cutoff of the local descriptor, the many-body term alone reproduces none of this force, however many features it is given, whereas the hierarchy recovers 99% of it, with a reach set by the cutoff of its radial term. In MD, the hierarchy reproduces about 80% of the shift of the ion-pair distribution toward the reference, while the many-body term alone leaves it where the base places it.
items.v: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
items.tz: Δ-HGPR：用于主动学习Δ势的层次化高斯过程框架
items.az: Δ-learning，即使用机器学习仅表示高精度参考计算与低精度基础计算器之间的差异，是有限训练数据下实现高保真分子动力学（MD）的一条有前途的路线，但它缺乏一个将层次化描述符与明确定义的平衡采样相结合的统一协议。我们提出了Δ-HGPR（用于Δ学习的层次化高斯过程回归），一个学习差异势的框架，以及其在MD中的实例化Δ-HGPR-MD。该框架结合了：（i）一个差异势，写为加性径向（逆距离）项加上多体机器学习修正，由单次正则化最小二乘拟合确定；（ii）系综力标准差作为主动学习指标，带有自动缩放的阈值；（iii）每轮中保持固定的差异势，使得在探索和生产中平衡NVT采样都是明确定义的。Δ-HGPR-MD的多体项使用平滑原子位置重叠（SOAP）描述符与随机傅里叶特征（Δ-HGPR-RFF）。在一个其差异势包含超出局部描述符截断范围的1/r贡献的玩具系统中，无论给予多少特征，仅多体项都无法再现这些力，而层次结构恢复了其中99%，其作用范围由其径向项的截断决定。在MD中，层次结构再现了离子对分布向参考方向偏移的约80%，而仅多体项则将其留在基础计算器放置的位置。
items.rv: Δ-HGPR用层次化高斯过程回归学习Δ-learning差异势，将势分解为径向逆距离项加多体ML修正，以系综力标准差做主动学习，每轮固定势保证NVT采样明确。属计算化学力场学习，与有机分子晶体有一定关联（涉及离子对分布），与生成模型、视觉生成关系弱，与高斯过程回归等数学工具有直接联系。

items.t: Microenvironmental pH-Modulated Vitamin B6 Ternary Eutectics for BCS Class IV Drug Delivery
items.a: The essence of developing multicomponent solid formulations for drugs with poor physicochemical and pharmacokinetic properties is rapidly evolving to cut short the consumption of resources and time. Quite a few commercially available binary drug formulations in the public domain serve as a prime illustration of the field’s success. However, the design and utilization of ternary or higher-order drug formulations can be more efficacious in terms of enhancing such properties of the drug as well as providing humidity resistance and controlling unexpected phase transitions during drug development. Low-soluble and low-permeable BCS IV class drugs continuously present a barrier by lowering their absorption in the body. Drugs mesalamine (MSA) and acetazolamide (ACZ) from the same BCS class were chosen to enhance properties by introducing the binary and ternary solid formulation approach. Soluble and acceptable co-partners, viz., vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride, PRDHCl) and p-Aminobenzoic acid (PABA), were carefully chosen. The grinding of MSA and ACZ with p-aminobenzoic acid (PABA) resulted in a physical mixture (MSA·PABA) and a cocrystal (ACZ·PABA), respectively, due to the mismatch of functional moieties and shape. Interestingly, the addition of PRDHCl to the two binary systems generated two ternary eutectic solids, viz., PRDHCl·MSA·PABA and PRDHCl·ACZ·PABA. The thermal and spectroscopic analyses suggested that PRDHCl·MSA·PABA is a mixture of PRDHCl, MSA and PABA. However, PRDHCl·ACZ·PABA exists as a combination of the cocrystal ACZ·PABA and PRDHCl.
items.tz: 微环境pH调控的维生素B6三元共晶用于BCS IV类药物递送
items.az: 开发多组分固体制剂以改善理化性质和药代动力学性质较差的药物的本质正在快速演变，以缩短资源和时间的消耗。公共领域中相当多的市售二元药物制剂是该领域成功的主要例证。然而，三元或更高阶药物制剂的设计和利用在增强药物性质、提供抗湿性以及控制药物开发过程中意外相变方面可能更为有效。低溶解度和低渗透性的BCS IV类药物通过降低其在体内的吸收而持续构成障碍。选择同一BCS类别的药物美沙拉秦（MSA）和乙酰唑胺（ACZ），通过引入二元和三元固体制剂方法来增强其性质。精心选择了可溶且可接受的共组分，即维生素B6（盐酸吡哆醇，PRDHCl）和对氨基苯甲酸（PABA）。由于官能团和形状的不匹配，MSA和ACZ分别与对氨基苯甲酸（PABA）研磨后，分别形成了物理混合物（MSA·PABA）和共晶（ACZ·PABA）。有趣的是，将PRDHCl添加到两个二元体系中，生成了两种三元共晶固体，即PRDHCl·MSA·PABA和PRDHCl·ACZ·PABA。热分析和光谱分析表明，PRDHCl·MSA·PABA是PRDHCl、MSA和PABA的混合物。然而，PRDHCl·ACZ·PABA以共晶ACZ·PABA和PRDHCl的组合形式存在。
items.rv: 本文针对BCS IV类药物美沙拉秦和乙酰唑胺，引入盐酸吡哆醇与对氨基苯甲酸，通过研磨法构建二元及三元共晶体系，并用热分析和光谱手段表征其组成。属于有机分子晶体与共晶药物递送方向，与生成模型、视觉生成及相关数学关系较弱。

items.t: A Calix[4]arene Supramolecular Gel for Pharmaceutical Crystal Growth Enabled by Anion-Induced Conformational Modulation
items.a: Two novel calix[4]arene derivatives (compounds 1 and 2), incorporating 1,2,3-triazole and d/l-phenylalanine moieties within the linker, have been prepared. Upon the addition of tetrabutylammonium dihydrogen phosphate (TBAHP) followed by sonication at 42−48 °C for 15 min, compound 1 formed a supramolecular gel in n-butanol, whereas 2 did not undergo gelation under identical conditions. Variable-temperature 1H NMR studies suggest that dihydrogen phosphate induces a conformational change in 1, consistent with modulation of the calix[4]arene framework, thereby exposing additional intermolecular interaction sites that promote supramolecular gel assembly. Rheological measurements demonstrated that both the mechanical stability and the storage modulus of the resulting gel increased with increasing concentrations of the Compound 1/TBAHP system in n-butanol. Although the gel exhibited thixotropic behavior, recovery of the gel structure following shear was relatively slow. Notably, a pharmaceutical salt cocrystal comprising furosemide and its tetrabutylammonium salt was successfully grown within the Compound 1/TBAHP/n-butanol supramolecular gel. Although the same salt cocrystal could also be obtained from a TBAHP/n-butanol solution, crystallization required a higher concentration of furosemide than in the gel system.
items.tz: 阴离子诱导构象调制赋能杯[4]芳烃超分子凝胶用于药物晶体生长
items.az: 制备了两种新型杯[4]芳烃衍生物（化合物1和2），其连接臂中引入了1,2,3-三唑和d/l-苯丙氨酸基团。在加入四丁基铵二氢磷酸盐（TBAHP）后于42−48 °C超声处理15分钟，化合物1在正丁醇中形成了超分子凝胶，而化合物2在相同条件下未发生凝胶化。变温1H NMR研究表明，二氢磷酸盐诱导化合物1发生构象变化，与杯[4]芳烃骨架的调制一致，从而暴露出额外的分子间相互作用位点，促进超分子凝胶的组装。流变学测量表明，所得凝胶的机械稳定性和储能模量均随正丁醇中化合物1/TBAHP体系浓度的增加而增大。尽管该凝胶表现出触变性，但剪切后凝胶结构的恢复相对较慢。值得注意的是，由呋塞米及其四丁基铵盐组成的药物盐共晶在化合物1/TBAHP/正丁醇超分子凝胶中成功生长。尽管相同的盐共晶也可从TBAHP/正丁醇溶液中获得，但结晶所需的呋塞米浓度高于凝胶体系。
items.rv: 本文利用阴离子诱导杯[4]芳烃构象变化构建超分子凝胶，并在其中生长呋塞米盐共晶，展示了凝胶作为晶体生长微环境的功能。方法核心是阴离子调控分子构象以暴露相互作用位点，属于超分子化学与晶体生长的交叉。与「有机分子晶体」关系较近，与「生成模型」「视觉生成」「相关数学」关系弱。

items.t: Improving the Temperature Stability of MgZrNb2O8 through the Synergistic Effect of Ta5 + Substitution and High-Entropy Strategy
items.a: High-entropy Mg(ZrHfTiSnGe)0.2(Nb1–xTax)2O8 (x = 0–1) microwave dielectric ceramics were successfully synthesized via a solid-state reaction method. The effects of Ta5+ substitution and high entropy on sintering behavior, crystal structure, and microwave dielectric properties were systematically investigated. XRD confirms that Hf4+, Ti4+, Sn4+, Ge4+, and Ta5+ successfully entered the crystal lattice, forming a single-phase solid solution with a wolframite structure (P2/c space group). SEM images show that grains grow well, the grain size is uniform, and there are few pores. HRTEM images show that the sample has both structural long-range order and local lattice distortion. The dielectric constant (εr) increases with Ta5+ substitution, which is primarily attributed to the higher ionic polarizability of Ta5+ and the cation “under-bonding” effect. The continuous decline in the quality factor (Q × f) value is closely related to the reductions in both relative density and lattice energy. This is further supported by the broadening of the Nb/Ta–O symmetric stretching vibration peak in Raman spectra, indicating enhanced phonon interactions. Most importantly, the temperature coefficient of resonant frequency (τf) improves to −10 ppm/°C, benefiting from the increase in bond energy and the weakening of [AO6] (A = Mg, Zr, Hf, Ti, Sn, and Ge) octahedral distortion.
items.v: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
items.tz: 通过Ta5+取代与高熵策略协同效应提升MgZrNb2O8的温度稳定性
items.az: 通过固相反应法成功合成了高熵Mg(ZrHfTiSnGe)0.2(Nb1–xTax)2O8（x = 0–1）微波介质陶瓷。系统研究了Ta5+取代和高熵策略对烧结行为、晶体结构及微波介质性能的影响。XRD证实Hf4+、Ti4+、Sn4+、Ge4+和Ta5+成功进入晶格，形成了具有钨锰矿结构（P2/c空间群）的单相固溶体。SEM图像显示晶粒生长良好，晶粒尺寸均匀，气孔较少。HRTEM图像显示样品同时具有结构长程有序性和局部晶格畸变。介电常数（εr）随Ta5+取代而增大，这主要归因于Ta5+较高的离子极化率和阳离子「欠键合」效应。品质因数（Q × f）值的持续下降与相对密度和晶格能量的降低密切相关。拉曼光谱中Nb/Ta–O对称伸缩振动峰的展宽进一步证实了这一点，表明声子相互作用增强。最重要的是，谐振频率温度系数（τf）改善至−10 ppm/°C，这得益于键能的增加以及[AO6]（A = Mg、Zr、Hf、Ti、Sn和Ge）八面体畸变的减弱。
items.rv: 本文研究高熵钨锰矿结构Mg(ZrHfTiSnGe)0.2(Nb1–xTax)2O8微波介质陶瓷，利用Ta5+取代与高熵策略协同提升谐振频率温度稳定性。属无机功能材料与固体化学领域，与「有机分子晶体 / 生成模型 / 视觉生成 / 相关数学」均无直接关联。
items.tw: 期刊在关注名单；正式发表

items.t: Multimodal Fusion-Based Prediction and Preparation of Cocrystal: A Case Study of Diosmetin
items.a: Cocrystals offer promising approaches for the targeted regulation of raw material properties. Nevertheless, the accurate screening of cocrystal co-formers remains a critical bottleneck in the rational preparation of cocrystals. To address this challenge, a cocrystal prediction model based on multimodal fusion was constructed by integrating molecular descriptors, fingerprints, SMILES strings and molecular graphs to screen potential co-formers. The model incorporates a dynamic attention fusion mechanism and a tailored data-balancing strategy to address unimodal limitations and class imbalance, thereby enhancing classification performance under the present evaluation framework. It demonstrated strong classification performance and outperformed the evaluated unimodal models. Diosmetin was selected as the model compound, and systematic virtual screening identified promising co-formers, leading to the successful synthesis of diosmetin-4,4′-bipyridine and diosmetin-isonicotinamide cocrystals. Structural characterization revealed a 2:1 supramolecular network of diosmetin-4,4′-bipyridine stabilized by O−H···N hydrogen bonds. The two cocrystals showed lower moisture uptake than diosmetin under the tested high-humidity conditions of 40 °C/75% RH and 40 °C/95% RH. This study presents a multimodal fusion strategy for cocrystal prediction and highlights its potential in the rational design of solid forms.
items.tz: 基于多模态融合的共晶体预测与制备：以柚皮素为例
items.az: 共晶体为靶向调控原料性质提供了有前景的途径。然而，共晶共晶组分的准确筛选仍然是共晶体理性制备中的关键瓶颈。为应对这一挑战，研究构建了基于多模态融合的共晶体预测模型，通过整合分子描述符、指纹、SMILES字符串和分子图来筛选潜在共晶组分。该模型引入了动态注意力融合机制和定制的数据平衡策略，以解决单模态局限性和类别不平衡问题，从而在当前评估框架下提升分类性能。该模型展现出强大的分类性能，优于所评估的单模态模型。以柚皮素（Diosmetin）为模型化合物，通过系统性虚拟筛选识别出有前景的共晶组分，并成功合成了柚皮素-4,4′-联吡啶和柚皮素-异烟酰胺共晶体。结构表征揭示柚皮素-4,4′-联吡啶形成由O−H···N氢键稳定的2:1超分子网络。在40 °C/75% RH和40 °C/95% RH的高湿测试条件下，两种共晶体的吸湿量均低于柚皮素。本研究提出了一种用于共晶体预测的多模态融合策略，并凸显了其在固体形态理性设计中的潜力。
items.rv: 本文以多模态融合（分子描述符、指纹、SMILES、分子图）构建共晶组分筛选分类模型，引入动态注意力融合与数据平衡策略，以柚皮素为案例成功合成两种共晶体并验证吸湿改善。属于有机分子晶体方向，与生成模型、视觉生成及纯数学关系较弱。

items.t: From Structurally Related Solvates to Divergent Anhydrous Polymorphs: Desolvation Pathways of Sotorasib
items.a: Sotorasib is a covalent KRAS G12C inhibitor with multiple hydrogen-bonding sites and conformationally flexible groups, making it prone to solvate formation. In this work, eight sotorasib solvates were obtained and systematically characterized, and their crystal structures were determined by SCXRD. Among them, SMeOHα, SDCE, and SMIX are previously unreported solvates. Except for SMIX, the other seven solvates crystallize in the same orthorhombic space group with similar unit-cell parameters and a conserved host−host hydrogen-bonding motif, while differences in guest stoichiometry, local interactions, and lattice occupancy generate distinct packing environments. Upon guest removal, these related solvates exhibit divergent post-desolvation evolution, with lattice destabilization followed by thermal-history-dependent structural reorganization toward different anhydrous polymorphs. Under dynamic heating, DSC reveals Form II-related thermal evolution for SACN and SMeOHα, while HSM further identifies melt-mediated recrystallization for SMeOHα. Molecular dynamics simulations and solvent-vapor-induced transformation experiments further indicate lattice adaptability during guest removal and exchange. These results highlight the roles of lattice environment and thermal history in regulating post-desolvation evolution and polymorph formation.
items.tz: 从结构相关溶剂化物到分歧无水晶型：Sotorasib 的脱溶剂路径
items.az: Sotorasib 是一种共价 KRAS G12C 抑制剂，具有多个氢键位点和构象柔性基团，因此容易形成溶剂化物。本工作中，获得了八种 sotorasib 溶剂化物并进行了系统表征，其晶体结构通过单晶 X 射线衍射（SCXRD）确定。其中，SMeOHα、SDCE 和 SMIX 是此前未报道的溶剂化物。除 SMIX 外，其余七种溶剂化物结晶于同一正交晶系空间群，具有相似的晶胞参数和保守的宿主-宿主氢键基序，而客体化学计量比、局部相互作用和晶格占位率的差异产生了不同的堆积环境。在去除客体后，这些结构相关的溶剂化物表现出不同的脱溶剂后演化路径，晶格失稳后经历依赖于热历史的结构重组，趋向不同的无水晶型。在动态加热条件下，DSC 揭示了 SACN 和 SMeOHα 的 Form II 相关热演化，而 HSM 进一步识别出 SMeOHα 的熔融介导重结晶。分子动力学模拟和溶剂蒸气诱导转化实验进一步表明，在客体去除和交换过程中晶格具有适应性。这些结果突出了晶格环境和热历史在调控脱溶剂后演化和晶型形成中的作用。
items.rv: 研究对象为 sotorasib（KRAS G12C 抑制剂）的八种溶剂化物及其脱溶剂路径，属有机分子晶体与药物多晶型范畴。方法涵盖 SCXRD、DSC、HSM 及分子动力学模拟，核心发现是结构相近的溶剂化物脱溶剂后走向不同无水晶型，受晶格环境与热历史共同调控。与生成模型、视觉生成及相关数学关系很弱，是纯粹的晶体学/多晶型问题。

items.t: DeepHartree: A Poisson-Coupled Neural Field for One-Shot Density Functional Theory
items.a: Linear-combination-of-atomic-orbital (LCAO) density functional theory (DFT) incurs steep costs when it constructs Coulomb terms and iterates the self-consistent field (SCF) equations. Matrix-learning approaches can bypass parts of this workflow, but their outputs inherit the dimensions and conventions of a fixed orbital basis. We introduce DeepHartree, a Poisson-coupled neural field that connects continuous real-space prediction to LCAO electronic structure. An E(3)-equivariant network predicts the Hartree potential, and the Poisson equation converts this potential into electron density. Atom-centered Gaussian fields resolve the near-nuclear region, while a molecule-level correction enforces the electron count. Analytical Gaussian integrals and numerical quadrature connect the predicted fields to the Kohn–Sham matrix. One diagonalization provides estimates of frontier orbital energies and the occupied subspace, and yields the density matrix used to evaluate energy components and initialize SCF. Mean molecular weighted normalized mean absolute errors (wNMAEs) are 0.110% for QM9 and 0.199% for VQM24 on PySCF level-0 grids, increasing to 1.366% and 2.218%, respectively, on level-3 grids. Models trained on def2-SVP densities transfer without retraining to def2-TZVP and def2-QZVP, retaining total-energy accuracy and occupied-subspace agreement. The Hybrid method combines finite differences and first-order automatic differentiation with analytical Gaussian integrals and multilevel quadrature to accelerate field-to-matrix conversion.
items.v: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
items.tz: DeepHartree：面向单次密度泛函理论的泊松耦合神经场
items.az: 原子轨道线性组合（LCAO）密度泛函理论（DFT）在构建库仑项和迭代自洽场（SCF）方程时会产生高昂的计算成本。矩阵学习方法可以绕过该工作流的部分环节，但其输出继承了固定轨道基组的维度和约定。我们提出 DeepHartree，一种泊松耦合的神经场，将连续实空间预测与 LCAO 电子结构连接起来。一个 E(3)-等变网络预测哈特里势，泊松方程将该势转换为电子密度。以原子为中心的 Gaussian 场解析近核区域，而分子层面的校正则约束电子数。解析 Gaussian 积分和数值求积将预测的场与 Kohn–Sham 矩阵连接起来。一次对角化即可提供前沿轨道能量和占据子空间的估计，并生成用于评估能量分量和初始化 SCF 的密度矩阵。在 PySCF level-0 网格上，QM9 和 VQM24 的平均分子加权归一化平均绝对误差（wNMAE）分别为 0.110% 和 0.199%；在 level-3 网格上分别增至 1.366% 和 2.218%。在 def2-SVP 密度上训练的模型无需重新训练即可迁移至 def2-TZVP 和 def2-QZVP，保持总能精度和占据子空间一致性。Hybrid 方法将有限差分和一阶自动微分与解析 Gaussian 积分及多级求积相结合，以加速场到矩阵的转换。
items.rv: 该工作提出 DeepHartree，用 E(3)-等变网络在实空间预测哈特里势，经泊松方程反解电子密度，再经解析积分映射回 Kohn–Sham 矩阵，实现单次对角化即得前沿轨道与密度矩阵。方法核心是连续实空间神经场与 LCAO 电子结构的桥接，属于量子化学中神经网络代理模型，与有机分子晶体、视觉生成、相关数学关系较弱。

items.t: Voxelotor Polymorphs: Crystalline Diversity of a Highly Potent Sickle Cell Anaemia Drug
items.a: The solid-state landscape of highly flexible organic molecules often presents profound challenges and opportunities in materials chemistry, critically dictating macroscopic, physicochemical, and biopharmaceutical properties. Herein, we report voxelotor, a BCS Class II drug historically developed for sickle cell disease, as a noteworthy model system to elucidate nucleation pathways and a non-classical structure-performance relationship, with bioavailability that is critically dependent on its solid form. We report the preferential crystallization, multigram scale-up, and comprehensive structural elucidation of seven distinct polymorphic forms (Forms I-VII), including four previously undiscovered solid phases. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction and computational lattice energy calculations, including Hirshfeld surface analysis, show that its rich polymorphic diversity is rooted in extreme torsional adaptability (variations in τ2 from -160.0° to +110.0°), which drives parallel displaced π···π stacking and hydrogen-bonded assemblies. Thermal and humidity stress profiling discloses a complex relationship between thermodynamic stability and kinetic trapping. Notably, we identified paradoxical stability behavior in which seemingly robust, high lattice energy metastable states (e.g., Forms III, IV, V, and VI) undergo temperature- and moisture-promoted structural transformation and solid-state conversion to Form I crystals, which exhibit greater stability under ambient conditions.
items.tz: Voxelotor 多晶型：一种高效镰状细胞贫血药物的晶体多样性
items.az: 高柔性有机分子的固态景观在材料化学中往往带来深刻的挑战与机遇，并关键性地决定其宏观、理化及生物制药性质。本文以 voxelotor（一种历史上用于治疗镰状细胞病的 BCS II 类药物）作为值得关注的模型体系，阐明其成核路径及非经典的构效关系，其生物利用度关键性地依赖于其固态形式。我们报道了七种不同多晶型（I 型至 VII 型）的优先结晶、多克级放大及全面结构解析，其中包括四种此前未被发现的固相。单晶 X 射线衍射与计算晶格能计算（包括 Hirshfeld 表面分析）表明，其丰富的多晶型多样性根源于极端的扭转适应性（τ2 在 -160.0° 至 +110.0° 之间变化），由此驱动平行位移 π···π 堆积和氢键组装体。热应力与湿度应力分析揭示了热力学稳定性与动力学捕获之间的复杂关系。值得注意的是，我们鉴定出一种悖论性稳定性行为：看似稳健的高晶格能亚稳态（如 III 型、IV 型、V 型和 VI 型）在温度和湿度促进下发生结构转变和固相转化，转变为 I 型晶体，而 I 型晶体在环境条件下表现出更高的稳定性。
items.rv: 以镰状细胞贫血药物 voxelotor 为对象，通过单晶 X 射线衍射、Hirshfeld 表面分析和晶格能计算，解析了七种多晶型结构并评估其热与湿度稳定性。核心发现是极端扭转自由度驱动平行位移 π 堆积与氢键组装，产生丰富多晶型及悖论性亚稳态转化。与「有机分子晶体」最为接近，涉及多晶型筛选与固相转化机制。

items.t: MARS: Machine-Learned Force Field Framework for Automated Conformational Sampling, Vibrational Spectroscopy, and Microsolvation
items.a: We present MARS, an open-source Python package for automated conformational ensemble generation, infrared spectrum prediction, and explicit microsolvation of molecular systems. Built on JAX for GPU acceleration and automatic differentiation, MARS is carried out with machine-learned force fields (MLFFs), including SO3LR and MACE, with a four-phase conformational sampling workflow combining metadynamics, multitemperature molecular dynamics, and genetic algorithms. The package provides automated vibrational mode classification using Wilson B-matrix projections and functional group identification via graph-based pattern matching. We benchmark MARS on chemically diverse systems, including alkanes, halogenated aromatics, amino acids, peptides, drug-like molecules, phosphamides, host–guest complexes, and microsolvated biomolecular models. Semiempirical quantum-chemical methods have until now provided the practical state of the art for automated conformational sampling. Our benchmarks show that modern MLFFs can improve upon this paradigm by combining greater accuracy for high-level relative conformer energies with lower computational cost and more favorable scaling with molecular size. IR benchmarks against experimental gas-phase spectra additionally show performance comparable to quantum-chemical methods, with chemically interpretable mode assignments. Applications to alanine peptides, proline/β-cyclodextrin inclusion complexes, alanine dipeptide, and 2-methoxycyclohexanone further demonstrate that MARS captures conformational reorganization, noncovalent binding motifs, solvent-induced stability shifts, and spectroscopic signatures. These results establish MARS as a transferable and accessible platform for ensemble-based molecular modeling with machine-learned potentials. MARS is freely available at github.com/tcpunilu/mars.
items.v: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
items.tz: MARS：用于自动化构象采样、振动光谱和微溶剂化的机器学习力场框架
items.az:
我们介绍了MARS，一个用于分子系统的自动化构象集合生成、红外光谱预测以及显式微溶剂化的开源Python包。
基于JAX实现GPU加速和自动微分，MARS采用机器学习力场（MLFFs），包括SO3LR和MACE，结合了元动力学、多温度分子动力学和遗传算法的四阶段构象采样工作流程。
该包提供了基于Wilson B矩阵投影的振动模式分类以及基于图的模式匹配的功能团识别。
我们在化学多样性系统上对MARS进行了基准测试，包括烷烃、卤代芳烃、氨基酸、肽类、类药物分子、磷酰胺、主客体复合物以及微溶剂化生物分子模型。
半经验量子化学方法至今仍是自动化构象采样的实用前沿。
我们的基准测试表明，现代机器学习力场（MLFFs）通过在高阶相对构象能的准确性、更低的计算成本以及与分子大小更优的可扩展性方面结合，能够改进这一范式。
红外基准测试与实验气相光谱对比还显示出性能与量子化学方法相当，且具有可解释的振动模式分配。
对甘氨酸肽、脯氨酸/β-环糊精包合物、甘氨酸二肽以及2-甲氧基环己酮的应用进一步证明，MARS能够捕捉构象重排、非共价结合模式、溶剂诱导的稳定性变化以及光谱特征。
这些结果表明MARS是一种可转移且易于使用的基于机器学习势函数的集合分子建模平台。
MARS可在github.com/tcpunilu/mars免费获取。
items.rv: MARS 是基于 JAX 的开源 Python 包，用 SO3LR 和 MACE 等机器学习力场执行四阶段构象采样（元动力学、多温度分子动力学、遗传算法），并自动完成振动模式分类与官能团识别。基准覆盖烷烃、氨基酸、药物分子等体系，表明现代 MLFF 在相对构象能精度与计算效率上优于半经验量子化学方法。与「有机分子晶体」最接近，属分子构象与光谱的计算化学工具；与生成模型、视觉生成关系弱。
items.tw: 作者：Alexandre Tkatchenko；期刊在重点名单

items.t: Chameleonic π-Hole Behavior in Metal−Isocyanide Complexes: N ↔ C Composition-Controlled Migration
items.a: Cocrystal architecture reflects the cumulative outcome of competing and cooperating noncovalent interactions (NCIs) within the lattice. Here we demonstrate that the electrophilic π-hole of a coordinated aryl isocyanide is chameleonic: its localization migrates between the nitrogen and carbon termini of the C≡N bond in direct response to crystal composition. X-ray diffraction analysis of trans-[PdI2(CNC6H4Cl-4)2] (1) and its iodine cocrystals 1·I2 and 1·2I2, complemented by the isostructural platinum(II) analogue 2·I2, reveals three distinct binding regimes: Pd-πAr assembly in the parent complex, Pd-π-(CN) assembly at 1:1 stoichiometry, and π-(CN)-hole···I(LP) contacts at 1:2 stoichiometry. Quantum chemical analysis (Molecular Electrostatic Potential, Quantum Theory of Atoms in Molecules, NCIplot, Energy Decomposition Analysis, Natural Bond Orbital) establishes that the short C≡N bond and the small electrostatic differential between the two termini generate a delocalized π-hole that adapts to spatial demands imposed by competing halogen bonds. Energy decomposition further reveals that the N ↔ C migration is accompanied by a fundamental change in the stabilizing forces, from dispersion- and correlation-dominated stacking to orbital- and electrostatic-driven halogen bonding. These findings establish stoichiometry-controlled π-hole directionality as a design principle for engineering cocrystals in which multiple NCI types coexist in spatially optimized arrangements.
items.tz: 金属-异氰化物配合物中变色龙式π-孔行为：N ↔ C 组成控制迁移
items.az: 共晶结构反映了晶格内竞争与合作的非共价相互作用（NCI）的累积结果。本文证明，配位的芳基异氰化物上的亲电π-孔具有变色龙特性：其定位在C≡N键的氮端和碳端之间迁移，直接响应晶体组成的变化。对反式-[PdI2(CNC6H4Cl-4)2]（1）及其碘共晶1·I2和1·2I2的X射线衍射分析，辅以同构的铂(II)类似物2·I2，揭示了三种不同的结合模式：母体配合物中的Pd-πAr组装、1:1化学计量比下的Pd-π-(CN)组装，以及1:2化学计量比下的π-(CN)-孔···I(LP)接触。量子化学分析（分子静电势、分子内原子量子理论、NCIplot、能量分解分析、自然键轨道）表明，短的C≡N键和两端之间微小的静电势差产生了一个离域π-孔，该π-孔能够适应竞争卤键所施加的空间需求。能量分解进一步揭示，N ↔ C迁移伴随着稳定力的根本变化，从色散和关联主导的堆积转变为轨道和静电驱动的卤键。这些发现确立了化学计量比控制的π-孔方向性作为设计原则，用于构建多种NCI类型在空间优化排列中共存的共晶体。
items.rv: 本文研究金属-异氰化物配合物中π-孔随晶体组成在C≡N键两端间的变色龙式迁移，结合X射线衍射与MESP、QTAIM、EDA、NBO等量子化学手段阐明迁移机制及稳定力转变。对象为含有机配体的配合物共晶体系，与「有机分子晶体」最为接近，核心是非共价相互作用的晶体工程，与生成模型、视觉生成关系较弱。

items.t: The overlooked ZIF: reviving [Cu(imidazolato) 2 ] from 1960s literature
items.a: Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs), and in particular zeolitic imidazolate frameworks (ZIFs), are amongst the most well studied materials in modern chemistry. MOFs emerged as an explicit subfield of chemistry in the late 1980s and 1990s. However, much foundational work was accomplished in earlier decades. Here, we detail the structural and gas-adsorption characterization of [Cu(im) 2 ] (im = imidazolate), a ZIF that was widely reported in the early 1960s. This compound exists as several polymorphs. We re-prepared the historic blue polymorph [Cu(im) 2 ]-B, which has a sodalite topology, confirmed its identity by single-crystal X-ray diffraction, and measured its gas-adsorption isotherms. We conclude that the true origin of ZIFs lies with a copper(II) framework discovered more than 60 years ago that has been overlooked by recent literature.
items.tz: 被忽视的 ZIF：从 1960 年代文献中重新发现 [Cu(imidazolato)₂]
items.az: 金属有机框架（MOFs），尤其是沸石咪唑酯骨架材料（ZIFs），是现代化学中研究最为深入的材料之一。MOFs 在 20 世纪 80 年代末至 90 年代才作为一个明确的化学子领域出现。然而，大量基础性工作早在更早的几十年就已完成。本文详细报道了 [Cu(im)₂]（im = 咪唑酸根）的结构与气体吸附表征，该 ZIF 在 20 世纪 60 年代初曾被广泛报道。该化合物存在多种多晶型。我们重新合成了具有方钠石（sodalite）拓扑结构的经典蓝色多晶型 [Cu(im)₂]-B，通过单晶 X 射线衍射确认了其身份，并测量了其气体吸附等温线。我们得出结论：ZIFs 的真正起源是一个 60 多年前被发现、却被近年文献所忽视的铜(II)框架。
items.rv: 本文重新合成了 1960 年代报道的蓝色多晶型 [Cu(im)₂]-B，用单晶 X 射线衍射确认其方钠石拓扑结构并测量气体吸附等温线，旨在纠正 ZIF 起源被近年文献忽视的历史。属于配位聚合物与有机分子晶体的结构表征工作，与「有机分子晶体」最接近，与生成模型、视觉生成无直接关联。

items.t: The Effect of High Pressure on Nanoporous Molecular Crystals of Cofacial Porphyrin/Phthalocyanine Heterodimers
items.a: High-pressure single-crystal X-ray diffraction was used to characterize two phthalocyanine nanoporous crystals (PNCs) based on cofacial heterodimers of tetraphenylporphyrin (TPPCo) and octa(2’,6’-di-iso-propylphenoxy)phthalocyanine [(dipPhO)8PcCo], with and without a 4,4’-bipyridine "wall-tie" ligand....
items.tz: 高压对共面卟啉/酞菁异二聚体纳米多孔分子晶体的影响
items.az: 高压单晶X射线衍射被用于表征两种酞菁纳米多孔晶体（PNC），它们基于四苯基卟啉（TPPCo）与八(2',6'-二异丙基苯氧基)酞菁[(dipPhO)8PcCo]的共面异二聚体，分别含和不含4,4'-联吡啶「wall-tie」配体。....
items.rv: 研究对象为卟啉/酞菁共面异二聚体组装的纳米多孔分子晶体，采用高压单晶X射线衍射表征含与不含4,4'-联吡啶「壁连」配体两种体系在高压下的结构变化。属于有机分子晶体范畴，与生成模型、视觉生成及数学无直接关联。

items.t: Insights into the Nature and Thermal Phase Behavior of Mechanochemically Prepared Multicomponent Solids of 2-Amino-5-nitropyridine with para -Substituted Benzoic Acids
items.a: The thermal phase behavior of binary systems consisting of the supramolecular building block 2-amino-5-nitropyridine (ANP) with five systematically varied series of para-substituted aromatic acids (4XBA), viz, benzoic acid (BA), 4-fluorobenzoic acid (4FBA), 4-chlorobenzoic acid (4CBA), 4-bromobenzoic acid (4BBA), and 4-iodobenzoic acid (4IBA), was investigated separately. While single-crystal structures of 1:1 ANP-4FBA, 1:1 ANP-4CBA, and 1:1 ANP-4BBA in this series are known, their bulk thermodynamic stability and mechanochemical phase behavior have remained unmapped. The bulk binary mixtures of various compositions were prepared by an environmentally friendly mechanochemical neat grinding method. The thermal properties of the ground materials were thoroughly mapped using differential scanning calorimetry (DSC). The solid−liquid thermal binary phase diagrams were systematically constructed using DSC data and validated using Tammann plots and Predictor of Eutectic Mixture (PoEM) analysis. The phase diagram study of all the five systems revealed the distinct thermal phase behavior across the series. The ANP-4FBA system forms a stable congruently melting 1:1 cocrystal characterized by a “W-shaped” phase diagram with two eutectic valleys, while the ANP-BA, ANP-4CBA, and ANP-4BBA systems form an incongruent 1:1 cocrystal characterized by an asymmetrical liquidus curve terminating at a horizontal peritectic isothermal line in their phase diagrams.
items.tz: 2-氨基-5-硝基吡啶与对位取代苯甲酸机械化学制备多组分固体的性质及热相行为研究
items.az: 由超分子构建块2-氨基-5-硝基吡啶（ANP）与五个系统变化的对位取代芳香酸（4XBA）系列——即苯甲酸（BA）、4-氟苯甲酸（4FBA）、4-氯苯甲酸（4CBA）、4-溴苯甲酸（4BBA）和4-碘苯甲酸（4IBA）——组成的二元体系的热相行为被分别进行了研究。虽然该系列中1:1 ANP-4FBA、1:1 ANP-4CBA和1:1 ANP-4BBA的单晶结构已知，但其体相热力学稳定性和机械化学相行为尚未被表征。各种组成的体相二元混合物通过一种环境友好的机械化学纯研磨方法制备。研磨材料的热性质通过差示扫描量热法（DSC）进行了全面表征。固-液热二元相图利用DSC数据系统构建，并通过Tammann图和共晶混合物预测器（PoEM）分析进行验证。所有五个体系的相图研究揭示了该系列中不同的热相行为。ANP-4FBA体系形成稳定的同熔1:1共晶体，其特征是具有两个共晶谷的「W形」相图；而ANP-BA、ANP-4CBA和ANP-4BBA体系形成异熔1:1共晶体，其特征是相图中不对称的液相线终止于水平的包晶等温线。
items.rv: 以2-氨基-5-硝基吡啶与五种对位取代苯甲酸为对象，用机械化学纯研磨制备体相二元混合物，通过DSC系统构建固-液热二元相图，并用Tammann图和PoEM分析验证。揭示了同熔与异熔共晶体的不同相图特征。属于有机分子晶体领域，与生成模型、视觉生成及相关数学关系弱。
